zh: 娃的舌苔又白又厚，口气重，吃饭不好，是不是积食了

en: My kid always scratches itchy buttocks at night with no redness. Need pinworm medicine?
zh: 孩子晚上睡觉老说屁股痒，总去抠，我看了一下也没红，是不是肚子里有蛲虫，要吃打虫药吗

en: My kid snores loudly and holds breath occasionally while sleeping. Is it adenoid hypertrophy?
zh: 娃睡觉打鼾，像大人一样，偶尔憋气，是不是腺样体肥大

en: Painless yellowish eye discharge in kids. Lacrimal duct obstruction?
zh: 娃的眼睛里有黄白色分泌物，眼睛不红，是不是泪道堵塞

en: A small hole on my kid's ear occasionally secretes smelly fluid. Is it congenital fistula?
zh: 娃耳朵轮廓上有个小洞，偶尔流臭液，是不是先天瘘管

en: Painless millet-like flesh-colored bumps on kid's hands.
zh: 娃手上长了很多小疙瘩，肤色，像小米粒，不疼不痒，是什么

en: Insomnia caused by racing thoughts at night. Is it anxiety disorder?
zh: 最近总是失眠，躺下脑子胡思乱想，越想越精神，是不是焦虑症

en: Acid reflux worsens lying flat and eases with elevated pillow. Is it gastroesophageal reflux?
zh: 最近总是反酸，晚上躺下加重，枕头垫高好点，是不是食管反流

en: Runny nose and itchy eyes don't improve with cold medicine. Is it allergic rhinitis?
zh: 娃打喷嚏流鼻涕，以为是感冒，吃了药没用，眼睛也痒，是不是过敏性鼻炎

en: Severely painful blood blister after wart cryotherapy. Is the treatment ineffective?
zh: 我脚上瘊子用冷冻治疗，起了大血泡，很疼，是不是没治好

en: Eating icy watermelon causes stomachache and diarrhea. Is it enteritis?
zh: 每次吃冰西瓜就拉肚子，肚子疼，是不是肠炎

en: I get stomachache and diarrhea after drinking icy beer. Is it stomach cold?
zh: 每次喝冰啤酒就肚子疼，拉肚子，是不是胃寒

en: My toes are frostbitten with itchy swelling that worsens when warm. Any effective medicine?
zh: 我脚趾头冻伤了，红肿痒，一热更痒，有没有什么药能好

en: Kid has tinnitus and turns up TV volume. Possible middle ear effusion?
zh: 娃总说耳朵响，嗡嗡的，看电视声音开很大，是不是中耳有积液

en: I cough and feel breathless when smelling cigarette smoke. Is it asthma?
zh: 每次闻到烟味就咳嗽，喘不上气，是不是哮喘

en: A painless small fleshy lump exists in kid's ear since birth.
zh: 娃耳朵里有个小肉球，出生就有，不疼不痒，是什么

en: Painless bony protrusion on kid's foot. Is it accessory navicular bone?
zh: 娃脚上长了个硬包，像骨头凸起，不疼，是不是副舟骨

en: My kid passes pellet-shaped dry stools and cries during defecation.
zh: 娃大便干燥，一粒粒的，拉屎哭，用了开塞露拉了，但还是干

en: Post-meal belching, flatulence and stomach gurgling. Is it poor gastrointestinal function?
zh: 最近总是饭后嗳气，放屁多，肚子咕噜叫，是不是肠胃不好

en: Mood swings trigger bloating and belching. Is it neurogenic gastropathy?
zh: 最近心情一不好就胃胀，打嗝，气出来就舒服，是不是神经性胃病

en: Chest tightness relieved by deep breathing. Is it heart trouble?
zh: 最近总感觉胸闷，深吸气才舒服，打哈欠也打不出来，是不是心脏问题

en: Kid's abdominal discomfort relieves after rubbing. Is it intestinal spasm?
zh: 娃老说肚子不舒服，揉揉就好，肚脐周围软，是不是肠痉挛

en: My kid has bloated belly relieved by passing gas. Is it food accumulation?
zh: 孩子老说肚子胀，拍着咚咚响，放屁后舒服，是不是积食了

en: A bulge appears when my kid pees and disappears afterwards without pain. Is it redundant prepuce?
zh: 娃尿尿时鼓包，尿完消失，不疼，是不是包皮过长

en: Itchy private parts with white dirt and red foreskin in kid. How to clean correctly?
zh: 娃总说小鸡鸡痒，翻开有白色污垢，包皮口红，怎么清洗

en: My kid has itchy private parts with white dirt and red foreskin. Is it balanitis?
zh: 娃总说小鸡鸡痒，翻开有白色污垢，包皮口红，是不是包皮炎

en: Hunger pain relieved by eating, typical duodenal ulcer manifestation.
zh: 最近总是胃痛，饥饿时更痛，吃点东西就好，是不是十二指肠溃疡

en: Patchy facial red streaks turn redder when kid cries. Is it hemangioma?
zh: 娃脸上有红血丝，一片片的，哭闹时更红，是不是血管瘤

en: Petechiae-like spots that don't fade under pressure with normal blood tests.
zh: 娃身上长了好多小红点，像出血点，按压不褪色，查血正常，是什么

en: Transparent lip blisters form yellow scabs after breaking. Is it herpes?
zh: 娃嘴唇上长了个水泡，透明，破了结黄痂，是不是疱疹

en: Itchy lip blisters forming yellow scabs. Is it internal heat?
zh: 我嘴唇上起了小水泡，痒，然后结黄痂，是不是上火

en: Painless round dry peeling white patches on my kid's face. Is it vitiligo?
zh: 娃脸上有白斑，圆形，表面干燥脱屑，不痒，是不是白癜风

en: Horizontal grooves on all fingernails. Does it indicate severe illness?
zh: 我手指甲上有横沟，一条一条的，所有指甲都有，是不是大病

en: Urinary leakage occurs when coughing or rushing. Is it urinary incontinence?
zh: 最近总感觉憋不住尿，一着急就漏，尤其是咳嗽时，是不是尿失禁

en: Duck-like walking posture in kids. Is it hip dysplasia?
zh: 娃走路鸭子步，屁股翘，跑不快，是不是髋关节发育不良

en: My kid catches cold and fever frequently after entering kindergarten, relapses soon after recovery.
zh: 娃自从上了幼儿园，每个月都感冒发烧，这个月第三次了，刚好两天又烧，快崩溃了

en: Mouth breathing leads to chapped lips in kids. Is it adenoid hypertrophy?
zh: 娃睡觉总是张着嘴，嘴唇干裂，白天也习惯张着，是不是腺样体肥大

en: Frequent nausea and vomiting after taking contraceptives, need to change medicine.
zh: 每次吃避孕药就恶心，呕吐，是不是不能吃这种药

en: My kid bites lower lip and grinds teeth. Does he lack trace elements?
zh: 娃老咬下嘴唇，磨牙，是不是缺什么微量元素

en: Lip and mouth corner cracks worsened by licking, angular cheilitis.
zh: 娃嘴唇干裂起皮，舔了更干，嘴角也裂了，是不是口角炎

en: Severe mouth corner cracks limiting mouth opening, comprehensive angular cheilitis care.
zh: 娃的嘴角烂，裂口，张不开嘴，吃饭疼，是不是口角炎

en: Mouth corner cracks worsened by licking, lip-licking dermatitis.
zh: 娃嘴角烂了，裂口，起皮，老用舌头舔，越舔越烂，是不是舌舔皮炎

en: Coffee causes palpitations and hand tremors. Is it caffeine intolerance?
zh: 每次喝咖啡就心慌，手抖，是不是咖啡因中毒

en: Coffee triggers stomachache especially on empty stomach. Is it gastritis?
zh: 每次喝咖啡就胃痛，空腹更痛，是不是胃炎

en: Skin redness around warts after imiquimod use, suspected allergy.
zh: 娃手上长了个寻常疣，用了咪喹莫特乳膏，周围红了一圈，是不是过敏

en: My kid has severe dry cough at bedtime and dawn without daytime symptoms. Is it allergic cough?
zh: 娃晚上咳嗽，干咳，睡前和凌晨严重，白天不咳，是不是过敏

en: My kid only coughs in morning and evening or after exercise. Is it asthma?
zh: 娃早晚咳嗽，平时不咳，跑跳后咳，是不是哮喘

en: Persistent throat phlegm cannot be relieved by expectorants.
zh: 最近总觉得嗓子有痰，咳不出来，咽不下去，吃了化痰药也没用

en: My kid has chapped bleeding lips and always licks off lip balm. How to improve it?
zh: 娃嘴唇干裂，出血，不爱喝水，涂唇膏就舔掉，怎么办

en: Conservative treatment for easily enlarged painless transparent lip mucous cysts.
zh: 娃的嘴唇上有个小泡，透明，不疼，舔了变大，是不是黏液腺囊肿

en: Painless lip blister swelling after hot food intake.
zh: 娃的嘴唇上长了个泡，吃热饭后变大，不疼，是什么

en: Painless persistent transparent lip blister, mucous cyst.
zh: 娃嘴唇上长了一个透明小水泡，不疼，好几天没消，是不是黏液腺囊肿

en: My baby snores with phlegm-like sound while feeding without crying. Is he catching a cold?
zh: 孩子吃奶时鼻子呼噜呼噜响，像有痰，不哭闹，是不是感冒了

en: My kid lost sense of smell ever after catching a cold. Is it nasal polyps?
zh: 娃总说鼻子闻不到味道，感冒后一直没好，是不是鼻息肉

en: Painful mandibular induration turning suppurative, infected sebaceous cyst.
zh: 我下巴上长了个硬疙瘩，按着疼，几天后化脓，挤出脓血，是不是皮脂腺囊肿感染

en: Smooth red patch without coating on kid's tongue. Geographic tongue?
zh: 娃的舌苔上有一块没苔，光滑发红，是不是地图舌

en: My kid gets otitis media with ear pain and pus discharge every time he catches a cold.
zh: 娃每次感冒都中耳炎，耳朵疼，流脓，怎么办

en: Recurrent mouth ulcers affect eating. Is it immune system disorder?
zh: 最近总是口腔溃疡，舌尖舌尖下，疼得吃不下饭，是不是免疫系统问题

en: Painless dark tooth surface in kids, extrinsic pigmentation.
zh: 娃的牙齿有点黑，刷牙刷不掉，也不疼，是不是色素沉着

en: Smelly yellow ear discharge without severe pain, chronic otitis media.
zh: 娃的耳朵里流黄水，有臭味，不疼，是不是中耳炎

en: There is smelly yellow sticky discharge at my kid's ear opening without pain. Is it suppurative otitis media?
zh: 娃的耳朵口有黄色黏稠分泌物，有点臭，不疼，是不是中耳炎流脓

en: My kid wakes up suddenly crying confusedly in sleep. Is it night terror?
zh: 娃睡觉突然惊醒，大哭，眼睛睁着像不认识人，几分钟后又睡，是不是夜惊

en: Kid kicks quilt at night and has yellow nasal discharge in the morning. Is it cold?
zh: 娃晚上睡觉总踢被子，翻来覆去，早上起来鼻涕黄，是不是感冒了

en: My 5-year-old kid still wets the bed occasionally in night. Is it nocturnal enuresis?
zh: 娃尿床，五岁了还隔三差五尿，白天没事，是不是遗尿症

en: My one-year-old baby can only roll around instead of crawling. Is it developmental delay?
zh: 娃一岁还不会爬，只会趴着打转，是不是发育迟缓

en: Thick smelly unremovable scalp crusts in kids. Is it tinea capitis?
zh: 娃头上长了像头皮屑样的痂，厚，有臭味，洗不掉，是不是头癣

en: Painless soft water-filled lump on kid's head.
zh: 娃的头上长了个包，软软的，按着不疼，像水球，是什么

en: Thick smelly white scalp dandruff in kids. Is it tinea capitis?
zh: 娃头皮上有白色头皮屑，厚厚一层，还有臭味，是不是头癣

en: Itchy red rashes turning into yellow scabs on kid's scalp. Is it impetigo?
zh: 娃头皮上长了好多红疙瘩，痒，抓破结黄痂，是不是脓疱疮

en: My kid got a big bruised head bump after falling. Need CT scan?
zh: 娃头上摔了个包，又大又青，哭了很久，要不要去医院拍CT

en: Severe morning sickness makes me vomit everything and lose weight. Any safe relief medicine?
zh: 孕吐太严重了，吃什么吐什么，连喝水都吐，瘦了五斤，有没有什么药能缓解，怕影响宝宝

en: My kid wakes up frequently crying in sleep many times a night. Does he lack certain nutrients?
zh: 娃睡觉时频繁惊醒，哭几声又睡，一夜好多次，是不是缺什么

en: Dry rough red facial rashes in kids, dry eczema.
zh: 娃的脸上一块红，摸起来粗糙，干燥起皮，是不是湿疹

en: My kid likes sleeping on his stomach with hips raised at night. Is it indigestion?
zh: 娃晚上睡觉爱趴着睡，屁股撅起来，是不是消化不良

en: My baby only sleeps well held in arms and wakes up immediately lying on bed exhausting me.
zh: 宝宝晚上老是哭闹，非要抱着才肯睡，一放床上就醒，抱着睡能睡两小时，放下十分钟就醒，快累死了

en: My kid vomits when crying or feeding with normal weight gain. Stomach disorder?
zh: 娃一哭就吐，有时候吃奶后也吐，但是体重增长正常，是不是胃有问题

en: Unremovable yellow crusts grow on my kid's scalp. Is it seborrheic dermatitis?
zh: 娃头上长了好多黄色痂皮，像头皮屑，洗不掉，是不是脂溢性皮炎

en: Strawberry-like raised red nevus on kid's arm, will it fade naturally?
zh: 娃的胳膊上长了个红痣，凸起的，像草莓，出生后长的，会自己消吗

en: A strawberry-like raised red nevus grows on my kid's belly after birth. Will it fade away?
zh: 娃肚子上有个红痣，凸起来的，像草莓，出生后长出来的，会消吗

en: My kid vomits easily when crying but plays well afterwards with normal weight. Does he have a shallow stomach?
zh: 娃一哭就吐，吐完照常玩，体重正常，是不是胃太浅

en: My kid has unilateral stuffy nose, runny nose and sneezing worse in the morning. Is it allergic rhinitis?
zh: 娃鼻子总有一个鼻孔堵，流清涕，打喷嚏，早上严重，是不是过敏性鼻炎

en: Distended belly relieved by farting in kids. Intestinal flatulence?
zh: 娃的肚子总是鼓鼓的，敲着像打鼓，放屁后变小，是不是胀气

en: Postprandial abdominal distension relieved by flatulence. Is it gut flora imbalance?
zh: 最近总是肚子胀，吃完饭更胀，排气后缓解，是不是肠道菌群失调

en: Coccygeal pain worse on soft cushions. Rule out old injury.
zh: 最近总是尾骨疼，坐软沙发更疼，坐硬凳子好点，是不是尾骨骨折

en: Excessive thirst and frequent urination with normal blood sugar. Is it diabetes insipidus?
zh: 最近总是口渴，喝水很多，尿也多，查血糖正常，是不是尿崩症

en: Oozing shiny red rash in kid's diaper area. Diaper rash?
zh: 娃的屁股上有红疹，尿布区，皮肤发亮，有渗出，是不是尿布疹

en: Red moist broken skin on kid's groin. Is it diaper rash?
zh: 娃大腿根发红，潮湿，皮肤破损，是不是尿布疹

en: Split urine stream without pain in kids. Is it redundant prepuce?
zh: 娃尿尿分叉，尿得远，不疼，是不是包皮过长

en: My kid has smelly dark yellow urine due to little water intake. Is it urinary tract infection?
zh: 娃尿尿有臭味，颜色黄，喝水少，是不是尿路感染

en: Eye pain and diplopia in kids, first check astigmatism.
zh: 娃总说眼睛疼，看东西重影，是不是散光

en: Kid's lips turn purple and holds breath when crying. Is it heart disease?
zh: 娃一哭就嘴唇发紫，脸发青，憋气好几秒，是不是心脏病

en: My kid’s lips turn purple when crying. Is there something wrong with his heart?
zh: 娃一哭就嘴唇发紫，浑身使劲，缓过来就没事，是不是心脏有问题

en: Ingrown toenail causes swollen suppurative pain affecting walking.
zh: 我脚上趾甲长到肉里，红肿流脓，疼得走不了路，怎么办

en: Ingrown toenail with tender red skin in kids, treatment methods.
zh: 娃的脚趾甲往里长，有点红，碰到就疼，是不是嵌甲

en: Chocolate triggers throbbing migraine.
zh: 每次吃巧克力就头疼，一跳一跳的，是不是偏头痛

en: Morning sneezing, runny nose and unilateral congestion in kids, typical allergic rhinitis.
zh: 娃鼻子总有一侧塞，流清涕，打喷嚏，早上严重，是不是过敏性鼻炎

en: Night-only nasal congestion in kids mostly caused by dry air.
zh: 娃睡觉时鼻塞，白天没事，是不是房间空气太干

en: My nose is dry with scabs and easy bleeding, worse in winter. Is it dry rhinitis?
zh: 总感觉鼻子干，有血痂，抠一下流血，冬天更严重，是不是干燥性鼻炎

en: Excessive tears yet dry eyes, special type of dry eye syndrome.
zh: 最近总是眼干，眼泪很多，越擦越干，是不是干眼症

en: My kid has ear pain worse when pulling ears plus slight fever. Is it otitis media?
zh: 孩子总说耳朵疼，一拽耳朵更疼，还有点发烧，是不是中耳炎了

en: Kid has ear pain, fever and ear-pulling behavior. Is it otitis media?
zh: 娃耳朵疼，发烧，哭闹，抓耳朵，是不是中耳炎

en: Ear pain on pulling plus low fever, acute otitis media.
zh: 娃耳朵疼，一拽就疼，还有点发烧，是不是中耳炎了

en: My kid still has ear pain after recovering from cold. Is it otitis media?
zh: 娃感冒好了，但一直说耳朵疼，一拽更疼，是不是中耳炎

en: Kid resists ear touching due to pain. Is it otitis media?
zh: 娃总说耳朵里有东西，不让碰，一碰就疼，是不是中耳炎

en: Barking cough worsens at night in children. Is it laryngitis?
zh: 娃咳嗽时声音像狗叫，空空的声音，晚上加重，是不是喉炎

en: Painful neck lump swelling during fever, lymphadenitis.
zh: 我下巴和脖子交界处有个包，按着疼，发烧时更大，是不是淋巴结炎

en: Torn hangnails lead to swelling and suppuration on kid's hands. Is it paronychia?
zh: 娃手上长倒刺，撕了流血，然后红肿化脓，是不是甲沟炎

en: My kid has swollen eyes with sticky discharge sticking eyelids together. Is it conjunctivitis?
zh: 娃眼睛红肿，有分泌物，早上粘住睁不开，是不是红眼病

en: Waist pain limits bending and relieves after bathing. Is it lumbar muscle strain?
zh: 最近总是腰疼，弯不下腰，洗完澡好点，是不是腰肌劳损

en: Large itchy wheals appear on my kid’s body fading in hours. Is it urticaria?
zh: 娃身上起了风团，一大片一大片的，痒得直哭，过几个小时又没了，是不是荨麻疹

en: Widespread itchy rashes like insect bites. Is it urticaria?
zh: 娃身上长了好多红点，像蚊子咬的，但没有蚊子，痒，是不是荨麻疹

en: Fishy nasal odor, yellow pus rhinorrhea and headache in kids. Sinusitis?
zh: 娃的鼻子里有腥臭味，黄脓鼻涕，头痛，是不是鼻窦炎

en: My kid keeps clearing throat silently after catching a cold. Is it tic disorder?
zh: 娃感冒后一直清嗓子，吭吭声，没有痰，是不是抽动症

en: Yellow smelly pus flows out of my kid's ears without pain. Is it perforated otitis media?
zh: 娃耳朵里流出黄色脓液，有臭味，不疼，是不是中耳炎穿孔

en: I suffer from constipation with pellet-shaped stools. Yogurt doesn't work. How to improve it?
zh: 最近总是便秘，三四天一次，拉出来羊粪蛋，喝酸奶没用，怎么办

en: Bark-like thickened rough hand skin. Is it dermatitis?
zh: 我手上皮肤粗糙，像树皮，指关节处增厚，是不是皮炎

en: Dry itchy patchy lesions around kid's elbows, mostly dry eczema.
zh: 娃的胳膊肘上长了干癣，一块块，粗糙，痒，是不是湿疹

en: Recurrent painless ankle swelling after excessive walking post sprain. Is it ligament laxity?
zh: 我脚踝扭伤后经常肿，走路多了就肿，不疼，是不是韧带松弛

en: Thick hard-to-blow yellow rhinorrhea in kids. Sinusitis?
zh: 娃的鼻子里总有黄鼻涕，黏稠，擤不出来，是不是鼻窦炎

en: Kid has worsening frontal headache in the afternoon. Is it sinusitis?
zh: 娃总说头疼，前额痛，下午加重，是不是鼻窦炎

en: Increasing brown flat warts on face.
zh: 我脸上长了很多扁平疣，褐色，越来越多，怎么办

en: Persistent bad breath in kid even after brushing teeth. Is it tonsil stones?
zh: 娃嘴里有臭味，刷牙也臭，是不是扁桃体结石

en: Palm pigment mole grows slightly. Should it be cut off?
zh: 我手上有色素痣，在掌心，最近感觉变大了一点点，要不要切

en: Bulging cyanotic hand veins. Is it varicose veins?
zh: 我手上血管发青，凸起，一按就瘪，是不是静脉曲张

en: Fingers cannot straighten freely with painful clicking sound. Is it tenosynovitis?
zh: 我手指弯曲后伸不直，要掰一下，咯噔一声，疼，是不是腱鞘炎

en: Painful callus inside big toe caused by hallux valgus?
zh: 我脚上大脚趾内测有硬茧，走路疼，是不是拇外翻导致的

en: Hallux valgus causes foot swelling from tight shoes, is toe separator useful?
zh: 我脚上有大脚骨，穿鞋磨得红肿，用分趾器有效吗

en: Kid has phlegmy cough with moist rales detected. Is it pneumonia?
zh: 娃咳嗽有痰音，但咳不出来，听诊有湿罗音，是不是肺炎

en: There is ring-shaped hair loss on my kid's head. Is it zinc deficiency?
zh: 娃头上有一圈头发少，像斑秃，不疼不痒，是不是缺锌

en: Painless smooth bald patch on kid's scalp. Alopecia areata?
zh: 娃的头发有一块秃了，头皮光滑，不疼不痒，是不是斑秃

en: Midnight awakening with messy thoughts, typical anxiety-induced insomnia.
zh: 最近总是半夜醒来，再也睡不着，脑子里乱七八糟，是不是焦虑症

en: My child often feels dizzy and vomits in the car. Is there something wrong with his vestibular function?
zh: 孩子总说头晕，一上车就晕，还吐，是不是前庭功能不好

en: Near-fainting blackout sensation with normal blood tests.
zh: 最近总感觉要晕倒，眼前发黑，但没真晕，查血正常，是什么

en: A red nevus with white ring grows on my kid's arm.
zh: 娃手臂上长了个小红痣，周围有白色圈，像牛眼，是什么

en: My kid walks lame without pain or injury. Is it hip synovitis?
zh: 娃走路一瘸一拐，不疼，没摔过，是不是髋关节滑膜炎

en: Glove-and-sock numbness in limbs with normal blood sugar.
zh: 最近总感觉手脚发麻，像戴手套袜子，查了血糖正常，是什么

en: My kid mispronounces words unclearly. Is it short lingual frenum?
zh: 娃说话口齿不清，把“哥哥”说成“得得”，是不是舌系带过短

en: My kid has sparse hair at the back of the head. Is it calcium deficiency?
zh: 娃后脑勺有一圈头发稀少，枕秃，是不是缺钙

en: Painless bony occipital protrusion, mostly normal bone development.
zh: 娃的后脑勺有个硬包，像骨头凸起，不疼，什么时候长的不知道

en: My gums turn sour after eating apples. Is it caused by malic acid stimulation?
zh: 每次吃苹果就牙龈酸，像过敏，是不是苹果酸刺激

en: Radical treatment for tooth root inflammation causing gum abscesses and dental caries.
zh: 娃的牙龈上长了个脓包，对应的牙齿有洞，是不是牙根坏了

en: A painless pus abscess grows on my kid's gum repeatedly. Is it tooth root inflammation?
zh: 娃牙龈上长了个脓包，不疼，挤破后流脓，过几天又长，是不是牙根发炎

en: My kid sits up shouting soundly asleep with no memory next day. Is it sleepwalking?
zh: 娃晚上睡觉突然坐起来，大喊大叫，但不醒，第二天不记得，是不是梦游

en: Painless rough goosebump-like bumps on kid's hands.
zh: 娃手上起了很多小疙瘩，像鸡皮疙瘩，粗糙，不痛不痒，是什么

en: Obvious facial red blood streaks cannot be covered by makeup. Does photorejuvenation work?
zh: 我脸上红血丝明显，化妆遮不住，做光子嫩肤有用吗

en: Throat itch and tongue numbness after eating cantaloupe, food allergy.
zh: 每次吃哈密瓜就喉咙痒，舌头发麻，是不是过敏

en: Persistent fine urine foam without protein detected. Is it normal?
zh: 娃尿里泡沫多，细小久久不散，查尿常规无蛋白，是不是正常

en: Painless unremovable black spot on kid's tooth. Need filling?
zh: 娃的牙齿上有个黑点，刷牙刷不掉，也不疼，要不要补

en: Thick white tongue coating, sour breath and poor appetite in kids, typical food accumulation.
zh: 娃的舌苔又白又厚，口气酸臭，不爱吃饭，是不是积食了

en: Smelly wet yellow earwax in kids. Is it otitis media?
zh: 娃耳朵里湿性耳屎，黄色黏稠，有异味，是不是中耳炎

en: Smelly wet yellow earwax in kids. Otitis media?
zh: 娃的耳屎是湿的，黄色黏稠，有异味，是不是中耳炎

en: Oozing hand eczema relapses after stopping hormone ointment. Is it hormone dependence?
zh: 我手上有湿疹，渗液，用了激素好了，停药就发，是不是激素依赖

en: Sour fruits trigger severe tooth soreness. Is it dentin hypersensitivity?
zh: 每次吃酸的水果就牙倒，连豆腐都咬不动，是不是牙齿敏感

en: Yellow rough teeth in kids, mainly due to incomplete daily brushing.
zh: 娃的牙齿发黄，牙面不光滑，是不是没刷干净

en: Recurring facial eczema relapses after stopping hormone ointment in kids.
zh: 娃脸上湿疹反复，用了激素就好，停药又发，怎么办

en: Facial flushing and overheating without itchiness. Is it rosacea?
zh: 我脸上一热就红，发烫，但不痒，是不是玫瑰痤疮

en: Sweet food triggers acid regurgitation and heartburn. Is it excessive gastric acid?
zh: 每次吃甜食就反酸，烧心，是不是胃酸过多

en: Inner knee pain only after exercise in kids. Growing pain?
zh: 娃的膝盖内侧疼，走路不疼，跑跳后疼，是不是生长痛

en: My kid has popliteal pain worse after exercise relieved by rest. Is it growing pain needing calcium?
zh: 孩子老说膝盖后面疼，跑跳后更明显，休息就好了，是生长痛吗，要不要补钙

en: My 3-year-old kid suddenly had a fever of 39℃ at night, cold hands and feet but hot body. Can I use the opened Motrin not stored in fridge?
zh: 我家娃三岁，半夜突然烧到39度，手脚冰凉但身上滚烫，美林上次开瓶还能用吗，没放冰箱

en: My kid always tears hangnails until bleeding. How to prevent this?
zh: 娃手指上长倒刺，老去撕，撕到流血，怎么预防

en: Suppurative inflammation caused by torn hangnails in kids.
zh: 娃的手指甲旁边长倒刺，撕了红肿，化脓了，怎么办

en: Suppurative painful swelling beside nails, acute paronychia.
zh: 我手上长了个硬包，在指甲旁边，疼，流脓，是不是甲沟炎

en: I feel sleepy tired and cold with weight gain recently. Is it hypothyroidism?
zh: 最近总感觉累，睡不醒，还怕冷，体重也涨了，是不是甲减

en: Self-fading temporary white nail spots, mostly caused by minor trauma.
zh: 娃的指甲上有白点，过几天又没了，是不是缺什么

en: Pitted nails in kids. Psoriasis nail lesion?
zh: 娃的指甲盖上有小凹坑，像针扎的，是不是银屑病

en: A hard painful red pimple with pus tip grows on my back.
zh: 我后背上长了个红疙瘩，硬，疼，有白头，挤出来是血脓，是什么

en: Dense itchy papules on kid's wrists and ankles, predilection sites of scabies.
zh: 娃的手上起了红疹，丘疹，痒，在手腕和脚腕，是不是疥疮

en: My kid has swollen arms and slight fever after DPT vaccination. Is this normal reaction?
zh: 娃打了百白破疫苗后胳膊红肿，发烧38度，烦躁哭闹，正常吗

en: My baby had fever and rashes after MMR vaccination. Is it vaccine reaction and can I use antifebrile?
zh: 宝宝打完麻腮风疫苗第二天就发烧38.7度，还出了一些红疹，是疫苗反应还是生病了，能吃退烧药吗

en: My kid has recurring fever after vaccination for two days. Is this normal?
zh: 娃打完预防针后发烧，吃了退烧药退了又烧，反复两天，正常吗

en: There is hot swollen hard lump at the vaccination site of my kid. Is it infection?
zh: 娃接种疫苗后针眼处红肿硬块，摸起来热，是不是感染

en: General fatigue and mental sluggishness lately. Is it sub-health state?
zh: 最近感觉浑身没劲，早上起不来，上班脑子昏沉沉的，是不是亚健康了

en: My kid has watery diarrhea and vomiting several times a day without fever. Is it rotavirus infection?
zh: 娃呕吐拉肚子，水样便，一天五六次，不发烧，精神还行，是不是轮状病毒

en: Inflamed painful acne unresponsive to erythromycin ointment, drug resistance.
zh: 我脸上痘痘很多，还痛，用了红霉素软膏没用，是不是细菌耐药

en: Painless white patches with fine scales grow on my kid’s face. Is it ascariasis patch?
zh: 娃脸上长白斑，不痛不痒，表面有细碎皮屑，是蛔虫斑吗

en: Rough white patches like tinea grow on my kid's face and antifungal cream doesn't work.
zh: 娃脸上有白斑，表面粗糙，像癣，涂了抗真菌药没用，是什么

en: Gradually enlarged painless soft posterior neck mass, mostly lymph node hyperplasia.
zh: 娃的脖子后面有个包，按着软，不疼，最近变大了，是不是淋巴结

en: Blue veins on kid's nasal bridge. Is it a health problem?
zh: 娃鼻梁上有青筋，老人说脾气差，是不是有病

en: A hard itchy lump grows on my kid's back. Should it be removed?
zh: 娃后背长了个小疙瘩，硬硬的，像皮内痣，最近有点痒，要不要切

en: My kid always complains of itchy back with no visible rash but scratch marks. Is he allergic-prone?
zh: 孩子老说背后痒，但啥也没有，抓了才有红印，是不是过敏体质

en: Kid feels itchy back with no visible rash but scratch marks appear. Is it dermatographism?
zh: 娃老说后背痒，但什么也没有，抓了起红痕，是不是划痕症

en: Deep wrinkles on hands look senile. Is it collagen loss?
zh: 我手上皱纹很深，尤其关节处，像老人的手，是不是胶原蛋白流失

en: Fragile slow-healing hand skin. Is it vitamin C deficiency?
zh: 我手上皮肤特别薄，一碰就破，擦伤不易愈合，是不是缺维生素C

en: Painless pedunculated soft flesh lump on scalp for years.
zh: 我头皮上长了个肉瘤，软的，有蒂，好几年了，不疼，是什么

en: Rectal tissue protrudes during defecation and retracts automatically in kids. Is it rectal prolapse?
zh: 娃大便干燥，用力时肛门脱出一圈肉，拉完自己回去，是不是脱肛

en: Others smell bad odor from kid's nose while he can't. Is it sinusitis?
zh: 娃的鼻子里总有臭味，自己闻不到，别人能闻到，是不是鼻窦炎

en: Painless raised yellow spot with blood vessels on sclera. Is it pinguecula?
zh: 我眼白上有黄斑，凸起，不疼，有血管，是不是睑裂斑

en: My kid scratches head in sleep leaving marks without rashes. Is it itchy scalp?
zh: 娃睡觉时爱抓头，抓出痕，头皮没有疹子，是不是头痒

en: Excessive daytime sleepiness with sufficient night sleep. Is it sleep apnea?
zh: 最近总打哈欠，白天昏昏欲睡，晚上睡够八小时，是不是睡眠呼吸暂停

en: My kid grinds teeth at night and can't concentrate in daytime. Does he have intestinal parasites?
zh: 娃睡觉磨牙，白天注意力不集中，是不是肚子里有虫

en: My kid grinds teeth loudly leading to masseter hypertrophy and tooth wear.
zh: 娃睡觉磨牙声音大，脸咬肌大，牙齿磨损，怎么办

en: Dark itchy moss-like thickened skin on my ankle. Is it neurodermatitis?
zh: 我脚踝处皮肤变黑，粗糙，像苔藓，痒，抓了更厚，是不是神经性皮炎

en: Persistent cicada-like tinnitus simply caused by poor sleep.
zh: 最近总是耳鸣，蝉鸣声，听力检查正常，是不是睡眠不好引起的

en: High resting heart rate rises sharply after movement. Is it tachycardia?
zh: 最近总是心慌，静坐时心跳90多，走两步就120，是不是心动过速

en: I feel pressing pain on both temples where my glasses rest. Are my glasses ill-fitted?
zh: 最近总感觉太阳穴两边压着疼，戴眼镜的地方疼，是不是眼镜不合适

en: Sweet potatoes stimulate excessive gastric acid secretion easily.
zh: 每次吃红薯就胃酸，烧心，是不是红薯太甜产酸

en: I get diarrhea after eating seafood occasionally. Is it due to stale seafood?
zh: 每次吃海鲜就腹泻，但不是每次都腹泻，是不是海鲜不新鲜

en: Cough with thick green phlegm without fever, bacterial infection.
zh: 娃咳嗽有痰，痰是绿色的，浓稠，不发烧，是不是细菌感染

en: Thick yellowish-green eye discharge sticks kid's eyes shut in the morning. Is it conjunctivitis?
zh: 娃早上起来眼屎多，粘住眼睛睁不开，黄绿色，是不是红眼病

en: My kid passes green loose stools twice a day in good spirits. Is it indigestion?
zh: 娃大便呈绿色，稀糊状，一天两次，精神好，是不是消化不良

en: Green tea causes stomachache while black tea does not. Is it tea polyphenol stimulation?
zh: 每次喝绿茶就胃疼，喝红茶没事，是不是茶多酚刺激

en: Painless dark toes without trauma, alert early diabetic foot.
zh: 我脚趾头发黑，不疼，没受伤，是不是糖尿病足

en: Cold intolerance and hair loss with normal thyroid function, check anemia.
zh: 最近总是怕冷，穿很多也冷，还掉头发，查甲功正常，是不是贫血

en: Small hole behind kid's ear discharges smelly white secretion. Is it congenital preauricular fistula?
zh: 娃耳朵后面有个小洞，挤出白色臭东西，是不是先天瘘管

en: Two movable painless lumps grow behind my kid’s ears for half a year. Lymphadenectasis?
zh: 孩子耳朵后面长了两个小包，能活动，不疼，发现半年了，是淋巴结肿大吗

en: Painless movable lump behind kid's ear found for a month. Need examination?
zh: 娃的耳朵后面有个包，能滑动，不疼，发现一个月了，要不要查

en: Itchy moist cracked ear skin with yellow scabs, recurrent ear eczema.
zh: 娃的耳朵后面有裂口，湿润，有黄色结痂，痒，是不是湿疹

en: Moist cracked skin with yellow scabs behind kid's earlobes. Is it eczema?
zh: 娃耳垂后面裂口子，潮湿，有黄色结痂，是不是湿疹

en: Painless hard small lump on kid's auricle.
zh: 娃的耳朵轮廓上有个小包，硬硬的，不疼，是什么

en: Tender red auricle without fever, auricular perichondritis.
zh: 娃的耳朵发红发热，一碰就疼，不发烧，是不是耳廓软骨膜炎

en: Hard earwax blocks my kid's ear canal causing poor hearing. How to clear it safely?
zh: 娃耳朵里有硬耳屎，堵住了，听不清，自己掏不出来，怎么办

en: Painful deep hard earwax in kids, professional removal methods.
zh: 娃的耳朵里有硬耳屎，自己掏不出来，还疼，怎么办

en: Hard earwax causes swelling after ear drops. How to deal with it?
zh: 娃耳朵里耳屎硬块，堵住了，听力下降，用碳酸氢钠滴了更胀，怎么办

en: Hard earwax in kids, is hospital ear irrigation painful?
zh: 娃的耳朵里有耵聍，硬块，自己掉不出来，去医院洗耳疼不疼

en: Night numbness in ring and little fingers. Is it nerve compression?
zh: 最近总感觉手麻，特别是晚上睡觉的时候，小拇指和无名指麻，是不是神经卡住了

en: Kid cries due to anal fissure bleeding caused by dry hard stools.
zh: 娃大便干结，拉屎时肛裂出血，每次拉屎都哭，怎么办

en: Epigastric discomfort and nausea after overeating, watch out for acute gastric dilatation.
zh: 每次吃撑了就心口窝疼，还恶心，是不是急性胃扩张

en: Chest stuffiness and acid regurgitation relieved by belching. Is it cardia relaxation?
zh: 每次吃太饱就胸口堵，感觉食物要返上来，打嗝后舒服，是不是贲门松弛

en: Slightly enlarged dull-pain lipoma just needs close observation.
zh: 我后背长了个脂肪瘤，最近长大了一点，还有点疼，是不是恶变

en: Smelly fluid oozes from kid's belly button. Patent urachus?
zh: 娃的肚脐眼流水，有臭味，周围皮肤不红，是不是脐尿管未闭

en: Tender red skin around kid's belly button, omphalitis symptoms.
zh: 娃总说肚脐眼疼，按压更疼，周围皮肤有点红，是不是脐炎

en: Red belly button with slight pus in kids. Omphalitis?
zh: 娃的肚脐眼发红，有少量脓性分泌物，是不是脐炎

en: Bulging belly button enlarges when crying and can be pushed back. Is it hernia?
zh: 孩子肚脐眼鼓出来一个包，哭的时候更大，按一下能回去，是疝气吗

en: My kid's belly button bulges when crying and retracts when calm. Is it umbilical hernia?
zh: 娃肚脐眼凸出，哭闹时变大，安静时变小，是不是脐疝

en: Bulging baby belly button aggravated by crying with bowel sounds, umbilical hernia.
zh: 娃的肚脐眼突出来，哭的时候更明显，按一下有咕噜声，是不是疝气

en: Safe cleaning methods for smelly dirty baby belly buttons.
zh: 娃的肚脐眼臭臭的，有黑色脏东西，能不能洗干净

en: Immovable painless hard lump on the back of wrist.
zh: 我手上长了个硬疙瘩，在手腕背侧，推不动，不疼，是什么

en: Painless soft lump behind kid's knee.
zh: 娃的膝盖后面长了个包，腿伸直时明显，按着软，不疼，是什么

en: Stiff waist difficult to straighten after bending to wash hair. Is it lumbar disease?
zh: 每次弯腰洗头后直不起腰，腰僵硬，过一会才好，是不是腰椎病

en: Severe snoring, night breath-holding and daytime lethargy in kids, surgery evaluation.
zh: 娃睡觉时打呼噜，有时候会憋醒，白天精神差，是不是要手术

en: Painless movable fleshy strip under kid's tongue.
zh: 娃的舌头下面长了个肉条，舔着能动，不疼，是什么

en: Stinging white tongue spot while eating, single oral ulcer.
zh: 娃的舌头上有个白点，疼，吃东西更疼，是不是口腔溃疡

en: Skipped heartbeat sensation detected as occasional premature beats on ECG.
zh: 最近总是心慌，感觉心跳停了一下，做心电图偶发早搏，是不是心脏病

en: Mouth corners get red, peeling and itchy after eating pineapple. Is it allergy?
zh: 每次吃菠萝嘴角就红，脱皮，痒，是不是过敏

en: Painless dry small pit above kid's gluteal cleft.
zh: 娃的屁股沟上面有个小坑，不疼不痒，没有渗液，是什么

en: Dark mosquito bite marks linger for a month on kid's skin. How to fade them?
zh: 娃脸上被蚊子咬的包，起水泡，破溃结痂，一个月了还有黑印，怎么去印

en: Dark mosquito bite marks left after blister scabbing on kid's face.
zh: 娃的脸上被蚊子咬后起水泡，破了结黄痂，留了黑印，怎么去印

en: Mosquito bites on kid's face develop blisters and yellow scabs. Is it infected?
zh: 娃脸上被蚊子咬后起水泡，结黄痂，是不是感染了

en: Mosquito bites cause big hard swollen lumps on my kid's face hard to fade. Is it severe allergy?
zh: 娃脸上被蚊子咬后起大包，红肿硬，几天不消，是不是过敏

en: Severe nocturnal anal itch with tiny white worms around kid's anus. Is it pinworm infection?
zh: 娃总说屁股痒，晚上更厉害，肛门周围有白色小线头，是不是蛲虫

en: My kid’s facial red birthmark gets bigger and bulgy. Will it fade naturally?
zh: 娃出生时脸上有个红色胎记，现在变大了还鼓起来，会不会自己消

en: My 5-year-old kid keeps biting nails even bleeding no matter how I persuade him. Is he zinc deficient?
zh: 娃五岁了还咬指甲，十个手指头都咬得光秃秃的，怎么说都没用，有时候还咬出血，是不是缺锌

en: My kid feels sore eyes and sheds tears after watching TV for a while. Is he nearsighted?
zh: 孩子老说眼睛酸，看电视一会儿就流泪，是不是近视了

en: Wide painful heel cracks affect walking. Is it fissured tinea pedis?

en: Three days after wisdom tooth extraction, still severe pain, can't open mouth, normal?
zh: 我拔了智齿三天，还是疼得厉害，嘴巴张不开，正常吗

en: Three days after extraction, still blood streaks, dry socket?
zh: 我拔了牙三天了，嘴里还有血丝，是不是干槽症

en: Tooth sore after filling, pain with cold water, not done well?
zh: 我补完牙之后牙齿一直酸，喝凉水疼，是没补好吗

en: Face swollen like pig after wisdom tooth extraction, normal? How long?
zh: 我拔了智齿后脸肿得像猪头，正常吗，要几天消

en: Tooth still painful after root canal, worse biting, not done well?
zh: 我做了根管治疗后牙还疼，咬东西更疼，是没做好吗

en: No period since abortion last month, normal?
zh: 我上个月做了人流，到现在没来月经，正常吗

en: Sex half month after abortion, infection risk?
zh: 我做完流产手术半个月，同房了，会不会感染

en: Abdominal cramping and bleeding 10 days after abortion, normal?
zh: 我做了人流术后第十天，肚子一阵阵疼，还有出血，正常吗

en: Two months after C-section, scar still painful, tugging inside
zh: 我做完剖腹产两个月，刀口还疼，里面扯着疼

en: After IVF transfer, bloated, normal?
zh: 我做了试管婴儿，移植后肚子胀，正常吗

en: Painless abortion day 3, no pain, brown discharge
zh: 我做了无痛人流，现在第三天肚子不疼了，但还有点褐色分泌物

en: Sad and tearful after miscarriage, normal?
zh: 我做了小产手术，现在情绪低落，动不动就哭，正常吗

en: Six months after C-section, scar sometimes itchy, deep pain
zh: 我做剖腹产半年了，刀口有时候还痒，里面疼

en: Brown discharge day 10 after IVF transfer, normal?
zh: 我做了试管婴儿，移植后第10天，有褐色分泌物，正常吗

en: Dad's left hand paralyzed after stroke, can recover?
zh: 我爸爸中风后左手一直不能动，还能恢复吗

en: Had heart stent, can I climb mountains? Precautions?
zh: 我做了心脏支架，能爬山吗，要注意什么

en: Dad speaks unclearly after stroke, can recover?
zh: 我爸爸中风后说话口齿不清，还能恢复吗

en: Dad walks in circles, foot drop after stroke, rehab helpful?
zh: 我爸爸中风后走路画圈，足下垂，康复有用吗

en: Dad speaks unclearly, chokes on water after stroke, can recover?
zh: 我爸爸中风后说话含糊，喝水呛，能恢复吗

en: Dad post-lung cancer surgery, dry cough, wound pain, normal?
zh: 我爸爸肺癌术后，一直干咳，伤口还疼，正常吗

en: Genital warts removed by laser, how long no recurrence cured?
zh: 我得了尖锐湿疣，激光打掉了，多久不复发算治愈

en: Edema like a float ring after circumcision, normal?
zh: 我做了包皮手术，现在水肿，像游泳圈，正常吗

en: One month after double eyelid surgery, still swollen, normal?
zh: 我做了双眼皮手术一个月，眼皮还肿，正常吗

en: Thread lift for double eyelid, thread exposed, what to do
zh: 我做了埋线双眼皮，现在线头露出来了，怎么办

en: Double eyelid surgery, eyes asymmetrical, can revise?
zh: 我做了双眼皮手术，两个眼睛不对称，还能修复吗

en: Pit after laser mole removal, will it flatten?
zh: 我做了激光去痣，结痂掉了以后有个坑，能长平吗

en: Red rash and itch after laser hair removal, allergy?
zh: 我做了激光脱毛后皮肤起红疹，痒，是过敏吗

en: Swollen under eyes one month after eye bag surgery, failed?
zh: 我做了去眼袋手术，眼睛下面一直肿，一个月了，是不是失败

en: Nasal bridge slightly crooked after rhinoplasty, need revision?
zh: 我做了隆鼻手术，鼻梁有点歪，要修复吗

en: Blisters after laser hair removal, what to do
zh: 我做了激光脱毛后皮肤起水泡，怎么办

en: Two weeks after appendectomy, wound still a bit painful, normal?
zh: 我做完阑尾炎手术半个月，伤口还有点疼，正常吗

en: One week after hemorrhoid surgery, blood in stool, normal?
zh: 我做了痔疮手术一周，大便带血，正常吗

en: Pain like knife cut during BM after hemorrhoid surgery, normal?
zh: 我做了痔疮手术，大便像刀割一样疼，正常吗

en: One year after appendectomy, still dull pain at scar
zh: 我做完阑尾炎手术一年了，刀口那个地方还隐隐疼

en: Have biopsy during gastroscopy, now bloated, normal?
zh: 我做完胃镜取了活检，现在肚子胀，正常吗

en: Pain like passing glass shards during BM after hemorrhoid surgery
zh: 我做了痔疮手术，现在每次大便都像拉玻璃碴子，疼得哭

en: Black stool for two days after gastric biopsy, normal?
zh: 我做胃镜取了活检后，黑便了两天，正常吗

en: Fell off bike, scraped knee, scabbed but hurts inside
zh: 我骑自行车摔了，膝盖破皮，现在结痂了但里面疼

en: Stomach uncomfortable after endoscopy, normal?
zh: 做完胃镜后肚子一直不舒服正常吗

en: Still painful after hemorrhoid surgery, how long normal?
zh: 做完痔疮手术一直疼正常多久好

en: Still having stomach pain after appendicitis surgery
zh: 做完阑尾炎手术后一直肚子疼正常吗

en: Eyelids still swollen one month after surgery, normal?
zh: 做完双眼皮一直肿一个月正常吗

en: Still slight bleeding after hemorrhoid surgery, normal?
zh: 做完痔疮手术后一直流一点血正常吗

en: It’s been two months after eyelid surgery and still swollen, failed maybe?
zh: 做完双眼皮都两个月了还是有点肿，会不会失败了啊

en: Two weeks after appendicitis surgery the wound still feels hard and painful
zh: 做完阑尾炎手术快两周了，刀口旁边还是硬硬的按着还有点疼正常吗

en: My left ankle swells for no reason easing in morning and worsening in afternoon. Poor kidney function?
zh: 我左脚脚踝无缘无故肿了，不红不疼，早上起来好点，下午又肿，是肾不好吗

en: Bloating after drinking milk improves with lactose-free milk. Is it lactose intolerance?
zh: 每次喝牛奶就腹胀，屁多，改喝零乳糖就好了，是不是乳糖不耐受

en: Butterfly-shaped facial erythema worsened by sun exposure without joint pain, rule out mild lupus erythematosus.
zh: 我脸上有红斑，像蝴蝶，日晒后加重，关节不疼，是不是红斑狼疮

en: I feel extremely sleepy right after meals. I suspect blood sugar problems but have no glucose meter at home.
zh: 吃完饭就像被催眠了一样困，眼皮都睁不开，怀疑是不是血糖有问题，家里没有血糖仪

en: Swollen painful big toe joint with normal uric acid, rule out gouty arthritis.
zh: 我脚上大拇指关节红肿，疼，查尿酸不高，是不是不是痛风

en: I gain weight easily even drinking water with stubborn belly fat. Is it endocrine disorder?
zh: 我属于喝水都长胖的那种，节食也瘦不下来，肚子上一圈肉，是不是内分泌失调了啊

en: I get random bruises and nosebleeds lately. Is my platelet count too low?
zh: 最近腿上出现淤青，没磕碰，轻轻按也青，还鼻出血，是不是血小板少

en: Fluid flows out of my ear after catching a cold with slight itchiness. Is it otitis media?
zh: 每次感冒后耳朵里就流水，不疼，有点痒，是不是中耳炎

en: Tinnitus persists after cold recovery. Is it otitis media?
zh: 每次感冒就耳鸣，感冒好了耳鸣还在，是不是中耳炎

en: Frequent nighttime urination without pain. Is it benign prostatic hyperplasia?
zh: 最近总想小便，夜里起夜三次，尿不疼，是不是前列腺增生

en: I have cicada-like tinnitus only in my left ear with normal hearing. Could it be brain tumor?
zh: 我左耳耳鸣像蝉叫，右耳没事，听力也正常，是不是脑瘤

en: My feet swell obviously in the afternoon with pitting edema. Is it heart problems?
zh: 最近脚肿，鞋子穿不进，按了有坑，早上轻下午重，是不是心脏不好

en: A painless rough white bump grows under my tongue and hasn’t faded for months.
zh: 舌头下面长了个白色的小包，不疼不痒，用舌头舔着感觉粗糙，好几个月了也没消

en: I always choke while eating and lose weight recently. Could there be esophageal growth?
zh: 我吃饭的时候老噎着，喝口水才能下去，最近瘦了，是不是食道长了东西

en: I even choke on water, especially when lying down. Is there a problem with my swallowing nerve?
zh: 我喝水都会被呛到，尤其是躺着喝，是不是吞咽神经有问题

en: I urinate frequently at night with unchanged water intake. Is it diabetes?
zh: 最近喝水量没变，但尿特别多，夜尿三四次，是不是糖尿病

en: I sweat heavily soaking clothes every night even with thin quilt. Is it early menopause?
zh: 最近每天晚上都出好多汗，睡衣湿透，枕头都有汗味，盖很薄也出，是不是更年期提前了

en: Restless sleeping and whimpering in kids. Is it intestinal flatulence?
zh: 娃睡觉不踏实，翻来覆去，还哼哼，是不是肠胀气

en: My urine smells like rotten apples. Is it diabetic ketosis?
zh: 最近发现小便有股烂苹果味，很甜，是不是糖尿病酮症

en: Urine splits with lasting foam online said to be proteinuria. Should I check kidney function?
zh: 小便的时候分叉，尿完还有泡沫，过一会泡沫也不散，网上说是蛋白尿，要去查个肾吗

en: Dry mouth, dry eyes and joint pain. Is it Sjögren's syndrome?
zh: 我嘴巴干，眼干，关节痛，是不是干燥综合征

en: I have rapid heartbeat and get breathless easily. Is it heart trouble or overweight?
zh: 最近总感觉心慌，心跳快，爬两层楼就喘，是不是心脏有问题还是太胖了

en: My sprained foot still aches after excessive walking two years later. Did the ligament tear?
zh: 我脚上崴伤两年了，走路多了还疼，不敢跑跳，是不是韧带断了

en: Recurrent acne on forehead and chin worsens before period. Is it endocrine disorder?
zh: 脸上痘痘反反复复，下巴和额头长，月经前加重，是不是内分泌失调

en: Throbbing left temple migraine with nausea during menstruation.
zh: 每次来月经就偏头痛，左边太阳穴跳痛，疼得想吐，怎么办

en: It’s three days after wisdom tooth extraction with severe wound pain and facial swelling. Is this normal?
zh: 拔完智齿已经三天了，伤口还是疼得厉害，半张脸肿着，吃布洛芬能顶四五个小时，正常吗

en: I get diarrhea after greasy food especially hot pot for years. Is it related to gallbladder removal?
zh: 吃完饭就拉肚子，特别是油腻的，吃火锅后必拉，好几年了，是不是胆囊切了的原因

en: I get random bruises on arms and legs without any collision. Is my platelet count too low?
zh: 身上不知道什么时候就青一块紫一块，腿上胳膊上都有，也没磕碰过，是不是血小板少了

en: There are quick-dissolving big bubbles in my urine. Is it proteinuria?
zh: 最近尿里有泡沫，大泡泡，很快消散，是不是蛋白尿

en: I lose weight rapidly with big appetite and fatigue lately. Is it diabetes?
zh: 最近突然瘦了，没刻意减肥，吃得还多，但没力气，是不是糖尿病

en: I lost 10 kilos unintentionally with frequent thirst recently. Is it diabetes?
zh: 最近瘦了好多，没刻意减肥，一个月掉了十斤，还总口渴，是不是糖尿病

en: Morning lumbodorsal stiffness relieved by movement. Ankylosing spondylitis?
zh: 最近总是腰背痛，晨起僵硬，活动后好转，是不是强直性脊柱炎

en: Kid sweats heavily on head with cold limbs in sleep. Is it spontaneous sweating?
zh: 娃睡觉时头上出汗，湿枕头，但手脚凉，是不是虚汗

en: I have strong pounding heartbeat more obvious when lying down. Is it palpitations?
zh: 总感觉心跳很重，咚哒咚哒，躺下时明显，是不是心悸

en: Unintentional weight loss, sweating, heat intolerance and irritability. Hyperthyroidism?
zh: 最近瘦了还多汗，怕热，脾气暴躁，心慌，是不是甲亢

en: My husband has been irritable, heat-intolerant and lost weight lately. Does he have hyperthyroidism?
zh: 老公最近脾气特别暴躁，还怕热，瘦了好多，是不是甲亢了

en: Losing weight with big appetite and frequent defecation. Is it hyperthyroidism?
zh: 最近掉体重，吃得多，大便次数多，是不是甲亢

en: I feel cold and weak easily even wearing thick clothes with normal blood test. Is it hypothyroidism?
zh: 最近怕冷，穿很多还冷，没力气，查了血常规正常，是不是甲减

en: Puffy face especially eyelids in the morning with normal urine test. Is it hypothyroidism?
zh: 最近脸肿，眼睑明显，晨起重，查尿正常，是不是甲减

en: My leg hair reduces suddenly accompanied by hair loss and cold intolerance. Is it thyroid disease?
zh: 我腿毛突然变少，还掉头发，怕冷，是不是甲状腺问题

en: There is a painless black vertical line all through my thumbnail. Should I remove it?
zh: 我大拇指指甲上有黑色竖线，从甲根到甲尖，不疼，要不要切掉

en: My husband snores loudly and sometimes stops breathing for seconds then gasps. I’m afraid he will suffocate.
zh: 我老公打呼噜震天响，有时候打着打着突然没声音了，过好几秒才喘一口气，我害怕他憋过去

en: My eyesight declines with blurred vision without pain. Is it cataract?
zh: 最近视力下降，看东西模糊，但不疼，是不是白内障

en: Waist soreness and lower abdominal distension worse around menstruation. Gynecological inflammation?
zh: 最近总是腰酸，月经前后更明显，肚子也坠胀，是不是妇科炎症

en: I have tenesmus feeling around anus. Is it proctitis?
zh: 总感觉肛门坠胀，想大便又拉不出，是不是直肠炎

en: My hands are numb after waking up relieved by shaking arms. I type all day, is it mouse hand or cervical spondylosis?
zh: 早晨睡醒手麻，有时候麻得动不了，甩甩胳膊就好一点，我工作是天天敲键盘，是鼠标手还是颈椎

en: I have dull pain under ribs worse after full meals. Is it cholecystitis?
zh: 我肋骨下面隐隐作痛，深呼吸好点，吃饱了更明显，是不是胆囊炎

en: Greasy food causes right upper abdominal pain radiating to the back and nausea. Is it cholecystitis?
zh: 最近吃油腻就右上腹痛，放射到后背，恶心，是不是胆囊炎

en: A certain spot on my left back hurts when taking deep breaths. Is it pleurisy?
zh: 我后背左边有个点，深呼吸时疼，按压不疼，是不是胸膜炎

en: Screen skin malignant lesion risk for itchy raised facial age spots in middle-aged and elderly people.
zh: 我脸上长了个老年斑一样的，凸起，发痒，是不是皮肤癌

en: Greasy diarrhea after eating braised pork. Gallbladder disorder?
zh: 每次吃红烧肉就拉肚子，油花花的，飘在水面，是不是胆囊有问题

en: Oily stool diarrhea after high-fat meals, poor fat absorption.
zh: 每次吃肥肉就腹泻，油花状大便，是不是脂肪泻

en: I lose lots of hair every wash and almost get bald. Mom says it’s postpartum alopecia but my kid is already two.
zh: 头发一把一把掉，洗头时排水口堵的都是头发，感觉头顶都快秃了，我妈说我产后脱发，可娃都两岁了

en: Stiff waist difficult to straighten after bending work, early lumbar disc herniation tendency.
zh: 最近总是腰痛，弯腰洗头直不起来，睡硬板床好点，是不是腰突

en: Bilateral waist soreness worsens after sitting long. Is it kidney deficiency?
zh: 最近腰两侧酸胀，久坐更明显，捶捶好点，是不是肾虚

en: Severe throat edema allergic reaction induced by peanuts.
zh: 每次吃花生就喉咙痒，呼吸困难，是不是严重过敏

en: Photophobia and watery eyes. Keratitis?
zh: 最近总是怕光，眼睛流泪，睁不开，是不是角膜炎

en: Periumbilical colic occurs while running and relieves after stopping.
zh: 每次跑完步就肚子疼，肚脐周围绞痛，停下来就好，是不是跑步岔气

en: My joints especially knees get swollen and painful after drinking alcohol. Is it gout?
zh: 每次喝酒后关节疼，尤其是膝盖，红肿，是不是痛风

en: I have incomplete defecation sensation lately. Is it proctitis?
zh: 最近总感觉肛门里有东西，排完便还想排，是不是直肠炎

en: I found my mouth crooked and left facial paralysis after waking up. Is it stroke?
zh: 早上起来刷牙发现嘴歪了，左边脸动不了，眼睛也闭不紧，吓得腿都软了，是不是中风了

en: Facial red streaks and patches turn red when hot. Is it lupus erythematosus?
zh: 我脸上有红血丝和红斑，遇热变红，是不是红斑狼疮

en: Unsteady gait dizziness caused by cervical disc herniation?
zh: 最近总是头晕，走路不稳，像踩棉花，查颈椎CT有突出，是不是这个引起的

en: I have increasing eye floaters plus flashes. Is retinal detachment coming?
zh: 我眼睛里有飞蚊，黑点飘来飘去，最近变多了，还有闪光感，是不是视网膜要脱落了

en: A fish bone stuck in my throat causes neck pain. How to deal with it?
zh: 我喉咙卡了鱼刺，吞饭喝醋都没用，现在觉得脖子疼，怎么办

en: Increased appetite with weight loss and hand tremors. Hyperthyroidism?
zh: 最近食欲大增，一顿吃两碗饭还饿，但体重下降，心慌手抖，是甲亢吗

en: A mole on my arm has grown bigger with irregular edges lately. Could it be melanoma?
zh: 手臂上长了个黑痣，最近长大了点，边缘不光滑，会不会是黑色素瘤

en: This report has many arrows, serious?
zh: 这个检查报告好多箭头严重吗

en: Many arrows on my report, serious or not?
zh: 我这个检查报告上好多箭头严重不

en: My physical report has many red marks and arrows, is it serious?
zh: 我这个体检报告好多红字和箭头，看得我特别慌是不是很严重啊

en: Doctor, my physical examination report says "thyroid nodule". Is this serious? Will it turn into cancer?
zh: 医生，我体检报告上写着“甲状腺结节”，这个严不严重啊？会不会变成癌？

en: Doctor, my physical examination report said that I have fatty liver. I usually don't drink alcohol. How could I get this disease?
zh: 医生，我体检报告说我有脂肪肝，我平时也不喝酒啊，怎么会得这个病？

en: Doctor, my physical examination report said that I have a thyroid nodule, TI-RADS Class 3. Is this serious? Do I need surgery to cut it off? Will it turn into cancer? I checked Baidu and was scared to death.
zh: 医生，我体检报告说我有甲状腺结节，TI-RADS 3类，这个严不严重啊？我需不需要做手术切掉？会不会变成癌啊？我查了百度吓死了。

en: Uric acid 540, no joint pain, need meds?
zh: 我化验单上尿酸540，但是没有关节疼，要吃药吗

en: CT says 4mm lung nodule, need removal?
zh: 我做了CT说肺上有小结节，4mm，要不要切

en: Physical exam says sinus arrhythmia, what does it mean, serious?
zh: 我体检说窦性心律不齐，是什么意思，严重吗

en: Occasional atrial premature beats on Holter, serious?
zh: 我最近老觉得心慌，做了24小时心电图，说是偶发房早，严重吗

en: Burning urination, red urethral meatus, high WBC in urine
zh: 我最近尿尿有烧灼感，尿道口红，尿常规白细胞高

en: Back lipoma for years, recently grew larger, need removal?
zh: 我后背有个脂肪瘤好几年了，最近变大了，要不要切

en: Doctor, my physical examination report said that I am positive for Helicobacter pylori. Will this be passed on to my family? Do you want to divide the dishes?
zh: 医生，我体检报告说我有幽门螺杆菌阳性，这个会不会传染给家里人？要不要分碗筷？

en: Many upward arrows on physical report, confused about recheck needs
zh: 拿到体检单子一堆箭头朝上，看不懂指标，不知道需不需要进一步查

en: Confused about eating supper the night before entry physical examination
zh: 预约好入职体检马上到时间，不清楚体检前一晚能不能正常吃夜宵

en: Light supper permission the night before institutional entry physical exam
zh: 事业单位入职体检项目多，体检前一晚能不能少量吃点清淡夜宵

en: Strict diet and medicine rules before helicobacter pylori recheck
zh: 准备做幽门螺杆菌复查，复查之前饮食和吃药都有哪些严格讲究

en: Preparations besides fasting for painless gastroscopy examination
zh: 打算去做胃镜无痛检查，检查之前除了空腹还有别的注意事项么

en: Preparations needed before hospital helicobacter pylori test
zh: 去医院做幽门螺杆菌检测之前，都需要提前做好哪些准备事项

en: Pre-examination preparations for helicobacter pylori detection
zh: 打算去医院做幽门螺杆菌筛查，去之前都需要提前做好哪些准备工作

en: Chest film shows thickened lung texture, confused about physical condition
zh: 拿到胸片报告单写着纹理增粗，完全不懂代表身体出现什么状况

en: Many abnormal values in blood routine report, need detailed explanation
zh: 拿到血常规化验单多项数值异常，完全看不懂啥意思求讲解

en: Just uncomfortable above belly button, can't describe, not pain
zh: 就是肚脐眼上面不舒服，说不上来，也不是疼

en: Lactation period with cold fever, normal breastfeeding feasibility 判断
zh: 感冒发烧处在哺乳期阶段，这种状态下还能不能正常给宝宝喂奶

en: Wind-heat sore throat during breastfeeding, fear medicine affects breast milk quality
zh: 产后处于母乳期风热感冒嗓子疼，不敢乱吃药害怕影响奶水质量

en: Elders feel sore crawling sensation in legs relieved by moving around at night.
zh: 老人晚上老说腿里面酸胀，像蚂蚁爬，必须活动一下才舒服，是啥病

en: Restless legs syndrome troubles me at night without iron deficiency found. Can it be cured?
zh: 我晚上睡觉腿不宁，必须动，不然难受，查了没缺铁，还能治吗

en: My hands crack painfully in winter and can't heal well with bandages.
zh: 我手上一到冬天就裂口子，好几个，疼，用创可贴粘住，但还是裂

en: I get diarrhea drinking pure milk but not yogurt. Is it lactose intolerance?
zh: 每次喝牛奶就拉肚子，喝酸奶没事，是不是乳糖不耐受

en: I have tender lumpy breasts before menstruation which fade afterwards. Is it mammary hyperplasia?
zh: 每次来月经前乳房胀痛，摸到颗粒感，月经后消失，是不是乳腺增生

en: Dizziness obvious when standing up with low blood pressure. Is it orthostatic hypotension?
zh: 最近头晕，站起来时明显，血压低，是不是体位性低血压

en: Can photorejuvenation improve both red veins and pigment spots?
zh: 我脸上有红血丝，还有色素斑，用光子嫩肤能一起做吗

en: Beer drinking causes joint pain especially big toe. Is it gout?
zh: 我喝完啤酒以后关节疼，尤其是大脚趾，是不是痛风

en: A retractable small lump protrudes from anus after defecation. Is it internal hemorrhoid?
zh: 每次大便后肛门脱出一个小肉球，能自己回去，是不是内痔

en: First aid for normal skin burn caused by glacial acetic acid treating onychomycosis.
zh: 我脚上灰指甲，用冰醋酸泡过，周围皮肤烂了，疼，怎么办

en: The corn on my foot turns black and painful after cryotherapy. Is it damaged?
zh: 我脚上长鸡眼，冷冻后变黑，疼，是不是冻坏了

en: Painful blood blister after corn cryotherapy.
zh: 我脚上长了鸡眼，冷冻后起了血泡，很疼，怎么办

en: I get itchy swollen chilblains on feet in cold weather. How to prevent it?
zh: 我脚上的冻疮，天冷就长，又红又肿，痒，怎么办预防

en: My lips are chapped and peeling worse after licking. Is it cheilitis?
zh: 我嘴唇干裂，脱皮，舔了更干，涂唇膏也没用，是不是唇炎

en: Painless sole peeling gets worse in summer. Is it asymptomatic athlete’s foot?
zh: 脚底板脱皮，不痒，就是一层一层掉皮，夏天更明显，是不是脚气不痒的那种

en: My kid cries while peeing with swollen private parts. Is it urinary tract infection?
zh: 娃小便时哭闹，小鸡鸡头红肿，尿道口红，是不是尿路感染

en: Painful foot wound after vinegar cauterization on plantar wart. Infected?
zh: 我脚上长了跖疣，用醋精烧过，现在一个大窟窿，疼，是不是感染了

en: Plantar warts still exist after three cryotherapy treatments.
zh: 我脚上瘊子，冷冻了三次还有，是不是没冻干净

en: Recurrent plantar warts after cryotherapy.
zh: 我脚上长了跖疣，用了冷冻，掉了又长，怎么办

en: I cut my hand with kitchen knife bleeding much. Do I need tetanus injection?
zh: 做饭时切菜不小心划了手，口子不算深但流了不少血，菜刀是铁的，需要去医院打破伤风吗

en: I injured my ear digging earwax with yellow smelly discharge and dull pain. Is it otitis?
zh: 挖耳朵挖狠了，现在耳朵里流黄水，有点腥臭味，还隐隐作痛，是不是耳朵发炎了

en: A painful pimple grows inside my ear. Is it external auditory furuncle?
zh: 我耳朵里长了个痘痘，一碰就疼，是不是外耳道疖肿

en: Leg cramps at night don't improve with calcium tablets. Is it caused by cold?
zh: 最近晚上睡觉腿抽筋，吃了钙片没用，是不是受凉

en: Toe cramps occur frequently at night unrelieved by calcium tablets.
zh: 我脚趾头老是抽筋，特别是晚上，揉一下就好，是不是缺钙，但吃钙片没用

en: My hair is dry and split-ended, worse after perm and dye. No conditioner works. Is it protein deficiency?
zh: 最近头发干枯分叉，染烫后更糟，用什么护发素都没用，是不是蛋白质缺乏

en: Several tender hard lumps grow on my back head with red scalp. Is it folliculitis?
zh: 我后脑勺长了几个硬疙瘩，按着会疼，头皮还发红，是不是毛囊炎

en: Many painful pimples with yellow scabs grow on my scalp lately. Is it seborrheic dermatitis?
zh: 最近头皮上长了好多痘痘，梳头碰到就疼，会结黄痂，是不是脂溢性皮炎

en: Recurrent painful pus-filled red bumps grow on my husband’s scalp. Is it folliculitis?
zh: 老公头上长了好多红疙瘩，会出脓，疼，好了留疤，反反复复，是不是毛囊炎

en: Hard rough warts with black dots on kid's hands. Is it common wart?
zh: 娃手上长了个猴子，硬硬的，表面粗糙，有黑点，是不是寻常疣

en: I have constant urinary urge with little output and no pain. Is it overactive bladder?
zh: 总感觉有尿意，刚尿完又想尿，但是尿不多，也不疼，是膀胱过动症吗

en: Painful lump at ring finger base when bending. Tenosynovitis?
zh: 我手上长了个硬包，在无名指根部，弯曲手指时疼，是不是腱鞘炎

en: Pus oozes from my toenail gap with pain caused by ingrown nail. Is it paronychia?
zh: 我脚趾甲缝里流脓，疼，指甲嵌到肉里，是不是甲沟炎

en: Recurrent ingrown toenail unresponsive to simple nail extraction, need nail bed plasty.
zh: 我脚趾甲嵌甲，拔过甲，又长出来了，还是嵌，是不是没做甲床成形术

en: Protruding hemorrhoid can’t retract naturally now causing severe pain. Need surgery?
zh: 痔疮掉出来一个肉球，以前能自己缩回去，现在塞不回去了，卡在外面疼得走不了路，是不是要手术

en: I always feel foreign bodies in eyes with clear vision. Is it dry eye syndrome?
zh: 总感觉眼睛里有东西，揉也不出来，看东西不模糊，是不是干眼症

en: I have dry eyes, photophobia and lacrimation lately. Is it dry eye syndrome?
zh: 最近总感觉眼睛干涩，怕光，流泪，是不是干眼症

en: Laxative-dependent constipation.
zh: 最近总是便秘，用了开塞露才拉，不用就不拉，是不是依赖了

en: I have sore throat and hoarse voice without cough. Is it vocal cord inflammation?
zh: 我嗓子疼，声音嘶哑，说话费劲，不咳嗽，是不是声带炎

en: I sprained my ankle with cracking sound swollen and bruised. Should I apply hot or cold compress?
zh: 打球的时候脚崴了，当时听见‘咔’一声，现在肿得像个馒头，发紫了，能用热水泡吗还是冷敷

en: Swollen hot stiff knee without injury. Is it gout?
zh: 我膝盖红肿热痛，不能弯曲，没有受伤，是不是痛风

en: The skin around my nails is red, swollen and painful. Is it paronychia?
zh: 我指甲边缘皮肤发红疼痛，肿起来，是不是甲沟炎

en: Spicy food causes burning anal pain and slight bleeding. Is hemorrhoids flaring up?
zh: 吃辣后屁股火辣辣的疼，大便后纸上有点血，是不是痔疮犯了

en: Barbecue caused severe midnight acid reflux rising to throat, soda biscuits don’t help.
zh: 昨天晚上跟朋友吃了顿烧烤，半夜胃就开始反酸烧心，喉咙里酸水往上涌，吃了苏打饼干也没用

en: Conditioning for intractable bloating constipation unresponsive to common laxative foods.
zh: 最近总是便秘，吃香蕉喝蜂蜜水都没用，肚子胀，怎么办

en: Multiple bean-sized painless neck lymph nodes. Is it lymphoma?
zh: 我脖子上淋巴结肿大，不疼，像黄豆大小，好几个，是不是淋巴瘤

en: I’ve had athlete’s foot for years recurring in summer with itchy oozing toes. Daktarin only works temporarily. Need radical cure.
zh: 脚气好几年了，一到夏天就复发，脚趾缝烂得流水，痒得受不了，用过达克宁好一阵又回来，求断根方法

en: Recurrent inflammatory acne on jaw-neck area, core cause is endocrine disorder.
zh: 我脸上长痘，在下巴和脖子交界处，反反复复，是不是内分泌失调

en: Amoxicillin cured my sore throat but caused frequent diarrhea. Is it antibiotic side effect?
zh: 吃了阿莫西林一周，嗓子是不疼了，但是开始拉肚子，一天拉三四次，是不是抗生素吃坏了

en: Anti-allergy drugs work but cause drowsiness. Are there non-drowsy anti-allergy medicines?
zh: 吃抗过敏药就不痒了，但是困得不行，上班老打瞌睡被领导说，有没有不犯困的抗过敏药

en: My big toe leans towards the second toe causing shoe rub calluses. Is it hallux valgus and how to correct it?
zh: 我脚上大脚趾往二脚趾那边偏，穿鞋磨出茧子，是不是拇外翻，怎么矫正

en: Painful palm lump limiting finger movement. Palmar fascial contracture?
zh: 我手上有个硬疙瘩，在掌心，按着疼，手指活动受限，是不是掌腱膜挛缩

en: I have coin-sized painless alopecia areata. Can it heal naturally?
zh: 最近掉头发，斑秃一块硬币大小，不疼不痒，能不能自己好

en: Age-spot-like spots grow on my hands at the age of 30. Are they caused by sun exposure?
zh: 我手背上长老年斑一样的东西，才30岁，是晒的吗

en: Sun-induced brown facial spots can’t be faded by essence. Any effective ways?
zh: 我脸上晒太阳后长斑，褐色一块一块，用淡斑精华没用，有什么办法

en: Slightly enlarged painless raised red nevus on face.
zh: 我脸上长了个红痣，凸起，不疼不痒，最近变大了点，是什么

en: My leg hair grows inward with red hair follicles worse after shaving.
zh: 我腿上汗毛倒长，毛囊红红的，剃毛后更严重，怎么办

en: I have facial red blood streaks getting worse when hot. Is it rosacea?
zh: 脸上有红血丝，遇热更红，不敢用护肤品，是不是玫瑰痤疮

en: Damaged surrounding skin while corn still exists after salicylic acid patch use.
zh: 我脚上长了鸡眼，用了水杨酸贴，周围皮肤烂了，鸡眼还在，怎么办

en: Painless whitened corn after salicylic acid plaster application, healing sign.
zh: 我脚上长了鸡眼，贴了水杨酸膏贴，变白了，不疼了，是不是好了

en: Itchy transparent blisters grow on my fingers every summer, oozing fluid and peeling later.
zh: 我手指上长小水泡，透明，痒，破了出水，然后脱皮，每年夏天发作

en: Severely itchy hidden hand and foot blisters prevalent in summer, pompholyx.
zh: 我手上有水泡，深在，不破，特别痒，天热加重，是不是汗疱疹

en: Itchy hidden blisters break out on my hands every summer.
zh: 我手上长水泡，夏季发作，深在性小水泡，不破，很痒，是什么

en: Recurrent seasonal itchy blistering and peeling on hands and feet in summer.
zh: 我手上皮肤起小水泡，痒，挤破出水，然后脱皮，每年夏天都这样

en: Painless multiple yellowish bumps under lower eyelids.
zh: 我下眼皮长了黄白色的疙瘩，不疼不痒，好几个，是什么

en: My nose is completely stuffed up so I have to breathe through my mouth, making my lips dry. Nasal spray hasn’t worked for two days. I’m so worried.
zh: 鼻子堵得死死的，只能用嘴喘气，嘴唇都干了，喷了两天那个什么鼻通喷雾也没用，急死我了

en: I have terrible dandruff even right after washing hair with itchy scalp. Many anti-dandruff shampoos don’t work.
zh: 头皮屑多得吓人，刚洗过头吹干就能看见雪花，还痒，换了好几种去屑洗发水都没用

en: Facial allergy recurs soon after stopping ointment treatment. Is it hormone dependence?
zh: 最近脸过敏了，红痒肿，用了药膏好了，停了一周又复发，是不是激素依赖

en: Red acne marks on my face won't fade easily. Am I scar-prone?
zh: 我脸上痘印发红，很久不消，是不是疤痕体质

en: My eyes get swollen, painful and discharge more after staying up late. Is it conjunctivitis?
zh: 每次熬夜后眼睛就红肿，疼，分泌物多，是不是结膜炎

en: Cold food triggers temporary toothache. Is it tooth decay?
zh: 最近吃冰棍就牙疼，过一会不疼，是不是蛀牙了

en: My teeth ache badly drinking icy water or cold wind. No black spots seen, could it be tooth decay?
zh: 一喝冰水牙就酸得不行，吸口凉风也酸，右边下面那几颗牙，是不是蛀牙了，但看着没黑点

en: Cold food triggers dentin hypersensitivity leading to sore weak teeth.
zh: 每次吃冰棍就牙酸，牙齿好像酸倒了，是不是牙齿敏感

en: My thumb base aches with locking movement and clicking sound. What disease is this?
zh: 我大拇指根部疼，弯曲的时候会卡住，用力掰一下就‘咔哒’一声响，然后就好了，这是啥病

en: Clicking stiff fingers improve after movement in the morning. Is it trigger finger?
zh: 我手指弯曲弹响，早晨僵硬，活动后好转，是不是扳机指

en: Facial red veins and papules relieved partially by metronidazole gel.
zh: 我脸上有红血丝，还有丘疹，用了甲硝唑凝胶好一点，但还是红

en: My face is always red without itchiness worse when excited. Is it rosacea?
zh: 我脸上总是红红的，像过敏，但是不痒，一激动更红，是不是玫瑰痤疮

en: My big toenail turns yellow thick and crumbly spreading to other toes. Is it contagious onychomycosis?
zh: 大脚趾指甲变黄变厚，还掉渣，旁边的小脚趾也开始了，是不是灰指甲，会不会传染给家人

en: My calves cramp severely at night waking me up twice sometimes, without heavy exercise in daytime.
zh: 最近夜里老是小腿抽筋，疼得我从睡梦中大叫，有时候一晚抽两次，白天也没剧烈运动啊

en: I ate super spicy hot pot yesterday, and got acid reflux at midnight with stuff rising to my throat. It gets worse lying down. What can ease it?
zh: 昨天吃了个超辣的重庆火锅，半夜胃就开始反酸，感觉有东西顶到嗓子眼，躺下更严重，吃啥能压下去

en: My fingers peel severely even affecting fingerprint check. It starts with tiny blisters then peels off, painless but looks scary.
zh: 手指头脱皮脱得厉害，指纹打卡都打不上，先是小水泡然后爆皮，不疼但是看着好吓人

en: Poor effect after 2 microneedling sessions for acne pits. Need more treatment?
zh: 我脸上有痘坑，用了微针两次，效果不明显，是不是还要做

en: My T-zone is extremely oily with enlarged pores and recurring blackheads.
zh: 我脸上T区油得能炒菜，毛孔粗大，黑头挤了又长，用什么洗面奶都没用，好烦

en: Raised red acne scars. Keloid?
zh: 我脸上有痤疮疤痕，凸起的，红色，是不是疤痕疙瘩

en: I keep getting big red pimples on my face that leave dark marks after healing. What cream can fade the marks?
zh: 我脸上反复长那种又红又大的痘痘，好了留黑印，涂什么能去印

en: A hard painful big pimple grows beside my nose with large red area, can’t squeeze it. What to do?
zh: 脸上长了个又硬又疼的大痘痘，在鼻子旁边，挤不出东西，也不敢挤，红了一大片，怎么办

en: Keloid partially flattened still itchy after 3 steroid injections.
zh: 我手上有个疤痕疙瘩，打了三次激素针，平了一些但还是痒，还要打吗

en: A hard lump grows on my sole causing walking pain. Corn plaster doesn’t work. Is it plantar wart?
zh: 脚底板前掌长了个硬疙瘩，像鸡眼又不像，走路硌得疼，贴了鸡眼膏也没掉，是不是跖疣

en: I can't get rid of blackheads on my face and smelly white substance squeezes out of pores.
zh: 我脸上黑头挤不完，毛孔里挤出白色软条，还有臭味，是什么东西

en: I get pimples that secrete smelly white substance, and my pores keep enlarging. What should I do?
zh: 我脸上长痘，挤出来是白色长条，有臭味，毛孔越来越大，怎么办

en: Advanced care for deep intractable heel cracks ineffective by common urea ointment.
zh: 我脚后跟干裂，很深的口子，走路出血，用过尿素膏还是裂，怎么办

en: My husband has deep painful heel cracks which can’t be relieved by petrolatum.
zh: 老公脚后跟干裂得厉害，口子很深，走路都疼，涂了凡士林也不管用，怎么办

en: I grind teeth at night leading to sore cheeks and worn teeth.
zh: 我睡觉磨牙，早起腮帮子酸，牙齿也磨平了，怎么办好

en: There are stubborn milia around my eyes. Are they caused by greasy skin care products?
zh: 我脸上长脂肪粒，眼周白色小颗粒，挑不掉，是不是护肤品太油

en: Removal methods for hard white milia around eyes.
zh: 我脸上有那种很小很小的白色颗粒，挤出来是硬的，在眼周，怎么去掉

en: A transparent blister on eye white causes foreign body sensation.
zh: 我眼白上长了个透明小泡，不疼不痒，磨眼睛，是什么

en: Peeling and redness after tretinoin use, normal fading reaction of flat warts.
zh: 我手上扁平疣，用了维A酸软膏，脱皮发红，是不是好转反应

en: Hard earwax blocks kid's ear canal causing hearing loss.
zh: 娃耳朵里耵聍硬块，堵死了，听力下降，自己掏不了，怎么办

en: Itchy clear-edged rashes grow on my inner thighs worse in summer. Is it tinea cruris?
zh: 我大腿根部有红疹，痒，边缘清晰，夏天加重，是不是股癣

en: My inner thighs get dark and itchy. Is it tinea cruris and what medicine to use?
zh: 我大腿内侧磨得发黑，还痒，夏天穿短裤很丑，是不是股癣，涂什么药

en: Painless ring-shaped raised red patches on kid's inner thighs.
zh: 娃大腿内侧有红斑，环状，边缘凸起，不疼不痒，是什么

en: I have dry cough worse when lying down at night which eases sitting up. Is it gastroesophageal reflux?
zh: 最近一到晚上就咳嗽，干咳无痰，躺下更厉害，坐起来好点，是不是胃反流

en: I have chest pain and heartburn after meals, worse lying down and better sitting up. Is it esophagitis?
zh: 吃完饭胸口疼，烧心，躺下更重，坐着就好，是不是食管炎

en: Reflux recurs after stopping omeprazole.
zh: 最近总是反酸，烧心，吃饭后躺下更重，吃了奥美拉唑好了，停药就犯

en: Central chest burning sensation worsens after meals relieved by stomach medicine. Is it reflux esophagitis?
zh: 最近胸口正中烧灼感，饭后加重，吃胃药缓解，是不是反流性食管炎

en: Many acne-like pus-filled red pimples grow on my back. Is it folliculitis?
zh: 我后背长了好多红疙瘩，像青春痘，有的有脓头，是不是毛囊炎

en: Shin pain feels like bone cracking while running. Is it periostitis?
zh: 每次跑步时小腿前面疼，像骨头裂开，停下就好，是不是骨膜炎

en: Treatment for painful multiple plantar hyperkeratosis.
