en: Kiwi fruit causes throat itch and rashes. Food allergy?
zh: 每次吃猕猴桃就喉咙痒，起疹子，是不是过敏

en: Single toenail onychomycosis. Is topical medicine effective?
zh: 我脚上灰指甲，只有一个脚趾，吃药怕伤肝，涂药有用吗

en: I have constant cicada-like tinnitus worse at night causing insomnia. Is there no cure for neurological tinnitus?
zh: 耳朵里总有嗡嗡声，像知了叫，晚上安静的时候特别明显，搞得我失眠，看过说神经性耳鸣，没得治吗

en: I have general body soreness without fever lately. Is it post-influenza symptom?
zh: 最近总觉得浑身酸痛，像被人打了，查了没发烧，是不是流感后遗症

en: High-pitched tinnitus obvious at night with normal hearing.
zh: 最近总是耳鸣，高音调，晚上安静时明显，听力正常，怎么办

en: I get acne, breast distension and bad mood before menstruation. Is it hormone fluctuation?
zh: 每次大姨妈来之前就长痘，胸也胀，脾气大，是不是激素波动

en: My anal area itches worse at night with thickened pale skin. Is it pinworm infection?
zh: 最近肛门周围痒，晚上更痒，肛周皮肤变白增厚，是不是蛲虫

en: My skin stings and gets rashes when hot from hot food, sunshine or exercise, which fades in an hour.
zh: 身上一热就刺痒，比如吃饭烫的、晒太阳、运动后，皮肤就会起一片片的红，过一小时又自己消了

en: Exercise triggers temporary itchy wheals all over body. Is it exercise-induced urticaria?
zh: 每次运动后身上就痒，起小风团，但一会就消，是不是运动性荨麻疹

en: Painless protruding sternum in the middle of chest. Is it pigeon chest?
zh: 我胸口正中间骨头凸起，像个小山包，不疼，是不是鸡胸

en: I get transient stabbing pain on left chest many times a day. Doctors say it’s just anxiety.
zh: 左边胸口偶尔会像针扎一样刺痛一下，就一两秒，一天好几次，去医院查心电没事，医生说我太焦虑

en: I have frequent loose stools especially in the morning. Is it irritable bowel syndrome?
zh: 最近老想上厕所，大便不成型，早上起来就要拉，是不是肠易激

en: Wheals after eating shrimp without diarrhea. Mild allergy?
zh: 每次吃虾就起风团，但不腹泻，是不是轻度过敏

en: General itching and rashes after eating crabs. Seafood allergy?
zh: 每次吃螃蟹就全身痒，起红疹，是不是海鲜过敏

en: My memory gets really bad lately, always forgetting things. Could it be early Alzheimer’s?
zh: 最近记性差得要命，出门忘了带手机，到公司忘了带工卡，还经常想不起来要说啥，不会是老年痴呆吧

en: Extremely poor memory lately. Could it be brain tumor?
zh: 最近记忆力差到离谱，一句话说完就忘，刚做的事不记得，是不是脑瘤

en: I have severe memory loss lately. Could it be brain atrophy?
zh: 最近老忘事，刚放下的钥匙就找不着，还经常想不起熟人的名字，是不是脑萎缩了

en: Spicy food causes stomachache and diarrhea which relieves after defecation. Is it irritable bowel syndrome?
zh: 每次吃辣就拉肚子，肚子疼，拉完就好，是不是肠易激

en: Intestinal gurgling and diarrhea after spicy food, typical irritable bowel syndrome manifestation.
zh: 每次吃辣就拉肚子，肚子咕噜叫，是不是肠易激综合征

en: I feel short of breath relieved by deep breathing with normal lung function. Is it anxiety?
zh: 总感觉气上不来，深吸一口气才舒服，做了肺功能正常，是不是焦虑

en: Anger causes chest tightness, breathlessness and numb limbs. Is it heart trouble?
zh: 每次生气后胸口堵，喘不上气，手脚发麻，是不是心脏问题

en: I ate mango at noon and got swollen numb lips plus facial rashes in the afternoon. Can I never eat mango again?
zh: 中午吃了个芒果，下午嘴唇就肿了起来，还有点发麻，脸上也起了疹子，是不是以后都不能碰芒果了

en: My face and neck turn red plus rapid heartbeat after drinking little alcohol. Does it mean poor liver function?
zh: 我一喝酒就脸红，喝一小口就红到脖子根，心跳还加速，他们说这是肝不好，真的吗

en: Abdominal pain plus wheals after eating eggs, confirmed specific egg allergy.
zh: 每次吃鸡蛋就肚子疼，起荨麻疹，是不是鸡蛋过敏

en: A few drops of nosebleed when kid sneezes. Is it serious?
zh: 娃打喷嚏时喷出鼻血，就几滴，不是很多，要不要紧

en: Kid blinks often, says eyes itchy, tic disorder?
zh: 我孩子老眨眼睛，说眼睛痒，是不是抽动症

en: Kid grinds teeth loudly at night, roundworms?
zh: 我孩子睡觉磨牙咯咯响，是不是有蛔虫

en: Always thirsty lately, drink 5L water per day, diabetes insipidus?
zh: 我最近总是口渴，一天喝5升水，是不是尿崩症

en: Drink lots of water daily still dry mouth, blood sugar normal
zh: 我每天喝很多水还是觉得口干，查过血糖正常

en: Husband has bad breath he can't smell, stomach or mouth?
zh: 我觉得我老公有口臭，他自己闻不到，是胃还是口腔

en: Very cold intolerant, others in short sleeves, hypothyroidism?
zh: 我最近特别怕冷，别人穿短袖我穿外套，是甲减吗

en: Drink lots of water but chapped lips, vitamin B deficiency?
zh: 我每天喝很多水，但嘴唇还是干裂，是不是缺维生素B

en: Mouth ulcer day after hotpot, heatiness?
zh: 我每次吃火锅第二天就嘴巴里溃疡，是不是上火

en: Drink 2 cups coffee daily, recent palpitations, coffee related?
zh: 我每天喝两杯咖啡，最近心慌，是不是咖啡的原因

en: Acne recurring on face, many skincare products useless, is it hormonal
zh: 脸上长痘反反复复，用了很多护肤品没用，是不是内分泌

en: Lip blisters after BBQ, canker sore or herpes?
zh: 我吃了烧烤后嘴唇起泡，是上火还是疱疹

en: Face very oily, shines by afternoon, hormonal imbalance?
zh: 我最近脸好油，下午就反光，是不是内分泌失调

en: Lose clumps of hair after wash, nearly bald, shampoo?
zh: 我每次洗完头掉一大把，都快秃了，是不是洗发水问题

en: Callus on sole with black dot in center, corn or wart?
zh: 我脚底有个老茧，中间有个黑点，是鸡眼还是跖疣

en: Lost 10 jin unintentionally, eat more but lose weight, hyperthyroidism?
zh: 我最近瘦了10斤，没刻意减肥，吃得多还瘦，是甲亢吗

en: Always super tired after eating noodles, blood sugar issue?
zh: 我每次吃完面条就困得不行，是不是血糖有问题

en: Diarrhea after drinking milk, lactose intolerant? Can't drink ever?
zh: 我喝牛奶就拉肚子，是不是乳糖不耐受，以后都不能喝了吗

en: Stomach pain after eating two persimmons today, bezoar?
zh: 我今天吃了两个柿子后胃疼，是不是结石了

en: Bitter taste in mouth, especially morning, gallbladder issue?
zh: 我嘴里发苦，特别是早上起来，是胆有问题吗

en: Diarrhea every time after hotpot, IBS?
zh: 我每次吃完火锅就拉肚子，是不是肠易激综合征

en: Stomach pain after raw peanuts, never before, bad peanuts or gastric?
zh: 我吃了生花生后胃疼，以前不会，是花生坏了还是胃病

en: Stomach pain day after spicy food, gastric ulcer?
zh: 我每次吃辣的第二天就胃疼，是不是胃溃疡

en: Bitter taste in mouth, meds no help, gallbladder polyp?
zh: 我最近总觉得嘴苦，吃药没用，是不是胆囊息肉

en: Stomach pain after eating raw fish, parasite?
zh: 我吃了生鱼片后肚子疼，是寄生虫吗

en: Stomach pain after milk but fine with yogurt, strange
zh: 我每次喝牛奶就肚子疼，但喝酸奶没事，奇怪

en: Diarrhea after greasy food, gallbladder removed?
zh: 我每次吃油腻的东西就拉肚子，是不是胆囊切除了

en: Diarrhea after watermelon, bad melon or weak spleen?
zh: 我吃了西瓜后拉肚子，是西瓜坏了还是我脾胃虚

en: Acid reflux after chives, heartburn, chives bad for stomach?
zh: 我吃了韭菜后胃反酸，烧心，是韭菜伤胃吗

en: Acid reflux after banana, too sweet?
zh: 我每次吃香蕉就胃酸，是香蕉太甜了吗

en: Bloating after noodles, fine with rice, gluten allergy?
zh: 我每次吃面条就胃胀，打嗝，换米饭就没事，是麸质过敏吗

en: Diarrhea and stomach pain after watermelon, from being iced?
zh: 我吃了西瓜后拉肚子，肚子疼，是冰镇的原因吗

en: Sleep on stomach, wake up with neck pain, wrong pillow?
zh: 我睡觉爱趴着睡，醒来脖子疼，是不是枕头不合适

en: Itching down there, discharge like tofu, is it yeast infection, what med
zh: 下面有点痒，白带像豆腐渣，是不是霉菌感染，用什么药

en: My 1.5-year-old baby has coughed for days, can't sleep at night
zh: 宝宝一岁半，咳嗽好几天了，晚上咳得睡不了觉

en: Kid has red rash, itchy, fever 39°C, is it roseola
zh: 孩子身上起了红疹子，痒，发烧39度，是不是幼儿急疹

en: Baby has green poop with curds, mixed feeding, is that normal
zh: 宝宝拉绿色大便，有奶瓣，混合喂养，正常吗

en: My 4-month-old refuses milk, cries when feeding, what's up
zh: 我宝宝四个月，不爱吃奶，一吃就哭，怎么回事

en: Daughter 4, says ear pain, had fever 38.5 last night, otitis media?
zh: 我女儿4岁，说耳朵疼，昨晚还发烧38.5，是中耳炎吗

en: Baby has yellowish dandruff-like stuff on head, what is it
zh: 我宝宝头上长了像头皮屑一样的东西，黄黄的，是啥

en: Baby cries at night, inconsolable, belly gurgling, colic?
zh: 我宝宝夜里哭闹，怎么哄都不行，肚子咕噜响，是肠绞痛吗

en: Kid's lips turn purple when crying, fine otherwise, heart problem?
zh: 我孩子一哭就嘴唇发紫，平时没事，心脏有问题吗

en: Baby fever 39°C, cold hands and feet but hot head, what's up
zh: 我宝宝发烧39度，手脚冰凉，但是头烫，怎么回事啊

en: Baby shakes head at night, bald ring at back
zh: 我宝宝晚上睡觉总摇头，后脑勺都秃了一圈

en: Kid says leg pain at night, fine during day
zh: 我家小孩最近老说腿疼，特别是晚上，白天活蹦乱跳

en: Daughter's chapped bleeding lips, constant licking, vitamin deficiency?
zh: 我女儿嘴唇干裂出血，一直舔，是不是缺维生素

en: Kid rubs nose says inside itchy, allergic rhinitis?
zh: 我孩子一直揉鼻子，说鼻子里面痒，是不是过敏性鼻炎

en: Daughter 8, genital itching, yellow discharge, precocious puberty?
zh: 我女儿8岁，说私处痒，有黄色分泌物，是不是性早熟

en: Baby teething fever 38°C, drooling, need meds?
zh: 我宝宝长牙发烧38度，流口水，需要吃药吗

en: Baby 2 months, no poop for 3 days, smelly farts, normal?
zh: 我宝宝两个多月，三天没拉屎，放屁很臭，正常吗

en: Baby has soft lump on head since birth, will it go away?
zh: 我宝宝头上有个软软的包，出生就有，会不会消

en: Kid coughed nearly a month, fine daytime, cough when lying down
zh: 我家孩子咳嗽快一个月了，白天不咳，晚上一躺下就咳

en: Baby rib flaring, calcium deficiency? Need supplement?
zh: 我宝宝肋骨外翻，是不是缺钙，要不要补

en: Bald patch on kid's scalp smooth, alopecia areata?
zh: 我孩子头皮上有一块没头发，光滑的，是斑秃吗

en: White patch at baby's mouth corner won't wipe off
zh: 我宝宝嘴角有白斑，像奶渍擦不掉，是什么

en: Kid walks with pigeon toes, need correction?
zh: 我孩子走路内八字，需要矫正吗

en: Baby startles easily in sleep, limbs twitch, normal?
zh: 我宝宝睡觉总是一惊一惊的，手脚抖动，正常吗

en: Kid 3 years old, can't speak full sentences, language delay?
zh: 我孩子三岁了还不会说完整的句子，是不是语言发育迟缓

en: Rash after fever in child, not itchy, roseola?
zh: 我孩子发烧后身上出了红疹，不痒，是幼儿急疹吗

en: Baby 7 months, frothy sour poop, eating less
zh: 我宝宝七个月，拉粑粑有沫沫，酸臭味，吃奶也少了

en: Kid has movable painless lymph node at back of head
zh: 我家孩子后脑勺有个淋巴结，能摸到，活动好，不疼

en: Baby recently dry heaves, sometimes vomits milk, indigestion?
zh: 我宝宝最近老是干呕，有时候吐奶，是消化不良吗

en: Baby stool has mucus like snot, 5-6 times a day
zh: 我宝宝大便有黏液，像鼻涕一样，一天拉五六次

en: Kid rubs nose and sneezes, worse in morning
zh: 我孩子老是揉鼻子，还打喷嚏，早上起来尤其严重

en: Baby bald at back, shakes head sleeping, calcium deficiency?
zh: 我宝宝枕秃，后面没头发，睡觉爱摇头，缺钙吗

en: Kid tilts head when watching TV, torticollis?
zh: 我孩子看电视老歪头，是不是斜颈

en: Baby fontanelle not closed at 1.5 years, calcium deficiency?
zh: 我宝宝囟门还没闭合，一岁半了，是不是缺钙

en: Kid holds breath when crying, face purple, then stops, breath-holding spell?
zh: 我孩子一哭就憋气，脸发紫，然后就不哭了，是屏气发作吗

en: Baby 3 months, still can't hold head steady when upright, developmental delay?
zh: 我宝宝三个月，竖抱时头还抬不稳，是不是发育迟缓

en: Small clear blister on kid's upper lip, painless, mucocele?
zh: 我孩子上嘴唇有个小泡，透明的水泡，不疼，是粘液囊肿吗

en: Baby's hand covered in drool from sucking, red rash on hand
zh: 我宝宝吃手吃的满手都是口水，手上起了红疹子

en: Baby walks on tiptoes, almost 1.5 years old, normal?
zh: 我宝宝走路老踮脚尖，快一岁半了，正常吗

en: White spots on kid's fingernails, vitamin deficiency?
zh: 我孩子手指甲有白点，是缺什么维生素

en: Baby red patches come and go, urticaria?
zh: 我宝宝全身长了红色的斑块，一会儿有一会儿没，是荨麻疹吗

en: Kid speaks unclearly, says "dede" for "gege", need correction?
zh: 我家孩子说话口齿不清，把“哥哥”说成“得得”，需要纠正吗

en: Baby constipated, stool like goat pellets
zh: 我宝宝便秘，拉出来的屎像羊粪蛋，一粒一粒的

en: Circular light patch on kid's face, rough, flaky, ringworm?
zh: 我孩子脸上有个浅色的圆形斑，粗糙，起皮，是癣吗

en: Daughter 6, red vulva, painful urination, UTI?
zh: 我女儿外阴红，说尿尿疼，六岁，是不是尿路感染

en: Baby makes gurgling throat sound when feeding, like phlegm, but alert
zh: 我宝宝喝奶的时候喉咙呼噜呼噜响，像有痰，但精神好

en: Corner of kid's mouth cracked, can't open wide, vitamin B deficiency?
zh: 我家孩子嘴角裂口子了，张不开嘴，是不是缺维生素B

en: Baby green poop with curds, need switch formula?
zh: 我宝宝拉屎是绿色的，还有奶瓣，要不要换奶粉

en: Kid tosses and turns at night, restless sleep, grinds teeth
zh: 我娃晚上睡觉老翻来覆去，睡不安稳，还磨牙

en: Baby head covered with yellow crusts, layers, can't wash off
zh: 我宝宝头上长了好多黄色的痂，一层一层的，洗不掉

en: Small black spot on kid's tooth, no pain, cavity?
zh: 我孩子牙齿上有个小黑点，不疼，是不是蛀牙了

en: Kid drools a lot during sleep, pillow wet
zh: 我孩子睡觉老流口水，口水特别多，枕巾都湿了

en: Kid says anal itching, worse at night, pinworms?
zh: 我孩子总说屁股痒，晚上更明显，是不是蛲虫

en: Baby vomits when crying, even one hour after feeding, normal?
zh: 我宝宝一哭就吐奶，吃完奶一个小时还吐，正常吗

en: Green-yellow discharge in kid's eye, stuck shut
zh: 我孩子眼睛里有眼屎，黄绿色的，把眼睛糊住了

en: Baby 1 year old can't crawl, only rolls over, delayed?
zh: 我娃一岁还不会爬，只会翻身，是不是发育慢

en: Small blisters on baby's hands and feet, not mouth, hand-foot-mouth?
zh: 我宝宝手上起了小水泡，脚上也有，嘴巴里没有，是手足口吗

en: Kid often dizzy, sometimes vision blackout for seconds
zh: 我孩子经常说头晕，有时候会眼前发黑，几秒钟就好

en: Baby blows bubbles like a crab, pneumonia?
zh: 我宝宝吐泡泡，像螃蟹一样，是不是肺炎

en: Kid coughs with phlegm but swallows it, problem?
zh: 我孩子咳嗽，有痰不会吐，全咽下去了，要紧吗

en: Baby bites people at 1.5 years, teething or problem?
zh: 我宝宝总爱咬人，一岁半，是长牙还是有问题

en: Kid has small hole near ear since birth, sometimes smelly, what
zh: 我孩子耳朵上有小孔，天生的，有时候会臭，是什么

en: Baby diarrhea like egg drop soup, 8 times a day, alert
zh: 我娃拉肚子，蛋花汤样的，一天八次，精神还行

en: Child recovered from cold, sniffs, says stuff dripping down throat
zh: 我孩子感冒好了，但一直吸鼻子，说鼻子后面有东西流下去

en: Kid sweats a lot at night, hair soaked, calcium deficiency?
zh: 我娃晚上睡觉总是一身汗，头发湿透，是不是缺钙

en: Baby strains, face red, grunting, gas?
zh: 我娃老使劲，脸憋得通红，哼哼唧唧，是肠胀气吗

en: Yellow greasy crusts on baby's eyebrows, what
zh: 我宝宝眉毛上长黄色的痂，油腻腻的，是什么

en: Baby rubs eyes, not red, sometimes tears, allergy?
zh: 我宝宝总是揉眼睛，眼睛不红，有时候会流泪，是过敏吗

en: Kid bad breath, brushing no help, stomach or tonsils?
zh: 我孩子有口臭，刷牙也不管用，是胃还是扁桃体

en: Baby hiccups for half hour, distressed? Need intervention?
zh: 我宝宝总打嗝，一打就是半小时，难受吗，要干预吗

en: Baby poops out carrot puree undigested, keep feeding?
zh: 我宝宝一吃胡萝卜泥就拉胡萝卜，不消化，还要喂吗

en: Red veins in kid's eye white, no discharge, too much screen?
zh: 我娃眼白上有红血丝，没有眼屎，是看手机多了吗

en: Blood streaks like hair in baby stool, alert
zh: 我宝宝大便有红血丝，很细，像发丝，精神状态好

en: Kid snores, stuffy nose, mouth breathes daytime, adenoids?
zh: 我娃睡觉打呼，鼻子不通，白天也张着嘴呼吸，是腺样体肥大吗

en: Baby passes gas with small poop, diaper rash
zh: 我宝宝屁多，每次放屁都会带出一点屎，红屁股了

en: Baby suddenly refuses bottle, only breastfed, feeding strike?
zh: 我宝宝突然不吃奶瓶了，只吃母乳，是厌奶期吗

en: Baby skin yellow but not eyes, 2 weeks old, jaundice?
zh: 我宝宝皮肤黄，眼球不黄，出生两周了，是黄疸吗

en: Kid writes crooked, wrong grip, sensory integration disorder?
zh: 我孩子写字歪歪扭扭，拿笔姿势不对，是感统失调吗

en: Morning eye swelling resolves by afternoon, urinalysis normal
zh: 我宝宝早上起来眼睛肿，到下午就消了，查了尿常规正常

en: Brown soft earwax blocking ear, affect hearing?
zh: 我娃耳屎是棕色的，软软的，堵住了耳朵，影响听力吗

en: Kid's mouth corners cracked and bleeding, hates vegetables
zh: 我家孩子嘴角裂口子，还流血，不爱吃蔬菜

en: Kid says ankle pain, no injury, won't walk in morning
zh: 我孩子总说脚脖子疼，没扭过，早上起来不敢走路

en: White mucus in baby's poop like snot, twice daily, alert
zh: 我宝宝拉屎有白色黏液，像鼻涕，一天两次，精神好

en: Kid tosses and turns, kicks blanket, talks in sleep, restless
zh: 我娃晚上睡觉来回翻滚，踢被子，还讲梦话，睡不踏实

en: Bald ring on baby's head like a hat, calcium deficiency?
zh: 我宝宝头上有一圈没头发，像戴了个帽子，是缺钙吗

en: Black lines on kid's teeth can't brush off, cavities?
zh: 我孩子牙齿上有黑线，刷牙刷不掉，是蛀牙吗

en: Drools during sleep and daytime, age 3
zh: 我孩子睡觉老流口水，白天也会不自觉流，三岁了

en: Kid says anal itch, scratches badly, even during sleep
zh: 我孩子总说屁股痒，抓得厉害，晚上睡着了也抓

en: Kid throat clearing and eye squinting, comes and goes for months
zh: 我孩子清嗓子吭吭声，还挤眼睛，时好时坏，几个月了

en: Baby vomits when crying, not projectile, flows from mouth, normal?
zh: 我宝宝一哭就吐，不是喷的，从嘴边流出来，正常吗

en: Green-yellow discharge in kid's eye, stuck shut in morning
zh: 我孩子眼睛里有黄绿色眼屎，糊住了，早上睁不开

en: Kid dizzy when standing or walking, fine lying down
zh: 我孩子经常说头晕，站着或走路时晕，躺下就好

en: Kid sniffs without runny nose, mouth corner twitches, tics?
zh: 我孩子老吸鼻子，没有鼻涕，嘴角还抽动，是抽动症吗

en: Small hole near kid's ear red today, squeezed out white smelly stuff
zh: 我孩子耳朵上有小孔，今天发红，挤出白色臭东西

en: My baby has a lot of red rashes, patches after patches, and it's very itchy. Is he allergic?
zh: 我娃身上起了好多红疹子，一片一片的，特别痒，是不是过敏了？

en: My baby doesn't like to eat much recently, and she always cries when she goes to bed at night. Is she accumulating food?
zh: 我娃最近不怎么爱吃饭，而且晚上睡觉总是哭闹，是不是积食了？

en: My baby got vaccinated yesterday. Today, there is a lump on his arm and a little fever. Is it normal?
zh: 我娃昨天打了疫苗，今天胳膊上有个硬块，还有点发烧，正常吗？

en: Doctor, my child had a fever of 39 degrees last night. She took antifebrile medicine and it went away. She woke up in good spirits this morning, but she developed a lot of small red rashes. Is it a child's acute rash?
zh: 医生，我娃昨晚发烧39度，吃了退烧药退了，今天早上起来精神挺好，但是身上出了好多小红疹子，是不是幼儿急疹？

en: My baby has just turned one year old. Today, he had loose stools several times. It has a little foam and a sour smell. His bottom is red. Is this lactose intolerance? Do you want to change the milk powder?
zh: 我家宝宝刚满一岁，今天拉了好几次稀便，带点泡沫，还有酸臭味，屁股都红了，这是不是乳糖不耐受？要不要换奶粉？

en: My baby is only 4 months old, and the stool he has recently pooped is all green, like grass, and very thin. He pooped more than ten times a day and cried hard. Is it lactose intolerance or enteritis?
zh: 我家宝宝才4个月，最近拉出来的大便全是绿色的，像草一样，而且特别稀，一天拉十几次，哭得厉害，是不是乳糖不耐受还是肠炎？

en: I have lost my hair very badly recently, and I catch a lot of it every time. Is my body lacking any nutrients?
zh: 我最近掉头发特别厉害，一抓一大把，是不是身体缺什么营养了？

en: My eyes have been dry, itchy, and a little red recently. Have I looked at my phone too much?
zh: 我最近眼睛总是干涩发痒，还有点红，是不是看手机看多了？

en: I feel sore and backache recently, especially when I get up in the morning. I feel better when I exercise. What's going on?
zh: 我最近感觉腰酸背痛的，特别是早上起来的时候，活动活动就好点了，是怎么回事？

en: Doctor, I always feel my ears buzzing recently, especially when it is quiet at night. What's going on?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得耳朵嗡嗡响，特别是晚上安静的时候，是怎么回事？

en: I always feel itchy in my eyes recently, especially in spring. Is it allergic conjunctivitis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛痒，特别是春天的时候，是不是过敏性结膜炎？

en: I always feel dry and painful recently. Is it dry eye syndrome?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛干涩，还有点疼，是不是干眼症？

en: I always feel cold in my hands and feet recently, especially in winter. Is my blood circulation bad?
zh: 我最近总是觉得手脚冰凉，特别是冬天，是不是血液循环不好？

en: I always feel tinnitus recently, especially when it is quiet at night. Is it kidney deficiency?
zh: 我最近总是觉得耳鸣，特别是晚上安静的时候，是不是肾虚？

en: I always feel itchy in my eyes recently, especially in spring. Is it allergic conjunctivitis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛痒，特别是春天，是不是过敏性结膜炎？

en: I always feel sore in my back recently, especially after sitting for a long time. Is it a strain of my back muscles?
zh: 我最近总是觉得腰酸，特别是久坐之后，是不是腰肌劳损？

en: I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I stand up. Is it anemia?
zh: 我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是站起来的时候，是不是贫血？

en: I recently brushed my teeth and my gums were bleeding endlessly, and my teeth were so loose that even when I bit an apple, blood oozed. Is it advanced with periodontitis? Can I still keep my teeth?
zh: 我最近刷牙牙龈出血不止，而且牙齿松动得厉害，咬苹果都渗血，是不是牙周炎晚期了？还能保住牙吗？

en: Recently, I always feel dry eyes, blurred after looking at my phone for a long time, and I also have a foreign body feeling. Is it dry eye? Can I use that kind of artificial tears? Which brand is good?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛干涩，看手机久了就模糊，还有异物感，是不是干眼症？能用那种人工泪液吗？哪种牌子好？

en: Doctor, I always feel waist pain recently, especially when I get up stiff in the morning. It's better if I exercise. Is it ankylosing spondylitis? Will young people get it too?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得腰疼，特别是早上起来僵硬，活动活动就好点了，是不是强直性脊柱炎？年轻人也会得吗？

en: Recently, I always feel my ears buzzing, like cicadas. It's more obvious when it's quiet at night. It's so noisy that I can't sleep. Is my ears ringing? Can it be cured?
zh: 我最近总是觉得耳朵嗡嗡响，像蝉叫一样，晚上安静的时候更明显，吵得睡不着，是不是耳鸣？能治好吗？

en: I always feel cold in my hands and feet recently, especially in winter. No matter how much I wear, I can't get warm. Is my blood circulation bad? Or is it Yang deficiency?
zh: 我最近总是觉得手脚冰凉，特别是冬天，穿再多也暖和不过来，是不是血液循环不好？还是阳虚？

en: My hair has fallen out badly recently. I grab a lot of it and the sewer is blocked when I wash my hair. Is this related to my recent weight loss and not eating staple foods? Or is there something missing in your body?
zh: 我tou发最近掉得厉害，一抓一大把，洗头的时候下水道都堵了，是不是跟我最近减肥不吃主食有关系啊？还是身体缺啥了？

en: Recently, I always feel numb in my hands and feet, especially when I sleep. My fingers feel wooden. It will be fine if I exercise it a little. Is the cervical vertebra pressing on the nerves?
zh: 我最近总是觉得手脚发麻，特别是睡觉起来的时候，手指头感觉木木的，活动一下就好了，是不是颈椎压迫到神经了？

en: Recently, when I brush my teeth, my gums always bleed. Sometimes I bite an apple, there are blood marks on it, and I feel that my teeth are a little loose. Is it periodontitis? How to treat it?
zh: 我最近刷牙的时候牙龈总是出血，有时候咬一口苹果上面也有血印，而且感觉牙齿有点松动了，是不是牙周炎？该怎么治？

en: Doctor, I always feel cold in my hands and feet recently, as well as in summer, and my face is pale. Is it anemia? Do you want to eat donkey-hide gelatin?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得手脚冰凉，夏天也凉，脸色苍白，是不是贫血？要不要吃阿胶？

en: Recently, I always feel cold in my hands and feet, cold in summer, and my face is pale. Is it anemia? Do you want to eat donkey-hide gelatin?
zh: 我最近总是觉得手脚冰凉，夏天也凉，脸色苍白，是不是贫血？要不要吃阿胶？

en: Eyes feel like something inside, gritty but not red, is it dry eye
zh: 我眼睛总感觉有东西，磨得慌，也不红，是不是干眼症

en: Mouth ulcer for half month, still not healed, painful to eat
zh: 我嘴里面长了个溃疡，半个月了还没好，疼得吃不下饭

en: Red eyes with discharge past 2 days, stuck shut in morning, pink eye?
zh: 我这两天眼睛红，有分泌物，早上粘住睁不开，是不是红眼病

en: Foamy urine that persists long, kidney problem?
zh: 我小便有泡沫，很久不散，是不是肾有问题

en: Face and eyelids swollen this morning, didn't drink much water yesterday
zh: 我今天早上起来发现脸肿了，眼皮也肿，前一天没喝多水

en: Urine reddish like meat-washing water but painless, nephritis?
zh: 我最近小便发红，像洗肉水，但不疼，是不是肾炎

en: Red veins in eyes, eye drops no effect, for days
zh: 我眼睛里有红血丝，用了眼药水没用，好几天了

en: Feel hotter than others but thermometer normal, why
zh: 我感觉我体温比别人高，但量体温正常，怎么回事

en: Urine smells strong like ammonia, drinking water doesn't help
zh: 我最近尿液气味很重，像氨水，多喝水也没用

en: Floaters like black dots moving with eyes, floaters?
zh: 我觉得我眼睛里有东西在飞，黑点跟着眼球转，是飞蚊症吗

en: Tinnitus matches heartbeat rhythm, whooshing sound, what is it
zh: 我耳鸣跟心跳节奏一样，翁翁的，是什么问题

en: Dry eyes and gritty sensation after phone use, dry eye?
zh: 我最近看手机久了，眼睛干涩，还有异物感，是干眼症吗

en: Random bruises on body, don't know where bumped
zh: 我身上总是青一块紫一块，不知道在哪磕的

en: Small lump on right neck, obvious when turning head, not painful
zh: 我脖子右边有个小肿块，转头时明显，不疼

en: Lump at back of head painful on pressure, recently had cold
zh: 我后脑勺有个包，一按就疼，最近感冒了

en: Lots of eye discharge on waking, glued lashes, conjunctivitis?
zh: 我睡觉起来眼屎很多，黏住了睫毛，是结膜炎吗

en: Sweat profusely even just eating a meal, weakness?
zh: 我最近动不动就出汗，吃个饭满头汗，是虚吗

en: Double vision when looking sideways, fine looking straight
zh: 我感觉我眼睛往旁边看时有重影，正看没有，咋回事

en: Always dry mouth despite drinking, blood sugar normal
zh: 我最近总是口干舌燥，喝了很多水还是干，血糖正常

en: Foamy urine past 2 days, but urinalysis normal, problem?
zh: 我最近两天尿里有泡沫，但体检尿常规正常，有问题吗

en: Yawning often despite enough sleep, brain hypoxia?
zh: 我最近总是打哈欠，但睡眠够，是不是脑缺氧

en: Feel smelly, others agree, shower daily
zh: 我最近总是感觉臭臭的，别人也这么说，但我每天洗澡

en: Ear feels blocked but hearing fine, can't dig out
zh: 我耳朵里感觉有东西堵着，但不影响听力，掏也掏不出来

en: Tip of tongue feels numb, for 3-4 days
zh: 我感觉我舌头有点发麻，舌尖那块，有三四天了

en: Left lower back pain, worse during urination, kidney stone?
zh: 我后腰左侧疼，尿尿的时候更疼，是不是结石

en: Left upper eyelid twitching for a month, on and off
zh: 我左上眼皮跳了快一个月了，跳跳停停，啥原因

en: Feeling of something stuck in throat, better after burping
zh: 我总感觉喉咙里有东西卡着，打嗝后会好一点

en: Eyes sensitive to light, can't open in daytime, what disease
zh: 我最近眼睛怕光，白天出门睁不开眼，是什么病

en: Hard to draw blood every time, blood too thick?
zh: 我每次抽血都很困难，血抽不出来，是不是血液太稠

en: Feeling heavy all over, like carrying something, sleep doesn't refresh
zh: 我最近老觉得浑身发沉，像背了东西，睡一觉也不解乏

en: Muscle on front of thigh keeps twitching, visible, no pain
zh: 我大腿前面那块肉老是跳，能看见肌肉在动，不疼

en: Everything tastes salty lately, even plain rice, what's wrong
zh: 我最近吃什么都觉得咸，连白米饭都咸，怎么回事

en: Neck thicker recently, thyroid function normal, why
zh: 我最近脖子粗了，查了甲功正常，是怎么回事

en: Small yellow spot on white of eye for years, painless
zh: 我眼白上有个黄色的小斑块，很多年了，不疼不痒

en: Constant yawning during meetings, embarrassing
zh: 我最近老打哈欠，开会时打不停，好尴尬

en: Swollen painful chin lymph node, no mouth ulcer
zh: 我最近下巴淋巴结肿了，按着疼，嘴里没有溃疡

en: Eyeball swelling and orbit pain, glaucoma?
zh: 我最近感觉眼球发胀，眼眶疼，是不是青光眼

en: Vision blurry like through fog, cataract?
zh: 我最近眼睛看东西有点模糊，像隔了一层雾，是白内障吗

en: Shadows floating in eyes, worse in sunlight, floaters?
zh: 我眼睛里有黑影飘，太阳光下更明显，是飞蚊症吗

en: Eyes too dry to open, artificial tears help but can't stop
zh: 我最近眼睛干得睁不开，用人工泪液就好点，但停不了

en: Muscle twitching on front thigh for days, no pain, just annoying
zh: 我大腿前面肌肉跳了好几天，不疼，就是烦

en: Everything tastes salty including plain water, kidney fine
zh: 我最近吃什么都觉得咸，连白开水都咸，查了肾没问题

en: Neck thicker, breathing a bit hard, normal thyroid function
zh: 我最近脖子变粗了，呼吸有点费劲，查了甲功正常

en: Clear small blister on white of eye, no pain, what
zh: 我眼白上有个透明的小水泡，不疼，是啥

en: Frequent yawning despite enough sleep, brain hypoxia?
zh: 我最近老打哈欠，但睡眠够了，是不是脑缺氧

en: Painful swollen chin lymph node, no mouth ulcer
zh: 我最近下巴颏淋巴结肿了，按着疼，嘴里没溃疡

en: Always feel cold even with thick blanket, temp 35.5°C
zh: 我最近老觉得冷，盖厚被子还冷，量体温35.5度

en: Doctor, recently, I always feel that the soles of my feet are like stepping on cotton, and I feel like I'm walking with my feet floating, especially when I close my eyes at night. Is it diabetic neuropathy?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得脚底板像踩在棉花上，走路发飘，特别是晚上闭眼站立不稳，是不是糖尿病神经病变？

en: My mother is 75 years old this year. Recently, she has always said that there are ants crawling in her thighs. It is so itchy that she can't sleep. It won't get better even if the skin is scratched. Is it skin itching caused by diabetes?
zh: 我妈妈今年75岁，最近总是说腿肚子里像有蚂蚁在爬，痒得睡不着，抓破了皮也不见好，是不是糖尿病引起的皮肤瘙痒？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling flustered recently, my heartbeat is fast, and my hands are shaking, but my blood pressure is not high, and my weight has become lighter. Is it hyperthyroidism? What medicine do I need to take?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心慌，心跳快，手抖，但是量血压不高，体重反而轻了，是不是甲亢？需要吃什么药？

en: Teeth ache with cold/hot, cavity or sensitivity?
zh: 我牙齿遇冷遇热就酸疼，是蛀牙还是敏感

en: Blood in mouth every morning, where from?
zh: 我每天早上起来嘴里有血，可能是哪里出血

en: Can't open mouth wide even yawn, TMJ disorder?
zh: 我嘴巴张不开，打哈欠都张不大，是不是颞下颌关节紊乱

en: Tooth pain after sweets, cavity to nerve?
zh: 我最近一吃甜食就牙疼，是不是蛀牙到神经了

en: Bleeding gums and bad breath when brushing, periodontitis?
zh: 我最近刷牙牙龈出血，还有口臭，是牙周炎吗

en: Cracked tongue like a map, painless, what
zh: 我舌头上有裂纹，像地图一样，不疼，是怎么回事

en: Teeth painfully sour after lemon water, corroded?
zh: 我喝了柠檬水后牙酸得厉害，是不是把牙腐蚀了

en: Veins under tongue thick and dark, blood stasis?
zh: 我舌头下面青筋又粗又黑，是不是淤血

en: Tooth pain after cake, better with cold water, cavity?
zh: 我吃了蛋糕后牙疼，凉水漱口就好，是不是蛀牙

en: Tooth pain intermittent, hot/cold sensitive, pulpitis?
zh: 我最近老是牙疼，一阵一阵的，冷热都疼，是牙髓炎吗

en: Teeth sore after lemon water, even tofu feels sour, what to do
zh: 我喝了柠檬水后牙齿酸软，吃豆腐都酸，怎么办

en: Veins under tongue thick and dark, yellow thick coating
zh: 我舌头下面青筋很粗，发黑，舌苔黄厚

en: Out of breath when walking fast, have asthma history, attack?
zh: 我走路快了就喘不上气，有哮喘病史，是不是发作了

en: Sneezing and runny nose for a week, thought cold but persists
zh: 我最近总是打喷嚏流清鼻涕，以为是感冒但一周了

en: Quit smoking recently, cough gets worse, detox?
zh: 我最近戒烟了，反而咳嗽更厉害，是身体在排毒吗

en: Sneezing, itchy nose and eyes lately, allergy?
zh: 我最近老是打喷嚏，鼻子痒，眼睛也痒，是过敏吗

en: Dry nose with scabs, bleeding when picking, atrophic rhinitis?
zh: 我鼻子里面干，有血痂，扣一下就出血，是干燥性鼻炎吗

en: Throat feels phlegm stuck for months
zh: 我嗓子总感觉有痰，咳不出来咽不下去，好几个月

en: Can't smell, nose still blocked half month after cold
zh: 我最近闻不到味道了，鼻子也不通，感冒好了半个月了

en: Always want deep breath, feel air hunger, not asthma
zh: 我最近总想深呼吸，觉得吸不够气，但又不像哮喘

en: Brown sputum like soy sauce, lung bleeding?
zh: 我咳出来的痰是褐色的，像酱油，是不是肺出血

en: Throat itchy, keep coughing, no phlegm, rock sugar pear no help
zh: 我嗓子痒老想咳，也没痰，吃了好几天冰糖雪梨没用

en: Breathing sounds like a whistle when lying down at night
zh: 我感觉我呼吸有声音，像哨子，尤其是晚上躺下

en: Cough and shortness of breath after running, resolves in half hour
zh: 我每次跑完步就咳嗽，喘不上气，过半小时就好

en: Runny nose for two weeks after cold resolved
zh: 我感冒好了之后一直流清鼻涕，快两周了，咋回事

en: Sneezing, teary, itchy eyes lately, pollen allergy?
zh: 我最近老打喷嚏，流眼泪，眼睛痒，是不是花粉过敏

en: Feeling of fluid in chest, hear water sound when turning
zh: 我最近感觉胸腔里面有积液感，翻身时能感觉到水声

en: Lately constant runny nose and sneezing, cold meds not working
zh: 我最近一直流清鼻涕，打喷嚏，吃了感冒药也没用

en: I cough for months after every cold, why is that?
zh: 我每次感冒后都会咳嗽好几个月，这是为啥

en: Cough lately when smelling smoke, asthma?
zh: 我最近老咳嗽，闻到烟味就咳，是不是哮喘

en: Coughing up jelly-like phlegm in small pieces
zh: 我最近总是咳出果冻一样的痰，一小块一小块的

en: Red lump inside nose blocking breathing, nasal polyp?
zh: 我鼻子里面有个红红的肉球，堵着不通气，是不是鼻息肉

en: Dry cough worse lying down, syrup no help
zh: 我最近老咳嗽，干咳，晚上躺下更严重，吃了止咳糖浆没用

en: Cough until vomiting, throat itch, pharyngitis pills no use
zh: 我最近老咳嗽，咳到吐，喉咙痒，吃了咽炎片没用

en: My throat feels harsh and stuck these two days, can't cough it out
zh: 我这两天嗓子有点齁得慌，总觉得有东西卡在那，咳不出来

en: White foamy phlegm cough, worse morning and night

zh: 我脖子上有好多小肉揪，揪掉还会长，是丝状疣吗

en: Hard painful lump behind ear, just noticed yesterday
zh: 我耳朵后边长了个硬包，一按就疼，昨天刚发现的

en: Big red swollen hard pimple suddenly on face
zh: 我脸上突然长了一颗大痘痘，又红又肿，摸起来硬硬的

en: Red itchy spots after hot shower, disappear after a while
zh: 我每次洗热水澡身上就起小红点，痒，过一会就没了

en: Black mole on sole, hurts from walking, need treatment?
zh: 我脚底板有个黑色的痣，最近走路磨得疼，要不要处理

en: Skin stings and reddens after skincare, barrier damaged?
zh: 我脸上皮肤一涂护肤品就刺痛发红，是不是屏障受损

en: Blister on lip popped, yellow fluid, now yellow crust
zh: 我嘴上起了个水泡，戳破了流黄水，现在结黄痂

en: Darkened patch on calf with scales, not itchy
zh: 我小腿上有一块皮肤颜色变深了，还有鳞屑，不痒

en: Many tiny flesh-colored bumps on face, no pain itch
zh: 我脸上长了很多细小的肉色小疙瘩，不痛不痒，是什么

en: Feet sweat profusely, socks soaked daily
zh: 我最近脚底出汗特别厉害，袜子每天湿透

en: Purple-red streaks on thigh like stretch marks, not pregnant
zh: 我大腿上长了一片紫红色的条纹，像妊娠纹，我没怀孕

en: Belly button smelly with discharge, what is it
zh: 我最近肚脐眼里面有臭味，还有分泌物，是什么

en: Red hard lump on face, still there after a month
zh: 我脸上长了个包，又红又硬，已经一个月了还不消

en: Red hard lump at groin, hurts when walking
zh: 我大腿根长了个红疙瘩，硬硬的，走路磨得疼

en: Skin red, hot, and rash after sun exposure
zh: 我脸上皮肤一晒太阳就发红发烫，起小疹子

en: Raised red scar on face, keloid?
zh: 我脸上有个疤，凸起来的，红红的，是疤痕疙瘩吗

en: Big red pimple on back, painful to touch, for days
zh: 我后背上长了个大痘痘，红红的，一碰就疼，好几天了

en: Toenails white, thick, powdery when cut, fungal?
zh: 我最近脚趾甲发白，变厚，剪的时候粉末状的，是灰指甲吗

en: Many small blisters on face, itchy, contagious?
zh: 我脸上起了很多小水泡，痒，会传染吗

en: Purple streaks on back of thigh like lightning, no pain
zh: 我大腿后面有紫色条纹，像闪电一样，不疼不痒

en: Face always oily, worse in summer, seborrheic dermatitis?
zh: 我脸上总是油光光的，夏天更严重，是不是脂溢性皮炎

en: White depressed streaks on leg, not stretch marks, what
zh: 我腿上有白色条纹，凹陷的，不是妊娠纹，是什么

en: Red, hot, painful lump on back with pus head, carbuncle?
zh: 我后背长了一个包，红肿热痛，还有脓头，是痈吗

en: Tiny grain-like bumps on arm, dense, no pain
zh: 我胳膊上起了那种小米粒一样的疙瘩，密密麻麻的，不疼

en: Feet peeling in layers, not itchy, athlete's foot?
zh: 我最近脚丫子脱皮，不痒，就是一层一层的掉，是脚气吗

en: Pus bump on leg hair follicle, squeezed white stuff, now red and swollen
zh: 我腿上汗毛长了个脓包，挤出来白色东西，现在红肿

en: Painful lump in hair at lower back of head for days
zh: 我后脑勺下面头发里长了个疙瘩，一按就疼，好几天了

en: Callus on foot with clear tiny hole in center, what
zh: 我脚上长了个老茧，中间有个透明的小洞，是什么

en: Red itchy rash after cold shower, cold allergy?
zh: 我每次洗冷水澡身上就起红疹，痒，是冷过敏吗

en: Small black bump on face scratched, bled
zh: 我脸上长了个黑色的小凸起，最近被挠破了，流血了

en: Red blood vessels and papules on face, worse with heat, rosacea?
zh: 我脸上有红血丝，还有丘疹，遇热加重，是玫瑰痤疮吗

en: Pimple became hard lump over a year, scar?
zh: 我脸上痘痘变成了硬疙瘩，一年多不消，是疤痕吗

en: Red painful lump behind ear, fever 37.5°C
zh: 我耳朵后长了疙瘩，有点红，一按就疼，发烧37.5

en: Itchy after hot bath, scratching causes red streaks, allergy?
zh: 我每次洗完热水澡就身上痒，抓了起红条，是过敏吗

en: Black vertical line under toenail, wide, no pain, what
zh: 我脚趾甲下面有黑色竖线，宽宽的，不疼，是什么

en: Anything stings skin, even plain water makes face red
zh: 我脸上皮肤用什么都刺痛，用清水洗脸也红

en: Pus blister on lip popped, now black crust
zh: 我嘴上起了个脓包，弄破了流脓，现在结黑痂

en: Purple-red streaks on thigh like watermelon rind, not pregnant
zh: 我大腿上长了紫红色条纹，像西瓜皮，没怀孕

en: Boil on buttock ruptured with pus and blood, still hard lump
zh: 我最近屁股上长了个疖子，破了流脓血，还有硬块

en: Belly button oozing fluid, smelly, slightly red, what
zh: 我肚脐眼流水，发臭，有点红，是什么

en: Red hard lump on face for a month, no pus
zh: 我脸上长了一个包，又红又硬，一个月没消，也不化脓

en: I have a lot of small red pimples on my skin, a little itchy, and dandruff. Is it an allergic reaction to the shampoo?
zh: 我tou皮上长了好多小红疙瘩，有点痒，还有头皮屑，是不是洗发水过敏了？

en: I have a lot of acne on my face. It's red and painful when I touch it. Is it an endocrine disorder?
zh: 我脸上长了好多痘痘，红红的，一碰就疼，是不是内分泌失调了？

en: I have a lot of small red pimples on my skin. It's a little itchy. Is it an allergic reaction to the shampoo?
zh: 我tou皮上长了好多小红疙瘩，有点痒，是不是洗发水过敏了？

en: I always feel dry skin recently, especially in winter. Is it a lack of vitamins?
zh: 我最近总是觉得皮肤干燥，特别是冬天，是不是缺乏维生素？

en: I always feel itchy on my skin recently, especially at night. Is it hives?
zh: 我最近总是觉得皮肤痒，特别是晚上，是不是荨麻疹？

en: My face suddenly had a lot of red pimples, which were itchy and swollen. It seemed like I had an allergic reaction, but I didn't eat anything new. Is it an allergic reaction during the season? Can I apply some Piyanping?
zh: 我脸上突然起了好多红疙瘩，又痒又肿，像是过敏了，但我没吃什么新东西啊，是不是换季过敏？能涂点皮炎平吗？

en: I have a lot of those red, hard acne on my face. It hurts when I touch it, and my chin and forehead are the most. Is this related to my recent stay up late to work overtime? Or is there an endocrine disorder?
zh: 我脸上长了好多那种红红的、硬硬的痘痘，一碰就疼，下巴和额头最多，是不是跟我最近熬夜加班有关系？还是内分泌失调了？

en: Doctor, recently I always feel that there are big patches of wind on my body, which is very itchy. It bulges when I scratch it, but it disappears again in a few hours. Is it hives?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得身上起那种风团，一大片一大片的，特别痒，抓了就鼓起来，过几个小时又消了，是不是荨麻疹？

en: I always feel itchy on my skin recently, especially after taking off my clothes at night. There are big bumps on my body that look like mosquitoes have bitten them. After a while, they disappear again. Is it hives?
zh: 我最近总是觉得皮肤痒，特别是晚上脱了衣服之后，身上起那种像蚊子咬过的大包，过一会儿又消了，是不是荨麻疹？

en: Recently, I always feel that my eyes have dark shadows floating around when I see things, like mosquitoes, and sometimes it will flash. Is this a precursor to retinal detachment?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛看东西有黑影飘来飘去，像蚊子一样，有时候还会闪光，是不是视网膜脱落的前兆？

en: I always feel dry recently. I cry after watching the screen for a long time, and the number of times I blink has increased. Is it dry eye? Can I use that Internet celebrity eye drops?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛干涩，看屏幕久了就流泪，眨眼次数增多，是不是干眼症？能用那种网红眼药水吗？

en: Recently, I always feel that I have double vision when I see things, especially when I am driving at night. Sometimes I have headaches. Is there a problem with the fundus of my eyes?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛看东西有重影，尤其是晚上开车的时候更明显，有时候还会头痛，是不是眼底出问题了？

en: Doctor, I always feel dry recently. I cry after watching the screen for a long time. I blink more frequently. Is it dry eye? Can I use that Internet celebrity eye drops?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得眼睛干涩，看屏幕久了就流泪，眨眼次数增多，是不是干眼症？能用那种网红眼药水吗？

en: Can't sleep well lately, wake at 3-4am and can't fall back
zh: 我最近睡不好，凌晨三四点就醒，再也睡不着了

en: Severe teeth grinding at night, sore jaw in morning, what's that
zh: 我睡觉磨牙很严重，早上腮帮子酸，是怎么回事

en: Very loud snoring, wife says I stop breathing suddenly, what disease
zh: 我最近鼾声特别大，老婆说我会突然不呼吸，是什么病

en: Wake at 2-3am and can't sleep, tired daytime
zh: 我最近老是凌晨两三点就醒，然后就睡不着了，白天没精神

en: Drool while sleeping, wet pillow, what's up
zh: 我睡觉流口水，早上枕头湿一片，怎么回事

en: Feet twitch involuntarily during sleep, unaware, wife says
zh: 我晚上睡觉脚会不自觉的抖动，自己不知道，老婆说的

en: Husband's snoring suddenly stops then gasps loudly, scary
zh: 我老公打呼噜突然停了，然后大喘一口气，吓人

en: Lots of dreams lately, more tired after waking, what's wrong
zh: 我最近梦特别多，醒来比没睡还累，怎么回事

en: Always can't wake up, miss multiple alarms
zh: 我最近总是睡不醒，闹钟响好几遍都听不见

en: Scream and hit in sleep, what's happening
zh: 我最近总在睡梦中大喊大叫，有时候还打人，是怎么回事

en: Insomnia, mind races when lying down, more awake
zh: 我最近老是失眠，躺下脑子就不停想事，越想越精神

en: Sleepy all day, fall asleep sitting, narcolepsy?
zh: 我最近总想睡觉，白天坐着也能睡着，是不是发作性睡病

en: Husband snores then stops for long time, then gasps
zh: 我老公打呼噜打着打着就没声了，好半天才喘一口气

en: Many nightmares, wake with racing heart, scared
zh: 我最近梦特别多，全是噩梦，醒来心跳快，害怕

en: Always can't wake up, tired after 10h sleep
zh: 我最近总是睡不醒，睡10个小时还困，越睡越累

en: Doctor, I recently found out that my husband snores very loudly when he sleeps. Sometimes he even feels like he stops breathing. Is it important?
zh: 医生，我最近发现我老公睡觉打呼噜特别响，有时候还感觉他呼吸停一下，这要紧吗？

en: I have been under a lot of stress recently, so I can't sleep at night. I wake up easily when I fall asleep. I have a headache in the morning and feel tired all over. Is it a nervous breakdown? Want to take sleeping pills?
zh: 我最近压力大，晚上睡不着，睡着了也容易醒，早上起来头疼，浑身没劲，是不是神经衰弱？要吃安眠药吗？

en: I recently discovered that my husband snores very loudly. Sometimes, when he is snoring, he suddenly stops. It takes a few seconds to catch his breath again. I am so scared that I dare not sleep. Is this called sleep apnea? Do you want to go to the hospital?
zh: 我最近发现我老公打呼噜声音特别大，有时候打着打着突然就没声了，过好几秒才又喘上来一口气，我吓得都不敢睡，这个是不是叫睡眠呼吸暂停？要不要去医院看看？

en: Dizzy and palpitations after diet control, hypoglycemia?
zh: 我最近控制饮食，结果头晕，心慌，是不是低血糖

en: Grandpa diabetic, recent swollen feet, kidney problem?
zh: 我爷爷有糖尿病，最近脚有点肿，是不是肾出问题了

en: Always hungry, palpitations, tremors, blood sugar 3.9
zh: 我最近总是觉得饿，而且心慌手抖，测了血糖3.9

en: Sweet smell in urine, diabetes?
zh: 我最近尿尿有甜味，是不是糖尿病

en: Dizzy, palpitations, tremors when hungry, better after eating
zh: 我肚子饿的时候会头晕，心慌，手抖，吃点东西就好了

en: Drink and urinate a lot, wake several times at night, annoying
zh: 我最近喝水特别多，尿也多，半夜要起来好几次，烦死了

en: Hungry soon after eating, hand tremors, low blood sugar?
zh: 我最近总感觉饿，刚吃完半小时又饿，手抖，血糖低

en: Dizzy, palpitations, tremors when hungry, relieved by candy
zh: 我肚子饿的时候会头晕，心慌，手抖，吃块糖就好

en: Doctor, I always feel thirsty recently. I am still thirsty after drinking a lot of water, and I urinate a lot. Is it diabetes?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得口渴，喝了很多水还是渴，而且尿也特别多，是不是糖尿病？

en: Doctor, I always feel that my mouth is dry recently, and it's useless to drink a lot of water. Is this a precursor of diabetes?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得嘴巴里干干的，喝很多水也没用，是不是糖尿病的前兆？

en: My father is 70 years old. Recently, he has to stop to catch his breath when walking a few steps. Is there a heart problem?
zh: 我爸爸70岁了，最近走路走几步就要停下来喘口气，是不是心脏有问题？

en: Doctor, I recently found out that my grandma is a little confused and sometimes doesn't know anyone. Is it Alzheimer's?
zh: 医生，我最近发现我奶奶有点糊涂，有时候不认识人，是不是老年痴呆了？

en: My father is in his 70s. Recently, he has to stop to catch his breath when walking a few steps. He can't lie flat when he sleeps at night. He has to put the pillow high to be comfortable. Is there a heart problem?
zh: 我爸爸70多了，最近走路走几步就要停下来喘口气，晚上睡觉也不能平躺，得垫高枕头才舒服，是不是心脏出问题了？

en: Doctor, I recently discovered that my grandma sometimes suddenly doesn't recognize me and asks me who you are. After a while, you'll get better again. Is this a precursor to Alzheimer's disease? I'm so scared.
zh: 医生，我最近发现我奶奶有时候会突然不认识我，还问我你是谁，过一会儿又好了，这是不是老年痴呆的前兆啊？我好害怕。

en: I recently discovered that my grandma sometimes suddenly doesn't recognize me and asks me who you are. After a while, you get better. Is this a precursor to Alzheimer's disease? I'm so scared.
zh: 我最近发现我奶奶有时候会突然不认识我，还问我你是谁，过一会儿又好了，这是不是老年痴呆的前兆啊？我好害怕。

en: Doctor, I always feel a buzzing sound in my ears recently, like cicadas. It is more obvious when it is quiet at night. It is so noisy that I can't sleep. Is it my tinnitus? Can it be cured?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得耳朵里有嗡嗡声，像蝉叫，晚上安静时更明显，吵得睡不着，是不是耳鸣？能治好吗？

en: Doctor, I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I turn my head or bow my head. I'll be fine after a faint. Is it otolithiasis? How to reset?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是转头或者低头的时候，晕一下就好了，是不是耳石症？怎么复位？

en: Doctor, I always feel my ears buzzing recently, like a cicada calling, especially when it is quiet at night. It is more obvious. The noise makes me unable to sleep. Is it ringing in my ears? Can it be cured?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得耳朵嗡嗡响，像有只蝉在叫，特别是晚上安静的时候更明显，吵得我睡不着，是不是耳鸣？能治好吗？

en: I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I get up in the morning. As soon as I get up, I feel dizzy and I need to relax for a while. Is it otolith?
zh: 我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是早上起床的时候，一起床就天旋地转的，得缓好一会儿，是不是耳石症？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling a buzzing sound in my ears recently, like the sound of electricity, and my hearing has dropped very quickly. I couldn't hear clearly when I was listening to the phone yesterday. Is it sudden deafness?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得耳朵里嗡嗡响，像电流声，而且听力下降得很快，昨天听电话都听不清了，是不是突发性耳聋？

en: Recently, I always feel a buzzing sound in my ears, like cicadas. It's more obvious when it's quiet at night. It's so noisy that I can't sleep. Is it ringing in my ears? Can it be cured?
zh: 我最近总是觉得耳朵里有嗡嗡声，像蝉叫，晚上安静时更明显，吵得睡不着，是不是耳鸣？能治好吗？

en: I have a headache and nausea these two days, did I eat something bad?
zh: 我这两天头疼还有点恶心，是不是吃坏东西了？

en: Ate hotpot last night, feeling off today, diarrhea three times
zh: 昨晚吃了火锅然后今天不太对劲，拉肚子三次了

en: Sometimes hurts sometimes not, dull right abdomen, is it appendicitis
zh: 有时候疼有时候又没事，右腹隐隐的，是不是阑尾炎

en: Feel gas moving in belly, gurgling sounds, lots of flatulence
zh: 我感觉肚子里有气在跑，咕噜咕噜叫，放屁多

en: Feel food stuck in chest when swallowing, what illness
zh: 我感觉吃东西咽不下去，堵在胸口，是什么病

en: Frequent burping after meals for half hour, what to do
zh: 我最近老打嗝，吃完饭就打，持续半小时，咋办

en: Constant urge to poop but can't, anal heaviness, growth?
zh: 我最近总感觉有便意但拉不出来，肛门坠胀，是长东西了吗

en: Dull left upper abdomen pain radiating to back, pancreas issue?
zh: 我左上腹隐痛，后面后背也疼，胰腺有问题吗

en: Burning sensation in stomach and chest discomfort, reflux esophagitis?
zh: 我感觉我胃有灼烧感，胸口也不舒服，是反流性食管炎吗

en: Urge to poop after spicy food, still feel after bowel, anal heaviness
zh: 我吃完麻辣烫后一直想大便，拉完还想去，肛门坠胀

en: Stomach always gurgling loud enough for others, embarrassing
zh: 我肚子总是咕噜咕噜叫，别人都能听到，尴尬死了

en: Need bathroom every time after coffee, colon too sensitive?
zh: 我每次喝咖啡就想上厕所，大肠是不是太敏感了

en: Diarrhea after cold raw food, enteritis?
zh: 我吃了生冷的东西就拉肚子，是肠炎吗

en: Dull right rib pain sometimes radiating to back
zh: 我最近老是觉得右边肋骨下隐隐疼，有时候后背也疼

en: Lately keep passing gas loudly, embarrassing on bus
zh: 我最近不知道咋了总放屁，还挺响的，坐公交好尴尬

en: Stomach cramping, intermittent, location changes
zh: 我肚子抽抽着疼，一阵一阵的，位置不固定

en: No stool for 3 days, hard belly, laxatives no effect
zh: 我最近三天没大便，肚子硬邦邦的，吃了泻药也没反应

en: Stomach pain when hungry, better after eating, duodenal ulcer?
zh: 我肚子饿的时候胃疼，吃了东西就好了，是十二指肠溃疡吗

en: Sour taste and acid reflux after meals, heartburn
zh: 我最近吃完东西嘴巴里发酸，反酸水，烧心

en: Stomach pain only at night, worse when hungry
zh: 我白天还好，一到晚上就胃疼，饿的时候更疼

en: Stomach feels like falling down, worse standing, better lying
zh: 我觉得我胃往下坠，站着的时候更明显，躺下好点

en: Feel choked when eating, need water to swallow
zh: 我吃东西的时候感觉噎得慌，要喝口水才能咽下去

en: Feel gas moving around in chest, better after fart
zh: 我最近老感觉有股气在胸口乱窜，有时候放个屁就好点

en: Frequent sour belching, gastroscopy normal
zh: 我最近老是嗳气，打出来的气有酸味，胃镜做了没事

en: Feel water sloshing in belly, drum sound when tapping, ascites?
zh: 我感觉肚子里有水在晃荡，拍一拍有咚咚声，是腹水吗

en: Dull pain under left rib, not tender to touch, fine with deep breath
zh: 我左边肋骨下隐痛，按着不疼，深呼吸也不疼

en: Nausea without vomiting, not pregnant
zh: 我最近总感觉想吐，但是没有吐，也没怀孕

en: Eat a lot but still lose weight, malabsorption?
zh: 我每天吃很多，但还是瘦，是不是肠子不吸收

en: Frequent burping, chest better after burping, stomach issue?
zh: 我最近老打嗝，打完嗝胸口舒服一点，是不是胃的问题

en: Feel food not chewed well, choking, esophagus narrow?
zh: 我总觉得饭没嚼碎就咽下去了，噎得慌，是不是食道变窄

en: Stomach gurgling and gas after eggs, allergy?
zh: 我每次吃完鸡蛋肚子就咕噜响，放屁多，是不是过敏

en: Can't eat greasy food, nauseated by oil smell, hepatitis?
zh: 我最近吃不下油腻的东西，闻到油味就恶心，是肝炎吗

en: Frequent loud farts not smelly, socially awkward
zh: 我最近老是放屁，不臭，就是声音大，社交尴尬

en: Stomach pain around 2 hours after meals and when hungry, what
zh: 我最近总在饭后两小时左右胃疼，饿了也疼，是什么

en: Burning in stomach worse after meals and lying down
zh: 我最近老是胃部烧灼感，吃了饭更重，平躺也会

en: Pain behind sternum when swallowing, like something scraping, what
zh: 我吃饭吞咽时胸骨后疼，像有东西划过去，是什么

en: Feel gas moving in chest, better after burping or farting
zh: 我最近老觉得胸口有气窜，打嗝或放屁后舒服

en: I woke up suddenly in the middle of the night with cramps. I felt better after diarrhea. It hurt again this morning. What happened?
zh: 我昨天半夜突然肚子疼醒，一阵一阵的绞痛，拉完肚子就好点了，今天早上又疼了，咋回事啊？

en: My stool has blood recently. It's bright red, but it doesn't hurt. Do you have hemorrhoids?
zh: 我最近大便带血，是鲜红色的，但是不疼，是不是得痔疮了？

en: I always feel bitter in my mouth recently, especially when I get up in the morning. Is there a liver and gallbladder problem?
zh: 我最近总是觉得嘴巴里发苦，特别是早上起来的时候，是不是肝胆有问题？

en: Doctor, I always feel bloated recently, which is more obvious after eating. I also like to fart. Is it a gastrointestinal disorder?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得肚子胀，吃完饭更明显，还爱放屁，是不是肠胃功能紊乱？

en: I recently lost weight and only ate fruits at night, but my stomach began to sour. Is there a problem with my stomach?
zh: 我最近减肥，晚上只吃水果，但是胃开始反酸了，是不是胃出问题了？

en: I have been feeling stomachache recently. It comes after diarrhea. It will be fine. Is it irritable bowel syndrome?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子疼，一阵一阵的，拉完肚子就好了，是不是肠易激综合征？

en: I always feel bloated recently and I also like to fart. Is it a gastrointestinal disorder?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀，还爱放屁，是不是肠胃功能紊乱？

en: I always feel bloated and hiccups recently. Is it indigestion?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀，还打嗝，是不是消化不良？

en: Recently, I always feel that there is something blocked in my throat, and I can't cough it out or swallow it. It's more obvious after eating. Sometimes I even reflux acid. Is it reflux?
zh: 我最近总是觉得嗓子眼里有东西堵着，咳不出来也咽不下去，吃完饭更明显，有时候还反酸水，是不是反流性食管炎啊？

en: My stool has blood recently. It's bright red, but it doesn't hurt. There's blood on the paper when I wipe my butt, and sometimes it's in the toilet. Is it hemorrhoids? Or bowel cancer? I checked Baidu and was scared to death.
zh: 我最近大便带血，是鲜红色的，但是不疼，就是擦屁股的时候纸上有血，有时候马桶里也有，是不是痔疮？还是肠癌啊？我查了百度吓死了。

en: I always feel bloated recently, which becomes more obvious after eating. I also like to fart. Sometimes my stomach grunts. Is it irritable bowel syndrome?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀，吃完饭更明显，还爱放屁，有时候肚子咕噜咕噜响，是不是肠易激综合征？

en: I always feel stomach pain recently, just around my navel eyes. It comes after a while. It gets better after diarrhea, but it hurts again after a while. Is it mesenteric lymphadenitis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子疼，就是肚脐眼周围疼，一阵一阵的，拉完肚子就好点了，但是过一会儿又疼，是不是肠系膜淋巴结炎？

en: Recently, I always feel bloated and hiccups. It becomes more obvious after eating. Sometimes I even turn sour. Is it gastritis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀，还打嗝，吃完饭之后更明显，有时候还反酸，是不是胃炎？

en: I recently lost weight and didn't eat at night, so I just ate an apple, but my stomach started to hurt. It was a faint pain. Did I get a stomach problem from hunger? What should I do?
zh: 我最近减肥，晚上不吃饭，就吃个苹果，但是胃开始疼了，是那种隐隐的疼，是不是饿出胃病了？我该怎么办？

en: I always feel bloated recently, which becomes more obvious after eating. I also like to fart. Sometimes my stomach grunts. Is it a gastrointestinal disorder? Can I eat some probiotics?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀，吃完饭更明显，还爱放屁，有时候肚子咕噜咕噜响，是不是肠胃功能紊乱？能吃点益生菌吗？

en: I always feel bloated recently, but it doesn't hurt. I just feel like there is gas running around inside. I feel better after farting. Is it intestinal obstruction?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀，但是不疼，就是感觉里面有气乱窜，放屁后舒服点，是不是肠梗阻？

en: Doctor, I always feel bloated recently, which becomes more obvious after eating. I also like to fart. Sometimes my stomach grunts. Is it irritable bowel syndrome?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得肚子胀，吃完饭更明显，还爱放屁，有时候肚子咕噜咕噜响，是不是肠易激综合征？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling stomach pain recently, just around my navel. It hurts a little bit. It feels better after diarrhea, but it hurts again after a while. Is it mesenteric lymphadenitis?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得肚子疼，就是肚脐眼周围疼，一阵一阵的，拉完肚子就好点了，但是过一会儿又疼，是不是肠系膜淋巴结炎？

en: Doctor, I always feel bloated and hiccups recently. It becomes more obvious after eating. Sometimes I even reflux. Is it gastritis?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得肚子胀，还打嗝，吃完饭之后更明显，有时候还反酸，是不是胃炎？

en: Doctor, I recently lost weight and didn't eat at night, so I just ate an apple, but my stomach started to hurt. It was a faint pain. Did I get a stomach problem from hunger? What should I do?
zh: 医生，我最近减肥，晚上不吃饭，就吃个苹果，但是胃开始疼了，是那种隐隐的疼，是不是饿出胃病了？我该怎么办？

en: Doctor, I recently brushed my teeth and my gums bled very seriously. Even if I didn't move, it would bleed on its own. Moreover, bruises appeared on my body for some reason. Is it leukemia? Scared to death.
zh: 医生，我最近刷牙牙龈出血特别严重，甚至不动它也会自己流，而且身上还莫名其妙出现淤青，是不是白血病啊？吓死了。

en: Recently, I always feel joint pain, especially my finger joints. I get up stiff in the morning and it takes half an hour to get better. Is it rheumatoid arthritis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是手指关节，早上起床僵硬，活动半小时才好，是不是类风湿关节炎？

en: Knee clicks when walking, no pain, need treatment?
zh: 我膝盖走路咔咔响，不疼，需要处理吗

en: Back pain with leg numbness, injured before moving stuff
zh: 我腰疼，带着大腿也麻，以前搬东西伤过

en: Pain in front of shin after running, worse on pressure, periostitis?
zh: 我跑步后小腿前面疼，按压更疼，是不是骨膜炎

en: Back stiffness in morning, improves with activity, what illness
zh: 我腰背疼，早上起来僵硬，活动后好转，什么病

en: Pain under rib edge, worse on pressure, fracture?
zh: 我觉得我肋骨下缘疼，按压更疼，是不是骨裂

en: Can't lift shoulder after badminton, ligament strain?
zh: 我打完羽毛球后肩膀抬不起来了，是韧带拉伤吗

en: Knee pain worse on stairs, fine on flat, meniscus tear?
zh: 我膝盖疼，上下楼梯更疼，平路没事，是半月板损伤吗

en: Back pain can't bend to wash hair, better lying down, herniated disc?
zh: 我腰疼，弯腰洗头都受不了，躺着会好点，是腰椎间盘突出吗

en: Sprained ankle 2 months ago still hurts walking, no X-ray then
zh: 我脚踝扭伤两个月了，走路还疼，当时没拍片

en: Buttock pain after sitting long, better standing, lumbar issue?
zh: 我每次坐久了屁股就疼，站起来就好了，是腰椎问题吗

en: Pain behind knee when squatting, fine walking, what
zh: 我膝盖后面疼，走路不疼，下蹲疼，是什么

en: Fingers can't bend when wake up, need to move first
zh: 我睡醒了手指头弯不过来，要活动一下才好，是怎么回事

en: Leg cramps at midnight, painful jump, calcium deficiency?
zh: 我最近老是半夜小腿抽筋，疼得我跳起来，是不是缺钙

en: Big tendon pain at back of neck when turning, stiff neck?
zh: 我脖子后面大筋疼，一转头就疼，落枕了吗

en: Pain at front of knee, fine on stairs, hurts when kneeling
zh: 我膝盖前面疼，上下楼不疼，跪着的时候疼

en: Heel pain worse with walking, better with rest
zh: 我最近老是脚跟疼，走路走多了更疼，休息就好

en: Heel pain first step in morning, better after walking, bone spur?
zh: 我早上起来下地第一脚脚后跟疼，走几步就好，是骨刺吗

en: Pulled back during yoga, pain bending, plaster no help
zh: 我做瑜伽时把腰拉伤了，现在弯腰疼，贴膏药没用

en: Hard immobile lump on wrist, bony?
zh: 我手腕长了个疙瘩，硬硬的，不活动，是骨性的吗

en: Pain between shoulder blades, worse after long phone use
zh: 我最近后背肩胛骨缝疼，尤其是长时间看手机后

en: Morning hand stiffness can't make fist, better with activity, rheumatoid?
zh: 我手指晨僵，握拳握不紧，活动一会就好，是类风湿吗

en: Night leg cramps despite calcium for a month, why
zh: 我每天晚上小腿抽筋，补钙一个月了还是抽，为什么

en: Pain when kneeling, fine walking, chondromalacia patellae?
zh: 我膝盖跪着疼，走路不疼，是不是髌骨软化

en: Heel pain first step in morning, better after walking, bone spur?
zh: 我最近老是脚跟疼，早上第一脚疼，走开了就好，是骨刺吗

en: Doctor, I always feel waist pain recently, especially after bending down to lift heavy objects. I feel like it flashes and I can't move. Is it a herniated lumbar disc? How long will I need to stay in bed?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得腰疼，特别是弯腰提重物后，像闪了一下，动不了，是不是腰椎间盘突出？需要卧床多久？

en: I always feel joint pain recently, especially my knees. It hurts badly when I go up and down the stairs, and sometimes it even cracks. Is it arthritis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是膝盖，上下楼梯的时候疼得厉害，有时候还咔咔响，是不是关节炎？

en: Doctor, I always feel numb in my hands and feet recently, especially my thumb and index finger. I wake up several times at night, and I feel better when I shake my hands. Is it carpal tunnel syndrome?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得手脚麻木，特别是大拇指和食指，晚上睡觉麻醒好几次，甩甩手就好点，是不是腕管综合征？

en: I always feel pain in my knees recently. It hurts the most when going up and down the stairs. I can't get up when I squat. I used to apply plaster, but now it has no effect. Is it time to change the treatment method?
zh: 我最近总是觉得膝盖疼，上下楼梯最疼，蹲下起不来，以前贴膏药管用，现在贴了也没啥效果，是不是该换种治疗方式了？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling joint pain recently, especially my knees. It hurts badly when I go up and down the stairs, and sometimes it even cracks. Is it arthritis?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是膝盖，上下楼梯的时候疼得厉害，有时候还咔咔响，是不是关节炎？

en: The bone behind my ear protrudes hard and asymmetric. Is it osteoma?
zh: 我耳朵后面骨头突出，按着硬硬的，两边不对称，是不是骨瘤

en: Carbonated drinks cause bloating and belching. Poor stomach function?
zh: 每次喝碳酸饮料就胃胀，打嗝，是不是胃不好

en: I have dry cough only when lying down which eases up standing up. Cough medicines barely help.
zh: 晚上躺下就咳嗽，干咳没有痰，坐起来或者站起来就好很多，吃了止咳药也没啥用

en: My complexion is always yellow with normal liver function test. What causes this?
zh: 我脸色一直很黄，眼白倒是白的，查过肝功能正常，别人都说我像黄疸，到底哪里出问题了

en: I have throbbing temple pain easily caused by lack of rest. Is it migraine?
zh: 总感觉太阳穴跳着疼，一抽一抽的，休息不好时发作，是不是偏头痛

en: My kid has intermittent periumbilical pain which fades soon with normal appetite and activity. Ultrasound shows nothing wrong.
zh: 我家孩子老说肚脐眼周围疼，疼一会自己就好了，能玩能吃，去医院查了B超也没事，到底要不要管

en: My knees ache badly in cold or changing weather. Could it be rheumatoid arthritis?
zh: 一到冬天或者变天，我的膝盖就疼，比天气预报还准，有时候脚踝也疼，是不是类风湿

en: Cold food triggers vasoconstrictive temple migraine.
zh: 每次吃冷饮就头痛，太阳穴跳痛，是不是脑部血管收缩

en: Ice water triggers transient frontal headache. Rapid blood vessel constriction?
zh: 每次喝冰水就头疼，额头痛，一会儿就好，是不是血管收缩太快

en: Painless patchy sole peeling worse in summer. Is it athlete's foot?
zh: 我脚底脱皮，一块一块的，不痒，夏天严重，是不是脚气

en: Easy bruising with normal platelet count. Is it high vascular fragility?
zh: 我腿上一碰就青，轻轻碰也青，查血小板正常，是不是血管脆性高

en: My nails are thin and sunken like spoons. Is it anemia?
zh: 我指甲盖中间凹陷，像勺子一样，还薄，是不是贫血

en: Rough oral mucosa stings when eating hot food. Is it oral lichen planus?
zh: 总感觉口腔黏膜粗糙，吃热食刺痛，是不是口腔扁平苔藓

en: Morning bitter dry mouth and bad breath can’t be removed by brushing teeth. H. pylori infection?
zh: 我早上起来嘴巴苦，口干，还有口臭，刷牙也没用，是不是幽门螺杆菌

en: Everything tastes salty to me. Is it taste disorder or menopause symptom?
zh: 吃啥都感觉咸，菜不咸也觉得咸，是不是味觉出毛病了，还是更年期

en: I’ve had metallic bitter taste in mouth for two months. Is it medicine side effect?
zh: 嘴里老有怪味，像金属味，吃什么都觉得苦，快俩月了，是不是吃了什么药的事

en: I suffer from itchy throat and dry cough which gets worse smelling smoke. Is it allergic cough?
zh: 我喉咙痒得不行，干咳，闻到烟味更严重，是不是过敏性咳嗽

en: Diarrhea after beer not red wine. Beer yeast allergy?
zh: 每次喝啤酒就拉肚子，喝红酒没事，是不是对啤酒酵母过敏

en: Intractable itchy peeling ear canal skin, external auditory canal eczema.
zh: 我耳朵里总是痒，用棉签掏也不解痒，还有点干皮，是不是外耳道湿疹

en: My leg skin is dry and scaly worse in winter. Is it ichthyosis?
zh: 我腿上皮肤干燥得像鱼鳞，冬天更重，是不是鱼鳞病

en: Dark strong-smelling urine due to insufficient water intake, liver fire manifestation.
zh: 最近总是尿黄，气味重，喝水少，是不是肝火旺

en: The skin on my finger joints becomes hard and waxy. Is it scleroderma?
zh: 我手指关节皮肤变硬，发亮，摸上去像蜡，是不是硬皮病

en: Hawthorn triggers acid regurgitation. Excessive gastric acid?
zh: 每次吃山楂就胃酸，反酸水，是不是胃酸过多

en: I crave eating ice cubes badly online said to be anemia symptom. Is that true?
zh: 最近特别爱吃冰块，一天能吃好几块，看见冰就走不动道，网上说爱啃冰是贫血，真的假的

en: My big toe joint gets swollen and painful after eating seafood without sprain. Is it gout?
zh: 我脚上大脚趾关节红肿热痛，没扭伤，吃海鲜后发作，是不是痛风

en: Painless movable axillary lymph nodes have swollen for months. Need biopsy?
zh: 我腋下淋巴结肿大，不疼，活动好，好几个月了，要不要穿刺

en: The veins on my back of hand bulge obviously when clenching fists. Is it ganglion cyst?
zh: 我手背上筋凸起，用力握拳更明显，不疼，是不是腱鞘囊肿

en: Thick earthworm-like veins pop out on my hands. Is it varicose veins and will they rupture?
zh: 我手背上的青筋很粗，像蚯蚓，是不是静脉曲张，会不会爆掉

en: All my fingernails have vertical lines. Is it vitamin deficiency or liver problems?
zh: 十个手指甲上都有竖条纹，一条一条的，表面不平滑，是不是缺什么维生素，还是肝有问题

en: I have several painless calluses on finger joints. Are they caused by long-time writing?
zh: 我手上长了好几个硬茧，不疼，在指关节处，是不是写字磨的

en: I need to defecate soon after meals with inconsistent stool form. Is this diarrhea?
zh: 吃完饭不到半小时就想大便，每天早上都要拉两三次，第一次成型第二次就稀了，算拉肚子吗

en: Hands swell stiffly after waking up and relieve with movement. Is it arthritis?
zh: 最近睡醒手肿，攥拳费劲，活动后消失，是不是关节炎

en: Morning facial and eyelid swelling fades at noon with normal urine test.
zh: 睡觉起来眼皮肿，脸也肿，中午就消，查尿常规正常，是不是晚上喝水的缘故

en: Sunflower seeds trigger mouth ulcers due to mechanical scratch?
zh: 每次吃瓜子就口腔溃疡，是不是瓜子太硬划伤

en: Irritant ingredients in onions easily cause gastric acid discomfort.
zh: 每次吃洋葱就胃不舒服，烧心，是不是刺激太大

en: Tender round axillary lymph node swelled after my sore throat. Are they related?
zh: 我腋下淋巴结肿了，摸着圆圆的一个，按着疼，前几天嗓子疼过，有关系吗

en: Combination skin with oily T-zone and dry peeling cheeks.
zh: 我脸上皮肤又油又干，T区油，两颊脱皮，用什么护肤品都难受

en: Red acne marks haven't faded for half a year. Will they stay forever?
zh: 我脸上有红痘印，半年不消，是不是永远不会消失了

en: Dark spots float in my eyes obviously against white walls. Is it floaters?
zh: 总感觉眼睛里有黑影，飘来飘去，看白墙明显，是不是飞蚊症

en: Painless black streak under nail without injury. Is it nail matrix nevus?
zh: 我指甲下出血，黑色一条，不疼，没砸到，是不是甲母痣

en: There are white spots on my fingernails. Calcium deficiency or intestinal worms?
zh: 我手指甲有白点，一小块一小块的，是不是缺钙还是肚子里有虫

en: Pitted uneven fingernails. Is it psoriatic nail disease?
zh: 我手指上出现小凹坑，指甲不平，是不是银屑病甲

en: My throat swelled up badly after barbecue, even swallowing hurts. I saw white spots in throat. Is it suppurative tonsillitis?
zh: 吃完那顿烧烤第二天嗓子就肿了，连吞口水都疼，照镜子看见喉咙里有好多白色小点，是扁桃体化脓了吗

en: My fingers are stiff and hard to clench fists after waking up, recover after moving. Could it be rheumatoid arthritis?
zh: 早上起床手指头僵僵的，攥拳头攥不紧，活动个十来分钟才好，两只手都这样，不会是类风湿吧

en: Lots of itchy red rashes broke out on my back and spread when scratched. Is it mite from dirty bed sheets or seafood allergy?
zh: 后背突然长了一大片红疙瘩，痒得钻心，越挠越多，是不是床单好久没洗有螨虫了，还是吃海鲜过敏？

en: My eyes are swollen badly in the morning and recover in hours. Mom says I drank too much water before bed but I didn’t.
zh: 早上起来眼睛肿得像桃子，但是过一两个小时又好了，我妈说睡前水喝多了，可我昨晚没咋喝水啊

en: I feel dizzy and black out after squatting to wash clothes for 5 minutes, need to lean on wall to recover. Is it anemia?
zh: 蹲下洗衣服不到五分钟，站起来就眼前一黑，得扶着墙缓十来秒才能看见东西，是贫血吗

en: I fart a lot recently which smells terrible. I dare not fart in elevator. My husband teases me but I eat normally.
zh: 最近不知道为啥老放屁，坐电梯都不敢出声，而且还特别臭，老公说我是不是偷吃了啥，可我正常吃饭啊

en: My right knee cracks when squatting and standing up, and aches on cloudy days. I’m only in my early thirties, could it be arthritis?
zh: 右膝盖蹲下去的时候咔咔响，起来也响，阴天还会酸胀，我才三十出头不会是关节炎吧

en: I’m worn out from overtime these days. My back head throbs nonstop and feels like blood vessels are bursting. Could my blood pressure be high?
zh: 这几天加班加到快崩溃了，后脑勺一直突突地疼，感觉血管要炸了，是不是血压高了？

en: Painless varying-sized white patches around kid's mouth. Is it pityriasis alba?
zh: 娃脸上长白斑，在嘴角边，大小不一，不痒，是不是白色糠疹

en: A painless hard lump on the back of my neck has grown bigger recently. Is it lipoma?
zh: 脖子后面有个硬包，不疼，好几年了，最近觉得变大了点，是脂肪瘤吗

en: Painless non-fading red spots grow on my calves. What are they?
zh: 小腿上长了好多红色的小点点，不疼不痒，压一下也不褪色，看着怪吓人的，是什么东西

en: My hands wrinkle severely after bathing for long time. Is my body weak?
zh: 每次洗完澡手上就起皱纹，比别人厉害，半天不消，是不是身体虚

en: A soft pedunculated painless flesh lump grows on my scalp.
zh: 我头皮上有个肉疙瘩，软软的，有蒂，不疼不痒，是什么

en: Lots of skin-colored soft painless small fleshy bumps grow on my neck.
zh: 我脖子上有好多小肉粒，肤色，软软的，不疼，是什么

en: A soft painless small yellow lump grows on my eyelid. Is it xanthelasma?
zh: 我眼皮上长了个黄色小疙瘩，软软的，不疼，是不是黄色瘤

en: A yellow spot on sclera grows slightly bigger these years. Will it affect eyesight?
zh: 我眼白上有个黄斑，不疼不痒，好多年了，最近觉得变大了点，会影响视力吗

en: I drool heavily during sleep with sour taste in mouth. Is it gastric reflux?
zh: 我睡着了流口水，醒来枕头湿一片，嘴里酸味，是不是胃反流

en: Easy midnight awakening and daytime fatigue. Is it insomnia?
zh: 最近总是半夜醒来，醒后很难再睡，白天没精神，是不是失眠

en: Numb big toe feels like wearing thick socks. Is it lumbar spine problem?
zh: 我脚上大脚趾麻木，像穿了厚袜子，没有受伤，是不是腰椎问题

en: Intermittent numbness spreads from neck to arms relieved by turning head. Is it cervical nerve compression?
zh: 从脖子到胳膊一阵一阵发麻，有时候整个手臂都麻，转转头会好一点，是不是颈椎病压迫神经了

en: Excessive coarse grains easily lead to bloating and flatulence.
zh: 每次吃粗粮就胃胀，放屁多，是不是肠胃消化不了粗纤维

en: Glutinous food causes stomach distension due to poor digestion.
zh: 每次吃糯米就胃堵，不消化，在胃里顶着，是不是胃动力差

en: Glutinous rice dumplings cause stomach stagnation. Poor gastric motility?
zh: 每次吃糯米粽子就胃堵，不消化，打嗝，是不是胃动力差

en: I feel dizzy and headache every afternoon. Is it due to no afternoon nap?
zh: 最近一到下午就头疼，昏昏沉沉，是不是没睡午觉

en: Diffuse distending headache with normal blood pressure. Tension headache?
zh: 最近总是头痛，胀痛，整个头都疼，血压正常，是不是紧张性头痛

en: Sweet potato causes bloating and flatulence. Indigestion?
zh: 每次吃红薯就胃胀，放屁多，是不是不消化

en: I used to drink milk fine but now get diarrhea and stomach gurgling. Is it lactose intolerance?
zh: 以前喝牛奶没事，最近一喝就拉肚子，肚子还咕噜咕噜响，是不是乳糖不耐受了，还有救吗

en: My ears feel stuffy like taking plane with poor hearing. Is it internal heat?
zh: 这两天耳朵闷闷的，像坐飞机那种感觉，打哈欠也没用，还有点听不太清，是不是上火了

en: The rib under my left chest hurts when pressing and coughing without collision. Is it costochondritis?
zh: 左边胸下面那个肋骨按着疼，深呼吸还好，咳嗽就疼，没磕过碰过，是不是肋软骨炎

en: I feel itchy crawling sensation on buttocks worse at night with no pinworm found.
zh: 最近屁屁上总感觉有虫子爬，还痒，晚上更明显，查了没有蛲虫，怎么回事

en: I have noisy moving intestinal gas with lots of odorless farts.
zh: 总感觉肚子里有气窜来窜去，还能听到声音，屁多但不臭

en: I have rumbling stomach discomfort relieved by passing gas. Is it indigestion?
zh: 总感觉肚子里有气，咕噜咕噜响，放屁后舒服，是不是消化不良

en: I hear gurgling sounds in my stomach without pain. Is it gastroptosis?
zh: 最近总觉得胃里有水声，晃一下咕噜响，不疼，是不是胃下垂

en: Painful writing-induced callus on index finger, need trimming or not?
zh: 我手上有个老茧，在食指侧面，写字磨的，疼，要不要削掉

en: Painless movable soft back subcutaneous lump, mostly lipoma.
zh: 我后背有一个包，摸起来软软的，不疼，推得动，是什么

en: My knees make clicking sounds when bending without pain. Are there bone spurs?
zh: 我膝盖弯曲时有摩擦感，咯咯响，不疼，是不是骨刺

en: Painless non-peeling white patch appears on my cheek. My friend says it may be vitiligo.
zh: 脸上突然出现一块白斑，在脸颊上，不疼不痒，也不掉皮，朋友说是白癜风，吓死我了

en: Bromelain in pineapple easily causes perioral stinging allergic reaction.
zh: 每次吃菠萝就嘴麻，舌头刺痛，是不是菠萝蛋白酶过敏

en: I feel heavy sore pain between shoulder blades relieved by massage. Is it fasciitis?
zh: 我后背肩胛骨中间疼，像背着石头，按摩后好些，是不是筋膜炎

en: The white part of my eyes looks blue. Is it iron deficiency?
zh: 我眼白发蓝，别人说不正常，是不是缺铁

en: Painless red spots on my hands fade under pressure and recover soon.
zh: 我手上有红色斑点，不疼不痒，压之褪色，然后复原，是什么

en: I have stuffy nose only after waking up in the morning. Is it allergic rhinitis?
zh: 每天早上醒来鼻子塞，起床后就好了，是不是过敏性鼻炎

en: I have allergic rhinitis symptoms with no detected allergen. Is it cold air allergy?
zh: 最近总打喷嚏，流清涕，鼻痒，查过敏原没查到，是不是冷空气过敏

en: Soy milk easily causes bloating and excessive flatulence.
zh: 每次喝豆浆就腹胀，放屁多，是不是不消化

en: Burning anal pain after spicy hot pot. Hemorrhoid flare-up?
zh: 每次吃辣火锅就肛门烧灼痛，大便后更疼，是不是痔疮发作了

en: I keep having runny nose and sneezing nonstop, plus itchy eyes. Colleagues think I have a cold, but I don’t think so.
zh: 一直不停流清鼻涕，还连着打十几个喷嚏，眼睛也痒，同事都问我是不是感冒了，可我觉得不像

en: Strongly irritating chive fillings easily cause stomach heartburn.
zh: 每次吃韭菜盒子就胃痛，烧心，是不是韭菜太辣了

en: Chives cause stomachache and heartburn. Gastric ulcer?
zh: 每次吃韭菜就胃痛，烧心，是不是胃溃疡

en: One-week persistent hiccups day and night, stomach qi disorder.
zh: 最近总是打嗝，吃完饭打，饿了也打，一周了，是不是胃有问题

en: I can't open my mouth widely with preauricular pain. Is it temporomandibular joint ankylosis?
zh: 我嘴巴张不大，吃苹果要掰开，耳前疼，是不是颞颌关节强直

en: Stomach pain occurs two hours after meals relieved by eating. Is it duodenal ulcer?
zh: 最近总是胃疼，饭后两小时疼，吃点东西就好，是不是十二指肠溃疡

en: Immovable painless bony protrusion on instep, rule out benign hyperosteogeny.
zh: 我脚上长了个硬包，在脚背，不疼，推不动，是不是骨肿瘤

en: Eyelid and facial edema after salty diet. Kidney problems?
zh: 每次吃太咸就眼皮肿，脸肿，是不是肾不好

en: I feel dizzy and weak with cold sweats lately, can't tell exact discomfort
zh: 这阵子总 toushu 发懵，浑身没劲还老出冷汗，也说不清到底哪里难受

en: I lose lots of hair lately and scalp itchy with flakes, what happened
zh: 我这阵子老掉头发，头皮还痒，一抓好多白色的东西

en: My skin feels itchy lately without rash, worse at night
zh: 我最近皮肤老痒但看不出啥东西，越晚上越明显特别烦

en: Sudden red itchy rash after detergent change, allergy maybe
zh: 我皮肤突然起很多红疹子特别痒昨天换洗衣液有关吗

en: Losing lots of hair lately when washing, body problem maybe
zh: 我最近头发掉得有点吓人，洗头一抓一大把，是不是身体出问题了

en: Suddenly got itchy red rash after changing detergent yesterday, related
zh: 我皮肤突然起了一片红疹子特别痒，昨天刚换洗衣液有关系吗

en: Dry tight skin and sore throat caused by long air conditioning use
zh: 夏季长时间吹空调皮肤干燥紧绷，还伴随喉咙干疼上火各类不适

en: Recurrent heat blisters around mouth corner with repeated relapse
zh: 嘴角边上反复长上火小水泡，好了没过几天又重新长出来反反复复

en: Perioral dermatitis with red rashes itching and burning from long mask wear
zh: 长时间佩戴口罩闷出唇周皮炎，泛红起小疹子还伴随发痒灼热感

en: Itchy red rashes on face from long mask wearing, sensitive seasonal skin
zh: 佩戴口罩时间太久脸上闷出红疹瘙痒，换季肌肤变得格外敏感

en: Painful red pimples on scalp with excessive oil after scratching
zh: 头皮上长了好多红痘痘摸着疼，洗头抓挠之后还容易冒头出油厉害

en: Skin dry peeling itchy in autumn and winter, lotion works for short time
zh: 皮肤一到秋冬就干燥起皮发痒，涂再多润肤乳也维持不了多久

en: Red hot sunburnt face peeling and dry next day after outdoor travel
zh: 出门游玩暴晒之后脸发红发烫，第二天还开始脱皮发干特别难看

en: Itchy peeling blisters on hands and feet, worry infecting kids
zh: 手心脚心长出小水泡，发痒还容易脱皮，会不会传染给家里小孩啊

en: Seasonal dry peeling itchy skin, skin care products work temporarily
zh: 换季皮肤莫名干燥起皮还发痒，涂护肤品只能短暂稳住一会

en: Recurrent stuffy acne around chin and mouth from frequent mask wearing
zh: 夏秋交替频繁佩戴一次性口罩，下巴嘴角位置反复滋生闷热痘痘

en: Red hot stinging sunburnt skin, fear subsequent sunspots and darkening
zh: 在太阳底下暴晒过后皮肤发红发烫刺痛，害怕后续长出晒斑变黑

en: Red hot stinging skin after sun exposure, fear sunspots and dark skin
zh: 户外暴晒之后皮肤泛红发烫刺痛，害怕后续长出晒斑变黑肌肤

en: Sudden itchy hot rashes spread fast, common ointments have no effect
zh: 身上莫名冒出成片小疙瘩，又热又痒越挠越多，涂普通药膏没啥用处

en: Itchy red bumps after eating seafood, allergy or skin disease distinction
zh: 吃多海鲜之后身上起痒疙瘩泛红，分不清是食物过敏还是皮肤问题

en: Increasing fat granules with moisturizing skin care products
zh: 额头和脸颊长满脂肪粒，护肤品越滋润脸上小颗粒长得越多

en: Swollen itchy lips with blisters after eating mango, judge fruit allergy
zh: 吃完芒果之后嘴唇红肿发痒起小水泡，这就是典型的水果过敏情况吗

en: Recurrent hard inflammatory acne on jaw, worse before menstruation
zh: 下巴两侧反复冒红肿硬痘痘，生理期来临之前长痘情况还会加重

en: Lots of itchy hot red rashes pop up, worse when scratching, common ointment useless
zh: 身上突然冒好多小红疙瘩又痒又烫，越抓越多，涂普通药膏根本没啥效果

en: Dry peeling itchy skin in autumn winter, lotion short-term effect
zh: 一到秋冬身上皮肤干巴巴起皮发痒，抹再多润肤乳维持时间都很短

en: Hard swollen big bump after mosquito bite, itchy easy to scratch infect
zh: 户外蚊虫叮咬之后起大包红肿发硬，瘙痒难耐还容易抓破皮感染

en: Hard swollen big bump after mosquito bite, easy infection from scratching
zh: 户外被蚊虫叮咬之后起硬肿大包，瘙痒难耐特别容易抓破皮引发感染

en: Severe skin stinging and large-area peeling after summer sun exposure
zh: 夏季户外暴晒之后皮肤火辣辣刺痛，后续还出现大面积脱皮现象

en: Expanding swelling and worsening itching from unknown wild insect bite
zh: 野外郊游被不知名毒虫叮咬，红肿范围持续扩大瘙痒越来越厉害

en: Itchy facial red rashes from long mask wearing, increased seasonal skin sensitivity
zh: 长期佩戴口罩脸上闷出红疹发痒，换季时节肌肤敏感度变得格外高

en: Excessive facial oil and enlarged pores with recurrent closed acne in puberty
zh: 青春期女孩脸上出油超多，毛孔粗大还一直冒闭口粉刺消不完

en: Recurrent closed acne on face, adjusted routine diet no effect
zh: 脸上反复冒闭口粉刺痘痘，作息饮食都调整了还是消不下去

en: Numerous facial fat granules, various skin care products fail to remove
zh: 脸上长出不少脂肪粒小颗粒，更换多款护肤品都没办法彻底消除

en: Recurrent facial acne despite adjusted routine and diet
zh: 脸上不停冒出闭口和红肿痘痘，调整作息饮食依旧不见好转消退

en: Itchy red rashes after eating too much seafood, allergy or skin issue
zh: 海鲜吃多之后皮肤起红疹发痒，属于食物过敏还是单纯皮肤问题

en: Dense white particles on both sides of nose, recurrent after cleaning
zh: 鼻翼两侧长密密麻麻白色小颗粒，反复清理之后依旧会重新长出来

en: My son rubs eyes lately and cannot see blackboard clearly, myopia maybe
zh: 我儿子最近老揉眼睛还说看不清黑板，是近视了吗

en: Sore dry eyes and intermittent blurred vision from long computer work
zh: 长时间盯着电脑办公眼睛酸胀干涩，视线还时不时出现短暂模糊情况

en: Blurred vision and easy tearing caused by long mobile phone use
zh: 长时间看手机导致视线模糊，远近东西看着都不清楚还容易流泪

en: Diplopia and photophobia from staying up late watching dramas, hard to relieve
zh: 追剧熬夜长时间紧盯屏幕，出现视物重影畏光，闭目休养也难以缓解

en: Dry sore blurred eyes from long computer use, simple eye protection ways
zh: 长期对着电脑眼睛干涩酸胀模糊，日常简单护眼方法有啥呀

en: Photophobia tearing and diplopia after all-night drama watching
zh: 通宵追剧之后双眼畏光流泪，看东西重影模糊休息一整天都没好转

en: Double vision blurred eyes from long phone use, hard to recover
zh: 眼睛长时间看手机出现重影视物模糊，闭眼休息也没法快速恢复

en: Double vision and blurred sight from long phone use, slow recovery by closing eyes
zh: 长时间紧盯手机出现看东西重影模糊，闭眼休息也没办法快速恢复

en: Sore blurred eyes from long screen watching, simple eye protection tips
zh: 整日盯着电子屏幕眼睛酸涩发花，日常简单好用的护眼小妙招有吗

en: I keep having insomnia lately and my mind won’t stop, exhausted next day
zh: 最近总失眠，闭上眼脑子一直转，第二天人都快废了

en: I cannot sleep lately with racing thoughts, very annoyed
zh: 最近晚上怎么都睡不着脑子一直想事情特别烦怎么办

en: I snore and wake up choking lately, feel dizzy daytime, lack oxygen
zh: 最近睡觉老打呼噜还憋醒，白天脑袋发懵，是不是缺氧了

en: I keep dreaming and waking many times at night lately, very tired
zh: 我最近睡觉老做梦，一晚上醒好多次，人特别累怎么办

en: Frequent dreams and waking at night, tired
zh: 我最近睡觉老做梦醒很多次特别累怎么办

en: Recurrent migraine induced by bad mood cold wind exposure
zh: 常年反反复复犯偏头痛，心情不好吹风受凉全都能诱发头疼发作

en: Recurrent migraine induced by bad mood and cold wind
zh: 常年偏头痛反反复复发作，情绪不好吹风受凉都容易诱发疼痛

en: Both temples ache badly, hard to relieve after long sleep and heavy headedness
zh: 最近两边太阳穴老是胀疼，睡多久都缓不过来，还总觉得脑袋沉沉的

en: Cold weather triggers neural headache leading to low spirits
zh: 天气一变冷就容易引发神经性头疼，疼起来整个人精神都萎靡了

en: Migraine triggered by cold wind with temple distending pain and dizziness
zh: 吹风受凉之后偏头疼立马发作，太阳穴位置胀痛整个人昏昏沉沉

en: Partner headaches with nausea, migraine?
zh: 对象老头疼还想吐是不是偏头痛

en: My head feels foggy lately and I keep forgetting things, what’s wrong
zh: 最近总觉得脑袋昏昏沉沉的，像没睡醒一样，还老忘事怎么回事

en: My partner keeps having headaches with nausea lately, migraine maybe
zh: 我对象最近老说头疼，还恶心想吐，会不会偏头痛啊

en: My eye keeps twitching these days and tired, is it facial paralysis sign
zh: 我这几天眼睛一直跳，睡不好还有点累，会不会面瘫前兆啊

en: My mood is terrible lately and I get angry easily, cannot control
zh: 我最近情绪特别差，一点小事就想发火，还控制不住自己

en: Want to cry lately and no energy for anything, depression maybe
zh: 最近总想哭，干什么都没劲，饭也不想吃，是不是抑郁了

en: Cold sweating and panic lately with poor appetite, feel terrible
zh: 我最近总冒冷汗，心里发慌，饭也吃不下特别难受

en: High post-meal blood sugar from excessive staple food intake without sweets
zh: 平时不吃甜食主食吃得多，餐后血糖居高不下该如何有效控制

en: Forgot to take hypoglycemic drugs hours ago, can take supplementary dose
zh: 降糖药忘记按时服用了，过了好几个小时还能补吃药物吗

en: Unstable fasting blood sugar, daily eating sequence adjustment 技巧
zh: 早上空腹测血糖忽高忽低不稳定，日常吃饭先后顺序有没有讲究

en: Crave watermelon with stable blood sugar, suitability for diabetics
zh: 血糖平稳之后忍不住想吃西瓜，夏季吃西瓜对糖尿病人友好吗

en: Blood sugar spikes after eating sweets on empty stomach, doubt sugar taboo
zh: 空腹吃了点甜食之后血糖直接飙升，糖尿病人真的一点甜都碰不得么

en: Low hemoglobin from long-term vegetarian diet without meat intake
zh: 吃素为主长期不吃肉类食物，体检发现血红蛋白偏低该如何食补提升

en: Take double dose of hypotensive drugs next day after forgetting to take it
zh: 前一天忘记吃降压药，第二天一早一次性吃双倍药量可行不可行

en: Forgot hypoglycemic drugs for two days, normal dosage taking on third day
zh: 连续两天忘记服用降糖药，第三天直接按量正常吃行不行呀
