zh: 我不是来看病的，就是想问问你们工资高不高

en: I don't want to ask anything, just testing you
zh: 我啥也不问，就是想测试一下你

en: I'm sleepy, will ask later after nap, bye
zh: 我困了，睡一觉再来问，拜拜

en: How to delete my previous consultation records?
zh: 我上次问诊的记录怎么删除

en: Can you see my previous chat history here?
zh: 你们这里能看到我之前的聊天记录吗

en: I want to ask, if I want to have a physical examination, do I need to be fasting? When is the best time to go?
zh: 我想问下，如果我要做体检，需要空腹吗？什么时候去最好？

en: Do you have wheelchair rental services in your hospital? Can I use it for the elderly with limited mobility?
zh: 请问你们医院有轮椅租借服务吗？老人行动不便可以用吗？

en: Excuse me, does your hospital have a nutrition department? I want to inquire about weight loss recipes.
zh: 请问你们医院有营养科吗？想咨询一下减肥食谱。

en: Stiff finger joints better after moving, pain worse on rainy days
zh: 手指关节早起僵硬活动一会才好转，阴雨天疼痛感还会明显加重

en: Stiff finger joints after waking up, worse pain on rainy gloomy days
zh: 每天早上起来手指关节发硬，活动一会才缓解，阴雨天痛感还加重

en: Stiff finger and wrist joints with poor movement in humid cold weather
zh: 天气潮湿阴冷的时候手指手腕关节活动僵硬，屈伸都觉得不顺畅

en: Numb hip and thigh root after long sitting, slow relief after moving
zh: 长时间坐着不动臀部大腿根发麻，起身活动好一会才能慢慢缓过来

en: Numb buttocks and thigh root after sitting long, relieve after moving
zh: 久坐之后臀部以及大腿根部发麻，起身活动片刻才能慢慢缓解

en: Lumbar soreness after sitting long, uncomfortable in all postures
zh: 久坐之后腰眼位置酸沉难受，躺着坐着都不舒服，简单缓解法子有吗

en: Numb buttocks after long chess and mahjong sitting, slow sensory recovery
zh: 久坐麻将棋牌之后臀部发麻，起身活动好久才能慢慢恢复知觉

en: Long phone use causes neck pain and concomitant back stiffness
zh: 日常低头玩手机时间太久，不仅脖子疼后背连带也跟着僵硬酸痛

en: Stiff neck from long phone playing, hard to rotate head, home relief methods
zh: 长时间低头玩手机脖子僵硬，转头都费劲，居家怎么快速缓解不适

en: Knee soreness weak after exercise hard to climb stairs, joint wear problem
zh: 运动过后膝盖酸胀发软，上下楼梯都费劲，是不是关节出现磨损了

en: Waist sprain after heavy labor with limited movement, uncomfortable in all postures
zh: 干重活不小心闪到腰，腰部活动受限，平躺侧卧都找不到舒服姿势

en: Lumbar muscle strain from heavy object carrying with limited movement
zh: 搬重物不慎拉伤腰部肌肉，弯腰转身活动都受限日常行动不便

en: Unusual cold and tight back, soreness worsens in cold wind
zh: 后背老是莫名发凉发紧，吹点冷风就酸痛僵硬，贴膏药效果一般

en: Dare not bend over after waist sprain, sore even lying flat
zh: 扭伤腰部之后不敢大幅度弯腰干活，平躺休息腰部依旧酸胀难受

en: Fear bending over after waist sprain, persistent soreness even lying flat
zh: 不小心扭伤腰部之后不敢弯腰劳作，平躺静养腰部依旧酸胀难受

en: Severe knee soreness after cold exposure, worse on rainy days
zh: 膝盖受凉之后就酸痛难忍，阴雨天疼痛感直接加重没法活动

en: Knee soreness weak after exercise, hard to climb stairs, joint wear worry
zh: 平常运动完膝盖发软发酸，上下台阶格外吃力，是不是关节磨损严重

en: General joint soreness and fatigue especially on rainy and cloudy days
zh: 一到阴雨天全身关节到处发酸发沉，干活做事都提不起一点力气

en: Cold stinging leg joints after temperature drop, poor stair movement
zh: 霜降降温之后双腿关节冰凉刺痛，上下楼梯屈伸活动都觉得不顺畅

en: Sudden knee stinging and cold pain after temperature drop, limited movement
zh: 气温骤降之后膝关节立马刺痛发凉，日常走路屈伸活动都受到限制

en: Stiff neck hard to turn head worse after playing mobile phone
zh: 脖子僵硬转头都费劲，低头玩手机久了格外难受怎么缓解

en: Cervical deformation from long desk work with occasional sudden dizziness
zh: 长期低头伏案工作造成颈椎变形，偶尔还会突发短暂性头晕眼花

en: Abnormal cervical curvature from long desk work with occasional dizziness
zh: 长期低头伏案引发颈椎曲度异常，偶尔还会出现一过性头晕恶心状况

en: Straight cervical curvature causes frequent dizziness nausea, poor massage effect
zh: 颈椎生理曲度变直频繁头晕恶心，尝试多种按摩方式效果都不理想

en: Straight cervical curvature frequent dizziness nausea, poor massage effect
zh: 颈椎曲度变直经常头晕恶心，尝试多种按摩方式效果都比较一般

en: Itchy fracture gap during recovery, wound healing or inflammation
zh: 骨折休养恢复期骨缝处发痒，不知道是伤口愈合还是发炎发炎了

en: Itchy fracture gap during recovery, healing or inflammation symptom distinction
zh: 骨折处在休养恢复阶段骨缝位置发痒，分不清是愈合还是发炎症状

en: Warm itchy fracture surroundings during healing, infection fear
zh: 运动摔伤骨折愈合阶段伤口周围发热发痒，害怕是发炎感染造成的

en: Wrist pain and numbness from phone use, tendonitis?
zh: 手腕疼得厉害用手机久了就麻是不是腱鞘炎

en: My wrist hurts badly and goes numb after using phone long, tendonitis maybe
zh: 我最近手腕疼得厉害，一拿手机久了就麻，是腱鞘炎吗

en: My calf keeps cramping lately waking me at night, calcium deficiency maybe
zh: 小腿最近老抽筋，半夜疼醒，是缺钙还是别的问题

en: After exercise yesterday my waist hurts badly when bending, strained maybe
zh: 我昨天运动完今天腰直不起来了，一弯腰就疼是不是闪了

en: Elderly at home fell yesterday and cannot straighten waist today, need Xray
zh: 我家老人昨天摔了一下今天腰直不起来，要不要拍片子

en: Knee pain after running, stairs painful, injury maybe
zh: 跑步后膝盖一直疼上下楼都痛是不是伤到了

en: My neck and shoulders sore with dizziness lately, cervical problem maybe
zh: 最近脖子肩膀特别酸，脑袋也昏，是不是颈椎病犯了

en: Been sweating cold with panic feeling and weak limbs lately
zh: 我最近总冒冷汗，心里发慌，还总觉得手脚发软怎么回事

en: My stomach keeps bloating and hurts after little food
zh: 我最近胃一直涨吃一点就难受

en: After hotpot last night, diarrhea and cramps all day
zh: 昨晚吃完火锅今天一直拉肚子还肚子抽抽

en: My kid vomited three times with fever today and looks weak, emergency needed
zh: 小孩今天突然吐了三次还发烧，精神也不好，要不要急诊啊

en: Movable painless fleshy lump inside mouth.
zh: 我嘴巴里长了个肉疙瘩，不疼，用舌头舔能动，是什么

en: Recurrent successive oral ulcers. Is it Behçet's disease?
zh: 我嘴巴里长溃疡，一个接一个，此起彼伏，是不是白塞病

en: Choking sensation worsens during sleep. Is it asthma?
zh: 最近总觉得有人掐我脖子，喘不上气，睡觉时加重，是不是哮喘

en: I’m 5 months pregnant craving crabs while my mother-in-law forbids it. Can I eat one or two?
zh: 我怀孕五个月了，特别想吃螃蟹，但婆婆说吃了会流产，让我忍忍，到底能不能吃一两只解解馋

en: My kid feels hot on back with normal skin temperature. Is it nerve disorder?
zh: 娃老说后背热，摸着不烫，但他就说烫，是不是神经有问题

en: More white frothy sputum in throat in the morning. Is it chronic bronchitis?
zh: 我喉咙里总有痰，咳出来白色泡沫状，早上多，是不是慢支

en: My kid always sniffs and clears throat habitually. Is it tic disorder?
zh: 孩子老吸鼻子，没有鼻涕，就是习惯性吭吭声，是不是抽动症

en: Back mole stinging from underwear friction. Is it dangerous?
zh: 我后背有个黑痣，穿内衣摩擦，最近有点刺痛，要不要紧

en: Painless limping due to thigh root pain in kids. Is it hip synovitis?
zh: 娃总说大腿根疼，走路一拐一拐，不发烧，是不是髋关节滑膜炎

en: Painless red hand hemangioma fades under pressure and grows slightly recently. Is it risky?
zh: 我手上长了个血管瘤，红色，按压褪色，最近变大了一点，要不要紧

en: Unremovable soft yellow dental plaque in kids. Enamel hypoplasia?
zh: 娃的牙齿上有一层黄黄的软垢，刷不掉，是不是牙釉质发育不全

en: Cold mixed dishes easily cause gastrointestinal discomfort and diarrhea.
zh: 每次吃凉拌菜就肚子疼，拉肚子，是不是生冷食物不耐受

en: Severe night sweats in normal kids, differentiate from rickets.
zh: 娃晚上睡觉头上全是汗，枕头湿透，白天精神好，是不是佝偻病

en: Itchy raised hard lump after wound healing. Is it keloid?
zh: 我手上伤口愈合后留了硬疙瘩，凸起，痒，是不是疤痕疙瘩

en: Dry peeling white patches on my kid's face improve with moisturizer. Is it tinea?
zh: 娃脸上有指甲盖大小白斑，表面干燥脱屑，涂保湿后好转，是不是癣

en: My kid is shorter than peers with normal diet. Should I use growth hormone?
zh: 我孩子比班里同龄人都矮半个头，吃饭还可以，就是不长个，要不要去打生长激素

en: My kid tosses about due to itchy buttocks and deworming medicine doesn't work. Is it eczema?
zh: 娃老说屁股痒，晚上睡觉翻来翻去，吃了打虫药也没用，是不是湿疹

en: My kid vomits when crying non-projectile and plays well afterwards. Is it gastric volvulus?
zh: 娃一哭就呕吐，但不是喷射状，吐完又能玩，是不是胃扭转

en: Brittle layered fragile toenails. Calcium deficiency or onychomycosis?
zh: 我脚上指甲变脆，分层，易断，是不是缺钙还是灰指甲

en: Aching wrist ganglion cyst, suggestions on surgery.
zh: 我手上长了个腱鞘囊肿，用力就酸胀，要不要手术

en: Foot mole gets rubbed while walking. Should it be removed?
zh: 我脚上长了黑痣，在脚底，走路磨到，要不要切掉

en: My kid gets rashes around the mouth after eating eggs which fade in an hour. Can he still eat eggs?
zh: 娃一吃鸡蛋就嘴巴周围红，起疹子，过一小时消退，还能吃吗

en: Persistent bruising and soreness at infusion needle hole for long time
zh: 在社区门诊打完点滴之后，扎针位置淤青肿痛很长时间消散不掉

en: My lips and mouth keep dry lately even after water, lacking something maybe
zh: 我最近老觉得嘴巴干裂，喝水也没用，是不是身体缺什么

en: Inflamed wisdom tooth swollen face hard to open mouth, will it worsen
zh: 智齿发炎半边脸肿痛张口困难，拖几天会不会变得越来越严重

en: After hemorrhoid surgery I still cannot sit from pain, recovery bad maybe
zh: 做完痔疮手术后还是疼得坐不了，是不是恢复不好啊

en: My period stopped after dieting lately, body damaged maybe
zh: 我最近减肥后月经突然不来了，是不是身体坏掉了

en: Heavy menstruation with severe dysmenorrhea cold sweat affect work
zh: 女生经期量大还伴随严重痛经，疼得直冒冷汗没法正常上班工作

en: Chest tightness and nausea in closed carriages in late pregnancy
zh: 孕晚期出门坐车容易胸闷反胃，密闭车厢里面难受得喘不上气

en: My mom’s blood pressure suddenly reached over 190 though she feels okay
zh: 我妈高血压很多年了，最近血压突然190多，但是人又没啥感觉怎么办

en: Will repeated consultation for same symptom affect doctors' judgment
zh: 非健康咨询：同一病症多次重复发起问诊，会不会影响后续医师判断结果

en: Night waking caused by great pressure, unable to fall asleep again in low mood
zh: 心里压力大经常夜里惊醒，醒来之后再也没法睡着情绪也很低落

en: My dad feels chest tightness and breathless climbing stairs, normal or not
zh: 我爸最近总说胸闷喘不上气，爬两层楼就累，这正常吗

en: Obvious blood pressure rebound within days after stopping hypotensive drugs privately
zh: 自己擅自停掉长期服用的降压药，短短几天血压数值就出现明显回升

en: Baby poop has blood streaks like red thread, loose stool
zh: 我宝宝拉屎有血丝，像红线的，大便稀，怎么办

en: Ate overnight watermelon, now abdominal colic, need gastric lavage?
zh: 我吃了隔夜西瓜，现在肚子绞痛，要不要去洗胃

en: Lost nearly 10kg in a month without trying, scared
zh: 我最近一个月瘦了快20斤，没减肥，害怕

en: Feel emotionally blocked and irritable lately
zh: 最近总感觉心里堵得慌特别烦躁

en: Can’t sleep lately and mind won’t stop, going crazy
zh: 我最近老睡不好脑子停不下来快烦死了

en: Can’t sleep lately and overthink once eyes closed
zh: 我最近总睡不好一闭眼就乱想

en: My dad has diabetes and foot wound not healing, serious maybe
zh: 我爸糖尿病好多年了脚上有点破皮一直不好会不会烂掉

en: My dad’s blood pressure fluctuates lately and he feels dizzy, serious maybe
zh: 我爸这两天血压忽高忽低，人还有点发飘，会不会出啥问题

en: Easy to gain weight can't control diet, prevent three highs hidden danger
zh: 自身属于易胖体质还管不住嘴，三高隐患慢慢显现该如何预防

en: High blood fat fond of greasy meat food, need complete diet taboo
zh: 体检查出血脂偏高，平时爱吃肉食重油重盐，现在必须彻底忌口吗

en: Extremely anxious, heart fluttering, hand tremors, see psychologist?
zh: 我感觉我焦虑得不行，心里发慌，手抖，该看心理医生吗

en: Lump at incision one month after hernia surgery, recurrence?
zh: 我做完疝气手术一个月，伤口鼓了个包，是不是复发了

en: Lump on face after hyaluronic acid filler, not resolving
zh: 我做了玻尿酸填充，脸上鼓了个包，不消，怎么办

en: Nearly three months after eyelid surgery and still swollen, worried it failed
zh: 做完双眼皮快三个月了还是有点肿，我现在特别担心是不是失败了

en: Glucose tolerance test result is abnormal near diabetes line. Can I reverse it without lifelong medicine?
zh: 体检说糖耐量异常，接近糖尿病临界值，我现在很害怕，有没有办法逆转，不想一辈子吃药

en: My kid always rubs eyes saying there are bugs inside with no signs found, also sensitive to light. Is he nearsighted?
zh: 我家娃总是揉眼睛，说里面有虫子，翻开看啥也没有，还怕光，白天老眯着眼，是不是近视了

en: This report has many red marks, serious?
zh: 我这个报告好多红字是不是很严重

en: Endoscopy says chronic non-atrophic gastritis, serious? Cancer?
zh: 我做完胃镜说是慢性非萎缩性胃炎，严重吗，会癌变吗

en: Many indicators high in physical report, confused which need recheck
zh: 拿到体检报告单好多指标偏高看不懂，不知道哪些项目需要进一步复查

en: Frequent urination day and night with normal urine test. Overactive bladder?
zh: 最近总是尿频，一小时去一次，晚上也起夜，查尿常规正常，是不是膀胱过度活动症

en: An unscratchable painless oral white patch has existed for a month. Will it turn cancerous?
zh: 我嘴巴里长了个白斑，刮不掉，不疼，发现一个月了，会不会癌变

en: Painless blisters filled with fluid recur on my feet. Is it pompholyx?
zh: 最近脚上起水泡，不痒，里面有水，挤破后流水，好了又长，是不是汗疱疹

en: Itchy red rashes on my waist form scabs and worsen in summer. Is it heat rash?
zh: 我后背腰部有红疙瘩，痒，抓后结痂，夏天加重，是不是痱子

en: I have large thick dandruff causing red scalp. Is it psoriasis?
zh: 我头皮屑大片大片，像盔甲，抠掉后头皮发红，是不是银屑病

en: A rough hard wart grows on my hand unimproved by vinegar soaking.
zh: 我手上长了个刺瘊，硬硬的，表面粗糙，用醋泡过没用，怎么办

en: I suffer long-term dry cough lasting one month after cold. Need radical treatment.
zh: 每次感冒后都要咳嗽一个月，干咳，半夜加重，吃什么止咳药都没用，求根治

en: I wheeze and breathe rapidly whenever catching a cold. Is it asthma?
zh: 每次感冒就喘，呼吸急促，有哮鸣音，是不是哮喘

en: Conditioning for dry pellet-shaped stools with incomplete defecation, intestinal fluid deficiency.
zh: 最近总是便秘，大便像羊粪蛋，拉不干净，是不是肠道缺水

en: Long-term maintenance for water-induced stinging cracked hand eczema.
zh: 我手上有湿疹，裂口子，接触水就疼，怎么办

en: Increasing painless brown flat bumps on face. Is it flat wart?
zh: 脸上长了很多扁平的小疙瘩，褐色，不疼不痒，越来越多，是不是扁平疣

en: I’ve had a big white mouth ulcer for nearly a week. It hurts badly drinking hot water and patches don’t work. Need quick relief.
zh: 嘴角长了个溃疡快一周了，又白又大，喝热水疼得我直咧嘴，用过那种贴膜也没好，求快点的法子

en: The bone beside my big toe bulges badly, rubbed red by sneakers and painful after long walks. Do I have to have surgery?
zh: 大脚趾旁边那块骨头越来越凸，穿运动鞋都磨得红，走路时间长了疼，是不是只能做手术了

en: Thick brittle crumbling toenails, typical onychomycosis symptoms.
zh: 我脚上指甲变白变厚，剪不动，还有粉末，是不是灰指甲

en: No improvement after 6-month topical amorolfine treatment. Need oral medicine?
zh: 我脚上灰指甲，外用阿莫罗芬搽剂用了半年，没好，是不是要口服药

en: New toenails still abnormal after 4-month terbinafine treatment. Need medicine change?
zh: 我脚上灰指甲，特比萘芬吃了四个月，新指甲还是坏的，是不是要换药

en: New warts grow nearby after self-cutting bleeding wart.
zh: 我手上长了个寻常疣，自己用指甲刀剪过，出血了，旁边又长了几个

en: Bleeding cracked fingertips worsen in winter. Is it Raynaud's phenomenon?
zh: 我手指尖裂口，出血，硬皮，冬天严重，是不是雷诺现象

en: I have oily scalp with greasy particles and severe hair loss. Is it seborrheic alopecia?
zh: 我脱发，头皮油，有黄色颗粒状油脂粒，一抠就掉，是不是脂溢性脱发

en: Itchy raised age spot on hand. Risk of canceration?
zh: 我手上有个老年斑，凸起，最近有点痒，是不是要变成癌了

en: I heard calcium tablets cause constipation and stones. Which type of calcium supplement is safer?
zh: 听说吃钙片容易便秘和长结石，我妈让我补钙，我有点害怕，吃哪种钙剂相对安全一点

en: There is callus-like lump with a black dot in the center on my sole causing walking pain. Is it corn?
zh: 我脚底长了个像老茧的东西，中间有个黑点，走路疼，是不是鸡眼

en: Burning anal pain occurs after eating spicy food. Is it hemorrhoids flare-up?
zh: 吃辣后肛门灼痛，像火烧，是不是痔疮发作

en: All-round moisturizing care for severely dry cracked blurred fingerprint skin.
zh: 我手上皮肤干燥，裂口子，指腹指纹都看不清，怎么办

en: Daughter 8 with breast development, need GnRH agonist?
zh: 我女儿性早熟，8岁乳房发育，要打抑制针吗

en: Tinnitus like cicada, hearing test normal, what to do
zh: 我最近老是耳鸣，像蝉叫，做了听力测试正常，怎么办

en: Son's foreskin can't retract, phimosis, need surgery?
zh: 我儿子小鸡鸡包皮翻不出来，是不是包茎，要手术吗

en: After 7 days of miconazole for athlete's foot, worse itching, what to do
zh: 我用了达克宁七天脚气没好，反而更痒了，咋办

en: Ingrown toenail painful when cut, paronychia, cure?
zh: 我脚指甲往肉里长，剪了就疼，是不是甲沟炎怎么根治

zh: 我最近屁股上长了个疖子，化脓了，自己能挤吗

zh: 天天坐着办公好几天不上厕所，肚子胀的难受，有没有温和通便法子

zh: 吃太饱之后胸口闷胀嗳气不断，总感觉食物堵在胸口下不去

zh: 吃完饭肚子就胀鼓鼓的还隐隐作痛，偶尔还反酸水，平时该忌口啥东西呀

en: My stomach bloated lately and burping after little food, serious stomach issue
zh: 最近胃一直涨，吃一点就顶得慌，还老打嗝，是不是胃病严重了

zh: 昨天喝酒后胃特别痛还一直反酸要不要去医院

en: Appetite very poor lately and losing weight, scared something serious
zh: 最近胃口特别差，看到油腻就恶心，人也瘦了好多有点怕

en: Cough with yellow phlegm, no fever, amoxicillin 3 days no change
zh: 我咳嗽有黄痰，不发烧，吃了三天阿莫西林没好转

en: My wife is 5 months pregnant, and her legs have been cramping very badly recently, especially at night. Is she suffering from a severe calcium deficiency? How many calcium tablets do I need to take?
zh: 我老婆怀孕5个月了，最近腿抽筋抽得特别厉害，尤其是晚上，是不是缺钙缺得狠了？需要吃多少钙片啊？

en: Two months pregnant and got cold, can take medicine?
zh: 怀孕两个月感冒了能吃感冒药吗

en: Stomach discomfort after aspirin, can switch to clopidogrel?
zh: 我吃了阿司匹林后胃不舒服，能换成氯吡格雷吗

en: I feel sleepy after taking this cold medicine. Can I still drive to work?
zh: 我吃了这个感冒药感觉更困了，还能不能继续开车上班啊？

en: I have hepatitis B, recent elevated ALT, need hepatoprotective drugs?
zh: 我有乙肝，最近转氨酶高了，要不要吃保肝药

en: Full of closed comedones on cheeks can't pop, what med
zh: 我脸颊两侧长满了闭口，挤不出来，用什么药

en: Red acne scars on face, what cream to remove
zh: 我脸上有痘印，红色的，用什么药膏能去掉

en: Dad insomnia, melatonin no effect, can take sleeping pills?
zh: 我爸爸失眠，吃褪黑素效果不好，能吃安眠药吗

en: Hemorrhoids flared after hotpot, bleeding, can I use Mayinglong?
zh: 我吃了火锅后痔疮犯了，流血了，能用马应龙吗

en: Burp and acid reflux after meals, what meds
zh: 我吃完饭就打嗝，还有酸水返上来，该吃啥药

en: Burning stomach after spicy food, what can soothe
zh: 我吃了辣的东西后胃像火烧一样，吃什么能缓解

en: Doctor, my father has had high blood pressure for more than ten years. Recently, he has been dizzy and has become erratic when walking. Yesterday, his blood pressure was measured to 170/100. He has not stopped taking medicine. Is it time to change his dressing?
zh: 医生，我爸高血压十几年了，最近老是头晕，走路发飘，昨天量血压170/100，他平时吃的药也没停，是不是该换药了？

en: My mother has had high blood pressure for more than ten years. Recently, she has been complaining of dizziness and walking like stepping on cotton. Today, she took her blood pressure to 160/100. She has never stopped taking medicine. Is this because the medicine is no longer working? Do you want to change your dressing?
zh: 我妈妈高血压十几年了，最近她总说头晕，走路像踩在棉花上一样，今天量了一下血压160/100，她平时吃的药也没断过，这是不是药不管用了？要不要换药？

en: After antibiotics stomach uncomfortable and diarrhea, medicine hurting stomach
zh: 吃完抗生素以后肚子一直不舒服还拉稀，是不是伤胃了

en: Accidentally drank alcohol after taking antibiotics, severe inner unease
zh: 吃了消炎类药物之后不小心喝了酒水，现在心里慌慌的特别不安

en: Taking anti-allergy medicine seasonally for prevention, immunity impact
zh: 每年换季都提前吃抗过敏药预防，长期吃会不会降低自身免疫

en: Private parts itchy and red though I keep clean, is it inflammation
zh: 男生下体有点发痒还泛红，日常清洁都做到位了，这是发炎还是别的毛病

en: I always feel something stuck in throat without affecting eating and drinking. Is it globus hystericus?
zh: 老感觉喉咙里有东西堵着，咳不出来也咽不下去，但是吃饭喝水不受影响，是梅核气吗

en: Brittle hair breaks easily when combing. Is it protein deficiency?
zh: 最近头发变得很脆弱，一拉就断，梳头断很多，是不是缺蛋白质

en: I get stomachache, belching and chest stuffiness when angry. Is it gastric ulcer?
zh: 每次生气后胃痛，打嗝，胸口堵，是不是胃溃疡

en: Severe headache day after drinking, liver problem?
zh: 我每次喝酒后第二天就头疼剧烈，是肝不好吗

en: Lately very irritable, can't control, related to menopause?
zh: 我最近脾气特别大，控制不住，跟更年期有关系吗

en: Feel sleepy after meals, is it blood sugar issue? Was normal before
zh: 我吃完饭后就想睡觉，是不是血糖有问题，之前血糖正常

en: Stomach pain after crab, fine before, crab not fresh?
zh: 我吃了螃蟹后胃疼，以前也吃没问题，是螃蟹不新鲜吗

zh: 我宝宝舌苔白厚，不爱吃奶，是什么问题

en: Kid blinks, grimaces, throat clearing frequently, tics?
zh: 我孩子频繁眨眼，挤眉弄眼，还清嗓子，是抽动症吗

en: Kid often complains periumbilical pain that resolves quickly, mesenteric lymphadenitis?
zh: 我孩子经常说肚子疼，绕脐周，一会就好了，是肠系膜淋巴结炎吗

en: Kid only drinks milk, no solid food at 1.5 years, malnutrition?
zh: 我家孩子不吃饭，就喝奶，一岁半了，会不会营养不良

en: Kid sniffs constantly but no runny nose, tic or rhinitis?
zh: 我孩子老吸鼻子，但是没有鼻涕，是抽动还是鼻炎

en: Baby 3 months, sour smelly frothy poop, what's up
zh: 我宝宝三个月，大便有酸臭味，还有泡沫，怎么回事

en: Vertical ridges and small pits in kid's nails, deficiency?
zh: 我娃指甲上有竖纹，还有点凹下去，像小坑，是缺啥

en: Doctor, I always feel my heartbeat is beating fast recently, and sometimes I feel like it's going to beat out. Is it hyperthyroidism?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心跳很快，有时候感觉要跳出来了，是不是甲亢？

en: I always feel sore back recently, especially after sitting for a long time. Is it a herniated lumbar disc?
zh: 我最近总是觉得腰酸背痛，特别是久坐之后，是不是腰椎间盘突出？

en: I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I turn my head. Is there a problem with my cervical spine?
zh: 我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是转头的时候，是不是颈椎有问题？

en: Feeling lump in throat, can't swallow or cough up, months
zh: 我觉得我喉咙有异物感，咽不下去吐不出来，好几个月

en: Feet burning sensation, worse at night, need cooling
zh: 我最近总感觉脚底发热，晚上更明显，要放外面凉快

en: I always feel flustered recently. Sometimes my heart beats very fast and my hands shake. Is it hyperthyroidism? Do I need to check my skills?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳很快，手也跟着抖，是不是甲亢？需要查甲功吗？

zh: 我吃了烧烤后第二天牙龈肿了，还化脓了，怎么办

en: Amoxicillin 3 days, fever gone but cough worse, getting severe?
zh: 我吃了阿莫西林三天，烧退了但咳嗽加重，是严重了吗

en: Constant throat clearing, itchy, pharyngitis pills no help
zh: 我最近一直清嗓子，喉咙痒，吃了咽炎片没用

en: Cough up jelly-like sputum with blood streaks
zh: 我最近咳嗽吐出来果冻样的痰，一大块，带血丝

en: Recently, I always feel that there is something in my throat that I can't cough it out or swallow it. Is it chronic pharyngitis?
zh: 我最近总是感觉喉咙里有东西，咳不出来也咽不下去，是不是慢性咽炎？

en: Recent breast discharge, light yellow, painless, serious?
zh: 我最近发现乳房有溢液，淡黄色，不疼，严重吗

en: Doctor, I always feel panicked recently, and my heart beats very fast. Sometimes I feel like it's going to beat out. Is there a problem with my heart?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心里发慌，心跳很快，有时候感觉要跳出来了，是不是心脏出问题了？

en: Doctor, I always feel panicked recently. It's the kind of sudden heartbeat that feels like it's going to beat out. It'll get better in a few minutes. It can have attacks several times a day. Is there a heart problem?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心里发慌，就是那种突然一下心跳加速，感觉要跳出来了，过几分钟又好了，一天能发作好几次，是不是心脏有问题？

en: Always feel someone whispering in ear but can't hear words
zh: 我最近总感觉有人在耳边说话，但我听不清说的啥

en: I always feel particularly anxious recently, my heart is beating fast, and my palms are sweating. Do I have anxiety disorder?
zh: 我最近总是觉得特别焦虑，心跳很快，手心出汗，是不是得了焦虑症？

en: I have always felt panicked recently, just like the feeling of not falling down in my heart. Sometimes I lie in bed at night with my heart beating loudly and I can't sleep over and over. Is this cardiac neurosis?
zh: 我最近总是感觉心慌慌的，就是那种心里没着没落的感觉，有时候晚上躺床上心跳得咚咚响，翻来覆去睡不着，是不是心脏神经官能症啊？

en: Mom over 60 says ants crawling on skin but nothing there
zh: 我妈六十多了，总是说身上有蚂蚁爬，但啥也没有

en: Red blood vessels on face, red nose, rosacea?
zh: 我脸上有红血丝，还有红鼻头，是不是酒糟鼻

en: Vertical ridges on nails lately, deficiency?
zh: 我最近指甲上出现了好多竖条纹，是不是缺啥

en: Hard thick patch on calf, itchy, scales when scratched
zh: 我小腿上有一块皮肤又硬又厚，还痒，抓了有皮屑

en: Many tiny flesh-colored pinpoint papules on face, no pain itch
zh: 我脸上长了很多细小的肉色丘疹，针尖大小，不痛不痒

en: Feet sweat very smelly, changing socks and shoes no help
zh: 我最近脚底出汗特别臭，换了鞋袜也没用
