zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得皮肤痒，特别是晚上脱了衣服之后，身上起那种像蚊子咬过的大包，过一会儿又消了，是不是荨麻疹？

en: Nauseous feeling, not vomiting, worse in morning, not pregnant
zh: 我最近总感觉恶心，不吐，早上起来最明显，没怀孕

en: Can't eat, nauseated by food smell, lost weight
zh: 我最近吃不下去饭，闻到饭味就想吐，瘦了好多

en: Frequent odorless belching, gastroscopy showed superficial gastritis
zh: 我最近老是嗳气，嗝出来的气没味道，胃镜是浅表性胃炎

en: Doctor, I have been feeling like a fire is burning in my stomach recently, especially when I am hungry in the middle of the night. Eating something can relieve it. Is this duodenal ulcer? Do you want to check a gastroscope?
zh: 医生，我最近老觉得胃里像有火在烧，特别是半夜饿的时候疼得厉害，吃点东西能缓解，这是不是十二指肠溃疡啊？要不要去查个胃镜？

en: Doctor, recently I have been feeling flatulence and farting a lot. Moreover, my bowel habits have changed. Sometimes I have constipation and sometimes diarrhea. Is it bowel cancer?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得肚子胀气，放屁特别多，而且大便习惯改变了，有时候便秘有时候拉肚子，是不是肠癌？

en: Recently, I have always felt flatulence and farting a lot, and my bowel habits have changed. Sometimes I have constipation and sometimes diarrhea. Is it bowel cancer?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子胀气，放屁特别多，而且大便习惯改变了，有时候便秘有时候拉肚子，是不是肠癌？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling pain in my joints recently, especially the base of my big toe. It is red, swollen and hot. It hurts when I touch it. Is gout? Can I take painkillers?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是大脚趾根部，红肿热痛，一碰就钻心地疼，是不是痛风犯了？能不能吃止痛药？

en: Fingers numb in morning, better after shaking, cervical?
zh: 我最近早上起来手指发麻，甩甩就好，是不是颈椎问题

en: Knee clicks and locks, then releases, meniscus?
zh: 我膝盖响的时候还会卡住，动一下又好了，是半月板问题吗

en: Shoulder blade pain, worse raising arm, frozen shoulder?
zh: 我后背肩膀缝疼，举胳膊也疼，是不是肩周炎

en: Inner knee pain, fine on stairs, hurts stepping up, where
zh: 我膝盖内侧疼，上下楼没事，上台阶疼，是什么位置

en: Mid-back pain worse bending, better straightening, X-ray no fracture
zh: 我最近后腰正中间疼，弯腰时加重，直起来好点，拍片没骨折

en: I always feel waist pain recently, especially after bending down to lift heavy objects. It seems to flash and I can't move. Is it a herniated lumbar disc? How long will I need to stay in bed?
zh: 我最近总是觉得腰疼，特别是弯腰提重物后，像闪了一下，动不了，是不是腰椎间盘突出？需要卧床多久？

en: I can cough up stinky yellow-white particles from throat. Are they tonsil stones?
zh: 我喉咙里有结石，咳出来黄白色颗粒，恶臭，是不是扁桃体结石

en: Recurrent mouth ulcers from eating sunflower seeds, dual causes of scratch and internal heat.
zh: 每次吃瓜子就口腔溃疡，是不是瓜子壳划伤还是上火

en: Hot palms and soles needing cool objects at night. Is it yin deficiency?
zh: 最近手心发热，脚心也热，晚上要贴凉的东西，是不是阴虚

en: I feel exhausted all day even with enough sleep. Is it insufficient qi and blood?
zh: 感觉浑身没劲，上班坐那都想趴着，晚上睡足八小时，白天还是累，是不是气血不足

en: My left eyelid has been twitching for days. Am I going to have a stroke?
zh: 最近左眼皮总跳，跳了好几天，是不是要中风了

en: Shrunken softened lipoma, malignant transformation?
zh: 我手上有个脂肪瘤，最近变软了，变小了，是不是恶变了

en: There is a smooth white patch on my face without dandruff. Is it early vitiligo?
zh: 我脸上有一小块皮肤发白，表面光滑，没有皮屑，是不是白癜风早期

en: Excessive bean products easily cause gastrointestinal flatulence.
zh: 每次吃豆制品就肚子胀，放屁多，是不是消化不良

en: Itchy skin without rash, worse at night
zh: 皮肤痒但没疹子晚上更严重怎么办

en: Increasing flat warts on body, painless but unsightly, removal ways
zh: 身上长的扁平疣越来越多，不痛不痒就是看着难看，不知道咋去掉

en: Rapidly spreading swelling and persistent itching after poisonous insect bite
zh: 郊外游玩被毒蚊虫叮咬之后红肿扩散快，瘙痒灼热感一直消散不掉

en: Fasting blood sugar unstable, any rules for daily eating order
zh: 空腹测量血糖数值忽高忽低不稳定，日常吃饭顺序有没有讲究

en: Missed hypoglycemic medicine for hours, supplementary dosage taking rules
zh: 忘记按时服用降糖药物，错过好几个小时之后还能不能补服药量

en: Elders have weak legs and get tired easily, needed nutritional supplements
zh: 老人走路腿脚发软无力，走一小段路就累得慌，需要补点什么营养

en: Nausea after taking cod liver oil, continue?
zh: 我吃了鱼肝油后恶心，还能继续吃吗

en: Insomnia and palpitations after diet pills, continue?
zh: 我吃了减肥药后失眠，心慌，还能吃吗

en: Liver enzymes higher after a month of hepatoprotective pills
zh: 我吃了一个月护肝片，转氨酶没降反而高了，怎么回事

en: Melasma got darker after hydroquinone cream, what to do
zh: 我脸上黄褐斑用了氢醌乳膏，反而变黑了，怎么办

en: After a month on metformin, stomach upset, can switch?
zh: 我吃了一个月的二甲双胍，胃不舒服，能换成别的吗

en: Two days of azithromycin, diarrhea, continue?
zh: 我吃了两天的阿奇霉素，拉肚子，还要继续吃吗

en: On BP meds half year, recent night cough, related to med?
zh: 我吃了半年的降压药，最近晚上老咳嗽，和药有关系吗

en: Doctor, I recently took that antihypertensive drug (amlodipine), and my ankles were as swollen as steamed buns. I had trouble taking off my shoes at night. Is the drug too strong? Can I change to another medicine myself?
zh: 医生，我最近吃那个降压药（氨氯地平），脚脖子肿得像发面馒头一样，晚上脱鞋都费劲，这是不是药劲太大了？能不能自己换别的药？

en: My computer blue-screened, can you fix it?
zh: 我电脑蓝屏了，你能修吗

en: I don't want to chat today, will ask tomorrow, will you remember me?
zh: 我今天不想聊了，明天再问，你们会记住我吗

en: Tired, going to sleep, will ask tomorrow, good night
zh: 我困了，先睡了，明天再问，晚安

en: I want to ask, if I want to have surgery, do I need to be hospitalized in advance? How long will you stay?
zh: 我想问下，如果我要做手术，需要提前住院吗？大概住几天？

en: Had heart stent, can I drink alcohol, just a little?
zh: 我做了心脏支架，能喝酒吗，偶尔喝一点

en: Persistent lumbago discomfort, bad after sitting or standing long, plaster effect unstable
zh: 腰后面老是酸沉难受，久坐久站都不行，贴膏药效果时好时坏的

en: Itching and fever around fracture wound during healing, judge recovery or infection
zh: 运动骨折愈合期伤口周边发痒发热，分不清是愈合良好还是发炎化脓

en: My kid keeps getting repeated fever these days, I’m worried maybe pneumonia?
zh: 孩子这两天一直反复发烧，退了又烧，我有点慌，不知道是不是肺炎了

en: My child says chest hurts lately but gets better soon, heart disease maybe
zh: 我家小孩最近老说胸口疼，但一会又好了，会不会心脏病

en: My son keeps saying stomach pain but still plays, fake or stomach issue
zh: 我儿子最近老说肚子疼但是还能玩，会不会是装的还是肠胃问题

en: My 3-year-old kid has runny nose and low fever, refuses food, can I give random medicine
zh: 家里三岁小孩总流清鼻涕还反复低烧，不爱吃饭哭闹不停，能随便喂药吗

en: One side of my kid's nose is always stuffy, changing with sleeping posture. Is it rhinitis?
zh: 娃鼻子总有一边不通气，睡觉往哪边侧哪边鼻子就塞，是不是鼻炎

en: My kid claims stomachache at meal time but eats snacks well. Is he pretending?
zh: 娃不爱吃饭，一到饭点就说肚子疼，但吃零食就没事，是不是装的

en: My kid refuses meals with stomachache which disappears while playing. Is it pretended or real pain?
zh: 孩子总说不爱吃饭，一到饭点就说肚子疼，玩起来就没事，是惯的还是真有病

en: Throat foreign body sensation unaffected by meals, chronic pharyngitis.
zh: 娃总说喉咙里有东西，咳不出来，吃饭没事，是不是咽炎

en: My kid has frontal headache especially in afternoon or after watching TV. Is it myopia?
zh: 娃总喊头痛，特别是下午或者看电视之后，额头疼，是不是近视了

en: My kid feels chest tightness relieved by deep sighs with normal check results.
zh: 孩子总说胸闷，长出气才舒服，查了心电图和心肌酶没事，是不是长叹气综合征

en: My 2-year-old kid only speaks simple words and understands everything else. Is it language delay?
zh: 我家孩子两岁三个月了，只会叫爸爸妈妈，其他一个字也不说，跟他说啥都懂，就是不说，是语言发育迟缓吗

en: My kid has split thin urine stream without pain. Is it a serious problem?
zh: 娃尿尿分叉，尿线细，不疼，要不要紧

en: Bulging private part with thin weak urine stream in kid. Is it phimosis?
zh: 娃尿尿时鼓包，尿线细，尿不远，是不是包茎

en: Two non-fading purple patches appear on my kid's legs with normal platelet test.
zh: 娃腿上有两个紫斑，按压不褪色，没有磕碰，查血小板正常，是什么

en: My kid has leg pain only during fever. Is it osteomyelitis?
zh: 孩子每次发烧就说腿疼，不烧了就不疼，是不是骨髓炎

en: Rattling phlegm sound without cough in kids. Laryngomalacia?
zh: 娃的喉咙里有痰，呼噜呼噜响，不咳嗽，是不是喉软骨发育不良

en: Painless odorless clear ear discharge in kids. Otitis media?
zh: 娃的耳朵里流水，无色无味，不疼，是不是中耳炎

en: There is smelly yellow discharge in my kid's ear without pain. Is it external ear eczema?
zh: 娃耳朵里有臭味，黄色黏稠物，不疼，是不是外耳道湿疹

en: My kid grinds teeth at night and bites nails in daytime with poor concentration. Is it tic disorder?
zh: 娃晚上磨牙，白天咬指甲，注意力不集中，是不是抽动症

en: Kid wakes up crying hard to soothe at night. Is it calcium deficiency?
zh: 娃晚上容易惊醒，哭闹，怎么哄都不行，是不是缺钙

en: My 18-month-old kid can’t stand steadily while peers can run. Is it developmental delay?
zh: 娃一岁半，还不会走路，扶站都晃晃悠悠，同龄的都会跑了，是不是发育迟缓

en: My kid tenses up all over when excited which relieves in seconds. Is it epilepsy?
zh: 娃一激动就全身发紧，拳头握紧，咬牙，几秒就好，是不是癫痫

en: Severe vomiting after kid's crying with quick recovery, cardia relaxation.
zh: 娃一哭就吐，胃里的东西全吐出来，吐完就好，是不是贲门松弛

en: Dark tea-colored urine without yellow sclera. Is it internal heat?
zh: 最近尿黄，像浓茶，眼睛不黄，是不是上火

en: My kid feels hot soles liking cold ground and stretching feet out while sleeping. Food accumulation?
zh: 孩子老说脚心热，想踩凉地板，晚上睡觉要把脚伸外面，是积食还是什么

en: Kid likes stepping on cold floor due to hot soles even in winter. Is it yin deficiency?
zh: 娃总说脚心热，要踩地板，冬天也这样，是不是阴虚

en: Anger triggers severe gastric spasm which fades away after calming down. Is it neurological?
zh: 每次生气就胃痉挛，疼得打滚，气消了就不疼，是不是神经性的

en: My kid walks unsteadily, falls easily and can't stop running. Is it sensory integration dysfunction?
zh: 娃走路不稳，容易摔跤，跑了就停不下来，是不是感统失调

en: Painless postauricular lymph node enlargement for months, medical check-up advised.
zh: 娃耳朵后面淋巴结肿了一个包，不疼，好几个月了，要不要查

en: Several movable painless lymph nodes swell behind my kid's ears. Is it serious?
zh: 娃耳朵后面淋巴结肿了好几个，能活动，不疼，查了血没事，要不要紧

en: General fatigue with normal check-ups belongs to chronic fatigue syndrome.
zh: 最近总是浑身乏力，注意力不集中，查了各项正常，是不是慢性疲劳

en: My kid gets itchy wheals that recur after stopping medicine. Is it chronic urticaria?
zh: 娃身上起风团，痒，吃了西替利嗪好了，停药又发，是不是慢性荨麻疹

en: Recurrent spreading flat warts after laser removal. Is it low immunity?
zh: 我手上扁平疣，用激光打了又长，越来越多，是不是免疫太差

en: My kid has sore throat with white spots on tonsils without fever. Are they tonsil stones?
zh: 娃老说喉咙痛，扁桃体上有白色小点，不发烧，是不是扁桃体结石

en: My kid keeps blinking and wrinkling nose. Teacher suspects ADHD, need medical consultation?
zh: 我家孩子总是不停眨眼睛，还挤鼻子，说了也不听，老师怀疑是多动症，要不要去看医生

en: Excessively wrinkled hand skin especially after soaking. Is it caused by water shortage?
zh: 我手上皮肤皱皱的，泡水后更明显，比别人厉害，是不是缺水

en: I have a painful hard lump in my palm. Is it tenosynovitis?
zh: 我手上长了个硬疙瘩，在掌心里，按着疼，像里面有东西，是不是腱鞘炎

en: Severe abdominal pain before defecation relieves afterwards. Is it irritable bowel syndrome?
zh: 每次想大便时肚子剧痛，拉完就好，是不是肠易激

en: Cracked thickened finger skin worsens touching detergent. Is it occupational dermatitis?
zh: 我手指关节处皮肤变硬，皲裂，接触洗衣粉更严重，是不是职业病

en: Painless intact walking blister on foot. Should I prick it?
zh: 我脚上磨了个水泡，没破，走路疼，要不要挑破

en: Kid has yellow sticky phlegm and fever for three days. Is it pneumonia?
zh: 娃咳嗽有痰，痰黄黏，发烧38度，三天了，是不是肺炎

en: I feel nauseous at fishy smell not due to allergy. Is it psychological factor?
zh: 每次吃鱼就恶心，不是过敏，就是觉得腥，是不是心理作用

en: Obvious nasolabial folds at 28, non-surgical improvement ways.
zh: 我脸上有法令纹，才28岁，看着很老，有没有不用手术的办法

en: Kid has toothache without cavities, check tooth nerve or teething discomfort.
zh: 娃老说牙疼，但牙齿没黑，是不是长牙或牙神经问题

en: My kid always walks on tiptoes with tight Achilles tendons. Do I need intervention?
zh: 娃走路老踮脚尖，跟腱看起来紧，要不要干预

en: Poor effect of long-term oral medicine for onychomycosis, drug resistance?
zh: 我脚上灰指甲，吃特比萘芬三个月，新长出来的指甲还是坏的，是不是耐药

en: Distinguish rosacea from lupus erythematosus via facial papules and pustules.
zh: 我脸上红血丝，还有丘疹脓疱，是不是红斑狼疮还是玫瑰痤疮

en: Facial red blood streaks combined with seborrheic dermatitis. Is it rosacea?
zh: 我脸上有红血丝，鼻翼两侧，还有脂溢性皮炎，是不是玫瑰痤疮

en: My kid sweats heavily on head during sleep with cool limbs. Is it calcium deficiency?
zh: 娃睡觉老是头汗多，像洗头一样，但手脚不热，是不是缺钙

en: My toddler drools heavily. Is it teething or nervous system problem?
zh: 娃一岁多，口水流得厉害，围兜湿好几条，是不是要长牙还是神经系统

en: Heavy hair loss while shampooing without obvious thinning. Normal telogen effluvium?
zh: 每次洗头掉一大把头发，但头发没见少，是不是正常休止期

en: My kid feels numb feet especially after being pressed which eases by changing posture. Is it calcium deficiency?
zh: 娃总说脚麻，尤其是被压到的时候，换姿势就好了，是不是缺钙

en: Kid's foot numbness relieves after moving. Is it growing pain?
zh: 娃总说脚麻，尤其是坐久了，跑跑就好，是不是生长痛

en: Kid complains of ankle pain without swelling or limited movement. Is it growing pain?
zh: 娃总说脚腕疼，不红不肿，活动自如，是不是生长痛

en: My kid has knee pain only at night. Does he need an X-ray?
zh: 娃老说膝盖里面疼，晚上疼，白天不疼，要不要拍片

en: Causes of white nail spots, rule out calcium deficiency and parasites.
zh: 我手指甲上有白点，有人说缺钙，有人说长虫，到底怎么回事

en: Tinnitus worsens after staying up late and eases with rest. Is it nervous tinnitus?
zh: 每次熬夜后耳鸣加重，休息后好转，是不是神经性耳鸣

en: My kid wheezes with whistling sound whenever catching a cold. Is it asthma?
zh: 娃每次感冒就喘，呼吸有哨子声，是不是哮喘

en: Antifungal medicine fails to cure facial white patches. Could it be vitiligo?
zh: 娃脸上有白色糠疹，用了抗真菌药没用，是不是白癜风

en: Modern medical correction of old belief that facial white spots are worm spots.
zh: 娃的脸上有白斑，表面光滑，不痛不痒，邻居说是蛔虫斑

en: Ill-defined smooth pale patches in kids, mostly pityriasis alba excluding vitiligo.
zh: 娃手上长了白斑，边界不清楚，表面光滑，不是白癜风是什么

en: Long-standing painless hard lump on back grows slightly recently.
zh: 我后背长了个硬包，不疼，好几年了，最近长大了点，是什么

en: Unsteady gait and tilting dizziness, check cerebellum problems.
zh: 最近总是头晕，站不稳，走路向一侧偏，是不是小脑问题

en: My kid's legs twitch periodically during sleep. Is it epilepsy?
zh: 娃睡觉时腿抖，一阵一阵的，像抽筋，但没醒，是不是癫痫

en: My kid drools a lot with foamy saliva while sleeping. Is it epilepsy?
zh: 娃晚上睡觉流口水特别多，枕头湿一大片，嘴角还有白沫，是不是癫痫

en: Persistent teeth grinding and drooling in kids with ineffective deworming.
zh: 娃晚上睡觉磨牙，还流口水，枕头湿一片，是不是打虫没用

en: Enlarged painful finger joints improve after movement. Is it rheumatoid arthritis?
zh: 我手指关节粗大，晨起疼，活动后减轻，是不是类风湿

en: Migratory soreness between shoulder blades relieved by posture adjustment. Is it fasciitis?
zh: 我后背肩胛骨区域疼痛，像有气游走，变换姿势能缓解，是不是筋膜炎

en: My kid scratches itchy anus with pale surrounding skin. Is it eczema or fungal infection?
zh: 娃老说屁屁痒，挠得厉害，肛周皮肤发白，是不是湿疹还是真菌

en: My kid has intermittent stomachache with normal appetite. Is it mesenteric lymphadenitis?
zh: 娃总说肚子疼，但照常玩，食欲好，是不是肠系膜淋巴结炎

en: My kid walks pigeon-toed and falls easily. Does he need corrective shoes?
zh: 娃走路内八字，跑起来容易摔跤，要不要穿矫正鞋

en: Anterior knee pain worsens after exercise relieved by rest with normal X-ray.
zh: 娃总说膝盖前方疼，跑跳后加重，休息就好，X光没事，是什么问题

en: Post-exercise knee pain in kids with normal imaging, mostly growing pain.
zh: 娃的膝盖前方疼，跑跳后明显，X光没事，是什么

en: My kid has popliteal pain after exercise relieved by rest with normal X-ray. Is it growing pain?
zh: 娃总说膝盖后面疼，跑跳后明显，休息就好，X光没事，是不是生长痛

en: Recurrent painful thick foot callus. Tell corns apart from common calluses.
zh: 我脚上老茧很厚，用刀片刮了又长，走路疼，是不是鸡眼不是老茧

en: Painless diarrhea after eating cakes. Sugar or cream intolerance?
zh: 每次吃蛋糕就拉肚子，不疼，是不是不耐受糖或者奶油

en: Movable soft lipoma on back turns painful recently. Is it malignant transformation?
zh: 我背上有个脂肪瘤，软软的，可以滑动，最近有点疼，是不是恶变了

en: My kid has intermittent periumbilical stomach pain lasting seconds many times a day. Is it epilepsy?
zh: 娃总说肚子疼，绕着肚脐转圈疼，疼几秒就好，一天好几次，是癫痫吗

en: My kid snores with mouth breathing and poor concentration. Does he need surgery?
zh: 娃睡觉打呼噜，张口呼吸，白天注意力不集中，要不要手术

en: My kid snores with mouth breathing and low energy in daytime. Is it adenoid hypertrophy?
zh: 孩子睡觉打呼噜，张嘴呼吸，白天总没精神，是腺样体肥大吗

en: Dizziness strikes when standing up and fades lying down. Is it otolithiasis?
zh: 最近总是头晕，躺下不晕，一起来就晕，是不是耳石症

en: There are unremovable black spots on my kid's teeth without pain. Is it tooth decay?
zh: 娃的牙齿上有黑点，刷不掉，不疼，是不是蛀牙了

en: Persistent rotten apple smell in nose with no nasal discharge.
zh: 最近总是鼻子里有腥臭味，像烂苹果味，没有流鼻涕，是什么

en: Thin white worms are found in kid's stool. Are they pinworms?
zh: 娃大便里有白色小虫，细线状，动来动去，是不是蛲虫

en: My two-year-old kid speaks few words but understands orders. Is it autism?
zh: 娃说话晚，两岁只会说十个词，能听懂指令，是不是自闭症

en: My kid has coughed with phlegm for a month without fever. Is it whooping cough?
zh: 娃咳嗽一个月了，早晚咳，有痰，但不发烧，是不是百日咳

en: Kid feels weak in legs with poor mobility. Is it myasthenia?
zh: 娃老说腿软，上楼梯没劲，蹲下起不来，是不是肌无力

en: I still get leg cramps at night despite calcium and magnesium supplements. Is it electrolyte disorder?
zh: 最近夜里总是腿抽筋，补了钙镁还是抽，是不是电解质紊乱

en: Stuffiness and heartburn worsen when lying down after overeating. Is it hiatal hernia?
zh: 每次吃撑了就心口窝疼，烧心，躺下更重，是不是食管裂孔疝

en: Rapid heartbeat occurs after overeating and relieves after rest. Is it postprandial tachycardia?
zh: 每次吃太饱就心慌，心跳快，休息半小时好，是不是餐后心动过速

en: Bananas easily induce gastric acid regurgitation.
zh: 每次吃香蕉就胃酸，泛酸水，是不是香蕉太甜了

en: Anterior knee pain worse climbing stairs after exercise. Is it patellar chondromalacia?
zh: 每次运动后膝盖前方痛，上下楼梯更明显，是不是髌骨软化

en: Pale red facial mark darkens when kid cries. Is it hemangioma?
zh: 娃脸上有红色印记，哭闹时变深，平时很淡，是不是血管瘤

en: Callus-like painful growth with transparent center on hand. Is it corn?
zh: 我手上长了像老茧一样的东西，但中间透明，按着疼，是不是鸡眼

en: I feel sleepy all the time lately even at work, body weak maybe
zh: 我最近总想睡觉，上班都睁不开眼，是不是身体虚了

en: Excessive sleepiness at work, fatigue
zh: 最近特别想睡觉上班都撑不住是不是虚了

en: Always tired lately even after sleep, body problem maybe
zh: 最近总感觉累，睡再久也没精神，是不是身体哪里坏了

en: Sudden spontaneous sweating general fatigue, tired without heavy work
zh: 莫名身上出虚汗浑身乏力，没干啥重活也总觉得身心特别疲惫

en: Easy flustered and breathless after slight exercise, physical fitness improvement
zh: 运动量稍微一大就心慌气喘，体力比同龄人差太多该怎么提升

en: Severe dry mouth despite water, body issue?
zh: 嘴巴特别干裂喝水也没用是不是身体有问题

en: My throat hurts and I have a fever these days, sweating at night, is my cold getting serious and should I go hospital
zh: 我这两天嗓子疼还有点发烧，晚上睡觉老出汗，是不是感冒发严了要不要去医院

en: I feel hard to breathe lately though oxygen normal, lung problem maybe
zh: 我最近老感觉呼吸不顺畅，但氧气好像正常，是不是肺出问题了

en: Two weeks after surgery wound still hard and painful, normal?
zh: 做完手术两周伤口旁边还是硬硬的还会痛正常恢复吗

en: Found hard lump behind neck these days, not painful but scared
zh: 这几天脖子后面摸到一个包，不疼但有点硬，我特别怕

en: I feel wet down there with strange smell lately, maybe infection
zh: 最近下面总有点湿湿的还有异味，不知道是不是炎症特别烦

en: Half month after abortion surgery, going out walking and shopping permission
zh: 做完人流术后半个月，能不能正常出门吹风逛街走动游玩

en: Yellow smelly private secretions, frequent cleaning no effect
zh: 私处分泌物颜色发黄还有异味，日常清洁频繁也没能改善状况

en: Persistent damp private parts with peculiar smell despite changing underwear
zh: 女生私处经常潮湿闷热还伴随异味，更换贴身衣物也没能改善状况

en: Persistent cold lower belly pain after menstruation, hot compress ineffective
zh: 来完事之后小腹一直凉凉的坠痛，喝热水敷肚子也没啥太大用处

en: Mild private distending pain after sports, can't disappear after rest
zh: 女生运动之后私密处有轻微坠涨感，休息过后也没能完全消失

en: Three months pregnant with bad cold and blocked nose, can I take medicine
zh: 怀孕三个月感冒了鼻塞厉害，能不能吃感冒药会不会影响宝宝

en: Fever above 38°C, should I take ibuprofen first or go hospital directly?
zh: 发烧38度多能不能先吃布洛芬观察一下，还是说直接去医院比较好

en: Great mental pressure anxiety poor appetite gradual weight loss
zh: 长期精神压力大焦虑烦躁，食欲下降身形也慢慢消瘦下来了

en: Low mood no interest in anything, overthinking sleepless at night
zh: 最近情绪低落干啥都没兴致，夜里还总胡思乱想睡不着，会不会抑郁了

en: No energy and interest in life, overthinking leads to poor sleep
zh: 整日提不起精神干啥都无趣，夜里还爱胡思乱想睡不踏实咋办

en: Depressed mood and social withdrawal, no interest in everything
zh: 整日闷闷不乐不愿与人说话，对所有事情都提不起半点兴趣咋办

en: Hair loss irritability and memory decline from heavy high school study pressure
zh: 高二学生学业压力巨大熬夜刷题，相继出现脱发易怒记忆力下滑情况

en: My heartbeat suddenly fast lately then normal again, dangerous or not
zh: 我最近总是心跳突然很快，过一会又正常，这危险吗

en: Chest tightness worse with stress, heart issue?
zh: 最近心口发堵一紧张更明显是不是心脏问题

en: My child has been coughing for several days recently. He coughed very hard at night. I feel like there is phlegm in my throat but I can't cough it out. It sounds wheezing. Should I go to the hospital to take an X-ray to see if it is pneumonia?
zh: 我娃最近咳嗽好几天了，晚上咳得特别凶，感觉喉咙里有痰但咳不出来，听着呼哧呼哧的，要不要去医院拍个片子看看是不是肺炎？

en: Tick bite, removed it, wound red and swollen, need injection?
zh: 我被蜱虫咬了，已经拔出来了，伤口有点红肿，要打针吗

en: Doctor, I always feel a sore throat recently. Swallowing is like swallowing a blade. I also have a fever of 38 degrees 5. Is my tonsils suppurating? Do you want an injection?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得喉咙痛，吞咽像吞刀片，还发烧38度5，是不是扁桃体化脓了？要不要打针？

en: Doctor, I always feel a sore throat recently. When I swallow, I feel like swallowing a blade. I also have a fever of 38 degrees 5. Is my tonsils suppurating? Should I go to the hospital for an injection?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得喉咙痛，吞咽的时候像吞刀片一样，还发烧38度5，是不是扁桃体化脓了？要不要去医院打针？

en: My mother has diabetes. Recently, a skin on her foot has been broken and has not liked it. It's a little dark. What should I do? I'm so anxious!
zh: 我妈妈有糖尿病，最近脚上破了个皮一直不爱好，有点发黑了，怎么办啊急死了！

en: I ate hot pot and drank cold beer last night. I woke up this morning and had diarrhea three times. My stomach is still cramping. Should I go to the hospital?
zh: 昨晚吃了火锅又喝了冰啤酒，今天早上起来拉肚子拉了三次了，肚子还绞痛，要不要去医院？

en: Cyst behind knee popped, jelly-like fluid, what to do
zh: 我膝盖后面有个囊肿，挤破了流胶冻样的东西，怎么办

en: Gums bleed, obvious when brushing, could it be leukemia
zh: 我牙龈出血，刷牙时特别明显，会不会是白血病

en: Lately always want to cry, no energy, no appetite, am I depressed
zh: 我最近总是想哭，没精神，也不想吃饭，是不是抑郁了

en: Feeling flustered lately, as if something bad will happen
zh: 我最近心里发慌，感觉有什么不好的事要发生

en: Eating a lot but losing weight, freaking out
zh: 我最近特别能吃，但体重一直降，心里发毛

en: Keep panicking lately, scared of sudden death
zh: 我最近老心慌总怕突然猝死

en: Heart races especially at night lately, really scared
zh: 最近老心慌一到晚上更明显快吓死了

en: Keep waking at night with rapid heartbeat
zh: 我最近总半夜醒心跳特别快

en: Keep waking suddenly at night feeling panicky
zh: 我最近晚上总突然醒还心里发慌

en: Every night lately I can’t sleep and my mind keeps racing, almost breaking down
zh: 我最近一到晚上就睡不着，脑子里乱七八糟想很多，感觉快崩溃了

en: Blood sugar over 10 lately, losing control maybe?
zh: 血糖最近一直10以上是不是控制不住了

en: My dad with diabetes has darkened feet lately
zh: 我爸糖尿病最近脚有点黑了怎么办

en: My dad has diabetes for years and lately his feet are numb and painful at night
zh: 我爸糖尿病好多年了，最近脚越来越麻，晚上疼得睡不着是不是严重了

en: My dad has diabetes for years, small wound on foot not healing, serious or not
zh: 我爸糖尿病好多年了，脚上有个小口子一直不好，会不会烂掉啊

en: Easy fat gain with poor diet control, three highs early prevention 措施
zh: 本身属于易发胖体质还管不住嘴，三高患病隐患显现该提前怎么预防

en: I have diabetes for years, blood sugar out of control, afraid fruit raises sugar
zh: 确诊糖尿病好几年了最近血糖控不住，想吃水果又怕升糖快纠结得很

en: High uric acid fond of broth and beer, need to give up all drinks
zh: 体检发现尿酸数值偏高，平时爱喝肉汤啤酒，现在必须全部戒掉吗

en: High uric acid fond of broth and beer, total abstinence necessity
zh: 体检查出来尿酸数值偏高，平时爱喝肉汤喝啤酒，全都要戒掉吗

en: My son sees double, left eye slightly squint, eye or neurology?
zh: 我儿子说看东西有重影，左眼有点斜，挂眼科还是神经科

en: Kid 2 years old only says mama papa, speech therapy?
zh: 我孩子说话晚，两岁只会叫爸爸妈妈，要不要做语言训练

en: Always tired, blood routine and liver normal, what next
zh: 我最近老觉得累，查了血常规、肝功都正常，还查啥

en: Eyelids still swollen after two months, normal?
zh: 做完双眼皮两个月了还是肿正常吗

en: It’s been a month after appendicitis surgery and wound area still feels hard
zh: 做完阑尾炎手术快一个月了，刀口旁边还是硬硬的正常吗

en: My instep swells without pain, milder in morning and worse in afternoon with pitting edema. Is it heart failure?
zh: 我脚背肿了，不红不疼，早上轻下午重，按了有坑，是不是心衰

en: Pitting lower limb edema worsening in evening, first check kidney metabolism.
zh: 最近总是腿肿，按下去有坑，早上轻晚上重，是不是肾不好

en: I smell bad odor in my nose that others can't sense. Is it sinusitis?
zh: 最近总觉得鼻子臭，别人闻不到，自己感觉有腐败味，是不是鼻窦炎

en: I feel hungry easily with flustered mood and hand tremors. Hypoglycemia or hyperthyroidism?
zh: 最近总感觉吃不饱，刚吃完饭没多久又饿了，还心慌手抖，是不是低血糖还是甲亢

en: I get frequent bruises and gum bleeding. I’m afraid it’s leukemia.
zh: 腿上经常有瘀青，轻轻碰一下就青，还牙龈出血，是不是白血病，好害怕

en: I feel hungry soon after meals accompanied by flustered feelings with normal blood sugar test results.
zh: 最近总觉得饿，刚吃完又饿，还心慌，去医院查血糖正常，怎么回事

en: I feel extremely thirsty even after drinking plenty of water. Is it Sjögren's syndrome?
zh: 最近口干舌燥，喝水也不解渴，是不是干燥综合征

en: I always hear imaginary voices. Am I mentally ill? I’m so scared.
zh: 总感觉耳边有人说话，但转头又没人，别人都说没听见，我是不是精神出问题了，好害怕

en: I have frequent skipped heartbeats every day. Is it premature beat?
zh: 总感觉心跳漏了一拍，心里咯噔一下，一天好多次，是早搏吗

en: My sprained ankle is still swollen and painful after walking too much half a year later. Did the torn ligament fail to heal?
zh: 我脚踝扭伤半年了，还肿着，走路多了疼，是不是韧带断了没愈合

en: My menstrual flow decreases sharply with dark blood these two months. Is it premature aging?
zh: 最近两个月月经量特别少，两天就没了，颜色发黑，是不是早衰了

en: Painless black toenail without trauma. Melanoma possibility?
zh: 我脚趾甲变黑，没受伤，不疼，是不是黑色素瘤

en: I feel weak in legs and struggle climbing stairs with normal electrolyte results. Is it lumbar disc herniation?
zh: 最近总感觉腿没劲，上楼梯抬不起来，查了电解质正常，是不是腰突

en: Persistent sinus tachycardia at rest, distinguish physiological and pathological causes.
zh: 最近总是心慌，躺着心跳也快，查心电图窦性心动过速，是病吗

en: My period lasts over ten days with light flow these months. Am I approaching menopause?
zh: 最近两三个月，月经来了就不走，拖拖拉拉十几天，量不多，是不是要绝经了

en: I get stomachache and diarrhea the next day after eating barbecue or fried food. Is it cholecystitis?
zh: 每次吃完烧烤或油炸，第二天必拉肚子，肚子疼，是不是胆囊炎

en: The middle spine of my back is tender when pressing or straightening chest. Is it ankylosing spondylitis?
zh: 我后背中间骨头痛，一按就疼，挺胸也疼，是不是强直性脊柱炎

en: My period is 8 days late while it’s always regular. Two pregnancy tests show negative. Should I take a blood test in hospital?
zh: 大姨妈已经推迟八天了，平时很准的，验孕棒测了两次都是一条杠，心里慌得很，要去医院抽血吗

en: I feel vaginal soreness and dryness after intercourse. Is it inflammation or hormone disorder?
zh: 每次同房后下面疼，干涩，是不是炎症还是激素问题

en: Bloating and belching after eating noodles. Is it gluten intolerance?
zh: 每次吃面条就肚子胀，打嗝，是不是麸质不耐受

en: I have hunger symptoms like hypoglycemia with normal blood sugar. Is it insulinoma?
zh: 总感觉饿，低血糖症状，但测血糖正常，是不是胰岛素瘤

en: Fell a few days ago and waist still hurts, need scan?
zh: 前几天摔了一下现在腰还疼要拍片吗

en: Fasting blood sugar above 7, serious?
zh: 我这个血糖空腹7点多严重吗

en: My report has many red marks and arrows, looks scary, serious?
zh: 我这个检查报告上好多红字和箭头，看着特别慌，是不是很严重

en: Eye swelling and orbit pain, IOP 21, normal?
zh: 我最近感觉眼球发胀，眼眶疼，测眼压21，正常吗

en: 20 weeks pregnant, ultrasound says low-lying placenta, serious?
zh: 我怀孕20周，B超说胎盘低置，严重吗，要注意什么

en: LDL 4.2, need meds? No hypertension or diabetes
zh: 我低密度脂蛋白4.2，需要吃药吗，没有高血压糖尿病

en: CT says lacunar infarct, serious? Need hospitalization?
zh: 我做了脑CT说是腔隙性脑梗死，严重吗，需要住院吗

en: Doctor, my physical examination found that my uric acid is high, and I don't feel anything at all. Should I take some medicine?
zh: 医生，我体检发现尿酸高，平时也没什么感觉，要不要吃药啊？

en: Doctor, my physical examination found that uric acid is 580. I don't feel much at all, but occasionally my toes are a little sour. Do I need to take medicine? Or can you reduce it just by relying on taboos?
zh: 医生，我体检发现尿酸580，平时没啥感觉，就是偶尔脚趾头有点酸，需要吃药吗？还是光靠忌口就能降下来？

en: Back lipoma recently softer and smaller, need attention?
zh: 我后背有个脂肪瘤最近变软了，还变小了点，要管吗

en: H. pylori positive but no symptoms, need treatment?
zh: 我查出来幽门螺杆菌阳性，但没有不舒服，要治疗吗

en: Many abnormal urine test indicators, suspect urinary system lesions
zh: 拿到尿液检测报告单多项指标异常，不知道是否代表泌尿系统出问题

en: Full abnormal values in blood routine report, need detailed explanation
zh: 拿到血常规检测报告满页异常数值，完全看不懂想让人细致讲解下

en: Mild lower belly pain during pregnancy preparation, inner unease
zh: 备孕期间经常小腹隐隐作痛，没来例假也不是着凉，心里特别不安

en: Orange peel-like acne pits on face. How to repair them?
zh: 我脸上痘痘留下坑，像橘子皮，用什么能填平

en: Sunken acne scars unresponsive to scar removal creams.
zh: 我脸上有痘印，凹坑，用了好多祛疤膏没用，怎么办

en: I bit my cheek causing swollen painful lump. Can I prick it with needle?
zh: 我吃东西咬到腮帮子，现在肿了一个大包，有点疼，能用针挑吗

en: I got a blood blister in mouth caused by hard food. Should I prick it?
zh: 我嘴巴里长血泡，吃硬东西磨的，要不要挑破

en: My palms sweat heavily especially when nervous causing many embarrassments.
zh: 我手心特别爱出汗，一紧张就滴水，考试的时候卷子都湿了，手机指纹也识别不了，好尴尬

en: Painless pitting ankle edema worse in afternoon. Is it kidney problems?
zh: 我脚踝肿，一按一个坑，不疼，早上不肿下午肿，是不是肾不好

en: Persistent salty taste in mouth. Is it kidney disease?
zh: 我嘴巴里咸味，像喝盐水，不吃也咸，是不是肾病

en: Coffee causes stomachache especially on an empty stomach. Is it gastric ulcer?
zh: 最近喝咖啡后胃疼，空腹喝更明显，是不是胃溃疡

en: I always feel something stuck in my throat which eases after belching post meals. Laryngoscopy shows nothing wrong. Is it gastroesophageal reflux?
zh: 总感觉嗓子有异物，吃完饭打嗝后会舒服点，做了喉镜没事，是不是胃食管反流

en: Throat foreign body sensation eases after belching worse after meals. Stomach problem?
zh: 我喉咙老觉得有东西，打嗝后会好一点，吃完饭更明显，是不是胃的问题

en: Tender soft lump on back head. Folliculitis or infected sebaceous cyst?
zh: 我头部后面有个包，软软的，按着疼，不小心碰到更疼，是毛囊炎还是皮脂腺囊肿感染

en: I’ve been hoarse for half a month diagnosed as vocal nodule. Do I need surgery?
zh: 嗓子哑了半个月了，不疼不痒，就是说话声音嘶哑，用力才能发出声，做过喉镜说是小结，要手术吗

en: I got private itching and bean curd-like discharge after hot spring. How to cure it?
zh: 上周末去泡温泉，回来以后下面就开始痒，分泌物像豆腐渣一样，以前没有过，怎么治

en: I have recurring eczema on hands that worsens after touching water. How to cure it completely?
zh: 我手上有湿疹，反反复复，沾水就加重，洗碗必须戴手套，怎么断根

en: I have defecation urge but can’t poop with bloated belly. Constipation or intestinal obstruction?
zh: 最近一周总想大便，但拉不出来，肚子憋胀，是便秘还是肠梗阻

en: Increasing tiny painless red moles grow on my back.
zh: 我后背上长了很多小红痣，针尖大小，不疼，越来越多，是什么

en: I was scratched by stray cat with slight bleeding. Do I need rabies vaccine?
zh: 被小区里的流浪猫抓了一下，有点破皮出了一点点血，猫咪看着也正常，要不要去打狂犬疫苗

en: Physical exam shows slightly high blood pressure. I don’t want medicine, can I lower it via diet and exercise at 35?
zh: 体检说血压偏高，140多90多，不想吃药，想靠饮食运动调，有希望降下去吗，我才35啊

en: Fluctuating hard inflamed facial acne indicates internal suppuration.
zh: 我脸上痘痘红肿硬，疼，按着有波动感，是不是化脓了

en: A slightly red painless hard lump grows in the middle of my chest. Is it keloid?
zh: 我胸口正中间长了个硬疙瘩，不疼，有点红，是不是瘢痕疙瘩

en: I have a swollen painful boil on buttocks affecting sitting. Can I squeeze it by myself?
zh: 屁股上长了个火疖子，又红又肿，疼得不敢坐，坐着就像坐在针上，能不能自己挤掉

en: The skin on my elbow gets thickened and itchy and worsens after scratching. Is it neurodermatitis?
zh: 我手肘关节处皮肤增厚，发硬，很痒，越抓越厚，是不是神经性皮炎

en: Persistent rapid heartbeat with normal thyroid test. Is it anxiety disorder?
zh: 最近总是心慌，心率100左右，查甲功正常，是不是焦虑症

en: Enlarged painful lipoma on back. Need removal?
zh: 我后背有个脂肪瘤，最近长大了，还疼，是不是要切了

en: Comparison between aspiration and surgery for aching wrist ganglion cyst.
zh: 我手上长了个包，在手腕处，活动时酸胀，B超说是腱鞘囊肿，要不要抽掉

en: I get swollen itchy mouth area and blisters after eating mango. Is it allergy and can I never eat it again?
zh: 吃完芒果后嘴巴周围红肿，痒，第二天起小水泡，是不是过敏，以后都不能吃吗

en: The place 3cm above my heel hurts more when pressing or standing on tiptoes. Is it achilles tendinitis?
zh: 我脚后跟上方三厘米处疼，按着疼，踮脚尖更疼，是不是跟腱炎

en: Heel bone spurs cause walking pain seen on X-ray. Need surgery?
zh: 我脚后跟骨刺，X光看到，走路疼，要不要手术

en: Painful heel spur, is blocking injection advisable?
zh: 我脚后跟骨刺，走路疼，医生让打封闭，能打吗

en: My athlete's foot gets worse after using Daktarin ointment. Is it drug allergy?
zh: 最近脚气犯了，趾缝烂，痒，还流黄水，用了达克宁更严重，是不是过敏

en: Red swollen painful stye on eyelid unrelieved by eye drops for 3 days. What to do?
zh: 我眼皮上长了个麦粒肿，红肿疼，用了眼药水三天没消，怎么办

en: Baby diarrhea for a week, good spirits, need lactose-free formula?
zh: 我宝宝拉肚子一周了，精神还好，要不要换腹泻奶粉

en: Kid's tooth has black spot, no pain, need filling?
zh: 我家小孩牙上有个黑点，不疼，要不要补

en: Kid bow-legged at age 2, need correction?
zh: 我娃腿不直，有点O型腿，两岁了，需要矫正吗

en: Baby bites and then smiles at 1.5 years, how to correct
zh: 我宝宝总爱咬人，一岁半，咬完还笑，怎么纠正

en: Excruciating period pain every time, ibuprofen doesn't work
zh: 我每次来月经都痛得要死，吃布洛芬也没用

en: Got a blister from hot water, pop it or not? Apply what?
zh: 我手被开水烫了个泡，要不要挑破，涂什么药

en: Athlete's foot still itchy after month of terbinafine spray
zh: 我脚气用了盐酸特比萘芬喷雾一个月了，还是痒，怎么办

en: Peeling after antifungal cream, still itchy, continue?
zh: 我脚气用了药膏，皮褪了，但还是痒，还要继续用药吗

en: Can't fall asleep, mind racing in bed, what to do
zh: 我最近总是睡不着，躺床上脑子特别清醒，怎么办

en: Haven't pooped for 3 days, bloated, laxatives didn't work, what to do
zh: 我三天没拉屎了，肚子胀，吃了泻药也没用，怎么办

en: Drink lots of water still constipated, bananas no help
zh: 我每天喝很多水还是便秘，吃香蕉也没用，咋整

en: Constipated, probiotics no help, what to do
zh: 我最近老是便秘，吃益生菌也没用，怎么办

en: Cold cold dishes cause quick stomach cramps and diarrhea, poor physical fitness
zh: 一吃生冷凉菜就肠胃拧着疼，拉肚子来得特别快，体质实在太弱了

en: Cold food causes stomach twitching pain and acid reflux, daily diet tips
zh: 吃完凉东西胃里抽抽着疼，还一直犯反酸，平时饮食该咋注意呢

en: After barbecue last night I keep having diarrhea today, stomach noisy, should I take medicine
zh: 昨晚吃完烧烤今天一直拉肚子，肚子还咕噜咕噜的，要不要吃止泻药

en: My right belly hurts on and off lately, appendicitis maybe
zh: 我肚子右边一直隐隐疼，有时候又没事，会不会阑尾炎

en: My left abdomen hurts slightly lately and feels hard when pressed
zh: 最近总是肚子左边隐隐作痛，按着还有点硬正常吗

en: Doctor, my baby was licked by a dog yesterday (the skin didn't break), but her skin was a little red. Should I get a vaccine? I heard that rabies virus cannot penetrate through intact skin?
zh: 医生，我娃昨天被狗舔了一下伤口（没破皮），只是皮肤有点红，还要打疫苗吗？听说狂犬病毒不能透过完整皮肤？

en: My 3-year-old has runny nose for a week, no fever, need antibiotics?
zh: 我孩子三岁，流鼻涕一周了，没发烧，要吃抗生素吗

en: Baby runny clear nose, sneezing, no fever, can take cold meds?
zh: 我宝宝流鼻涕，清水的，打喷嚏，没发烧，能吃感冒药吗

en: My baby started to have a fever last night. Now it's 38 degrees 5 degrees. She's in good spirits. Should I take some antifebrile medicine first?
zh: 我娃昨天晚上开始发烧，现在38度5，精神还行，要不要先吃点退烧药？

en: My baby has been coughing for several days. The cough is particularly severe at night. I feel that there is phlegm and I can't cough it. What medicine should I take to have a good effect?
zh: 我娃咳嗽好几天了，晚上咳得特别厉害，感觉有痰咳不出来，吃什么药效果好？

en: Doctor, my child was infected by other children in kindergarten. She has been coughing and running nose. Can I take some medicine to prevent it?
zh: 医生，我娃在幼儿园被别的小朋友传染了，一直流鼻涕咳嗽，能吃点什么药预防一下吗？

en: I have been taking traditional Chinese medicine to recuperate my body recently, but I feel that it has no effect. Do you want to continue taking it?
zh: 我最近在吃中药调理身体，但是感觉没什么效果，还要不要继续吃？

en: Cough for three months after each cold, what meds can cure it
zh: 我每次感冒后咳嗽三个月，吃啥药能断根

en: I have a little itching below recently, and my leucorrhea is like tofu dregs. Is it a mold infection? Can I go to the pharmacy to buy medicine myself?
zh: 我最近下面有点痒，白带像豆腐渣一样，是不是霉菌感染了？能自己去药店买药吗？

en: Pregnant with severe nasal congestion, can use spray?
zh: 怀孕了感冒鼻塞特别严重能喷药吗

en: Two months pregnant, can I take painkillers for toothache?
zh: 怀孕两个月能不能吃止痛药牙疼受不了

en: Dad has heart stent, on aspirin+clopidogrel, can extract tooth?
zh: 我爸装了心脏支架，现在吃阿司匹林+氯吡格雷，能拔牙吗

en: Elderly with Parkinson's, severe constipation, what meds
zh: 我家老人有帕金森，最近便秘严重，吃什么药

en: Husband fatty liver with high ALT, can hepatoprotective pills lower it?
zh: 我老公脂肪肝，转氨酶高，吃护肝片能降吗

en: Dad missed blood pressure meds for two days, serious?
zh: 我爸高血压药忘吃两天问题大吗

en: Stomach hurts and diarrhea lately, can take amoxicillin?
zh: 我最近胃疼还拉肚子能吃阿莫西林吗

en: Husband poor sperm quality, prescribed levocarnitine, effective?
zh: 我老公精子质量差，医生开了左卡尼汀，有用吗

en: Hair loss, anti-hair loss shampoo no effect, need meds?
zh: 我最近老是脱发，用了生发洗发水没用，要吃药吗

en: Doctor, I took that acne medicine (isotretinoin). Recently, my eyes are so dry that I can't open it, and my lips are cracked so that I bleed. Can I continue to take it? Is there any relief?
zh: 医生，我吃了那个治痤疮的药（异维A酸），最近眼睛干得睁不开，嘴唇裂得流血，还能继续吃吗？有没有什么缓解办法？

en: Acid reflux and heartburn after meals, worse lying down, best med?
zh: 我吃完饭后胃反酸烧心，躺下更严重，吃什么药好

en: Omeprazole for a week, still stomach pain, increase dose?
zh: 我吃了奥美拉唑一周，胃还是疼，要不要加量

en: My stomach has been swelling recently. I burp after eating, and sometimes I turn sour. What medicine should I take?
zh: 我最近胃一直涨，吃完饭就打嗝，有时候还反酸，该吃点什么药啊？

en: After BP medicine I feel dizzy and weak, medication issue maybe
zh: 吃了降压药后老是头晕还没力气是不是药不合适能换吗

en: Accidentally ate wine-containing dishes after taking cephalosporins, inner unease
zh: 服用头孢类药物后误食含酒菜品，当下身体没有异样依旧内心不安

en: Facial redness and heat allergy after using new external skin ointment
zh: 使用新款外用护肤药膏之后，脸颊部位泛红发烫出现明显过敏迹象

en: Feel sleepy weak after taking cold medicine, can drive normally
zh: 吃感冒药之后犯困浑身无力，还能不能正常开车出门办事呀

en: Drowsy after taking cold medicine, doubt driving safety
zh: 吃完治感冒的药片之后昏沉嗜睡，这种状态还能不能出门开车办事

en: Different dosage between offline and online prescribed medicine
zh: 线下拿药和线上问诊开的药量不一样，不清楚按照哪一个标准服用

en: I have constant cicada-like buzzing in head with normal ear tests.
zh: 总感觉脑鸣，脑子里有知了叫，耳鸣检查正常，怎么回事

en: I can smell bad breath myself while others can't. Is it just psychological effect?
zh: 总觉得自己有口臭，戴口罩能闻到，别人说没有，是不是心理作用

en: Sticky oral feeling can't be relieved by drinking water. Is it diabetes?
zh: 我嘴里总是黏黏的，像有胶水，喝很多水也没用，是不是糖尿病

en: My tongue aches and gets blisters after eating oranges. Is it allergy?
zh: 每次吃橘子舌头就疼，还会起小泡，是不是过敏

en: Everything tastes salty recently. Is it taste disturbance?
zh: 最近吃什么都觉得咸，连白粥也咸，是不是味觉失灵

en: Coffee causes palpitations and hand tremors which never happened before. Heart problems?
zh: 每次喝咖啡就心慌手抖，以前不会，是不是心脏出问题了

en: Throat foreign body sensation relieves after belching unimproved by stomach medicine. Is it laryngitis?
zh: 总感觉有东西在喉咙里，打嗝后舒服，吃过胃药没好，是不是喉炎

en: I often have nightmares and wake up with rapid heartbeat due to heavy pressure. Is it mental issue?
zh: 最近老做噩梦，半夜吓醒，心跳快，白天压力大，是不是心理问题

en: I feel cold, flustered, shaky and slim down with normal thyroid test. Is it menopause syndrome?
zh: 最近怕冷，还心慌，手抖，瘦了，查甲功正常，是不是更年期

en: Heat intolerance, sweating and hand tremors excluding hyperthyroidism, check menopause syndrome.
zh: 最近总是怕热，出汗多，心慌，手抖，查了甲功正常，是不是更年期

en: I have poor memory and frequent headaches lately. Is it insufficient cerebral blood supply?
zh: 最近记忆力极差，转身就忘，还头痛，是不是脑供血不足

en: I get dull stomachache when in bad mood recovering after sleep. Gastric ulcer or neurosis?
zh: 最近心情一不好就胃疼，闷痛，睡一觉又好了，是不是胃溃疡还是神经官能症

en: Chest tightness relieved by deep breathing with normal heart checks. Is it neurosis?
zh: 最近总是胸闷，深呼吸才舒服，心电图心脏彩超都正常，是不是神经官能症

en: I have persistent foreign body sensation in throat for half a year. Could it be laryngeal cancer?
zh: 总感觉喉咙里贴了东西，咳不出来，吞不下去，半年了，是不是喉癌

en: I feel extremely sleepy even in daytime lately. Is it narcolepsy?
zh: 最近总想睡觉，白天也困，坐着就能睡着，是不是发作性睡病

en: Excessive yawning and fatigue despite enough sleep. Oxygen deficiency?
zh: 最近总是打哈欠，白天没精神，睡够了还是打，是不是缺氧

en: I sweat heavily on chest and back at night and feel cold in daytime. Is it tuberculosis?
zh: 我晚上睡觉出汗，胸口后背湿透，白天怕冷，是不是结核

en: I drool heavily during sleep recently. Is it spleen deficiency or stroke precursor?
zh: 我晚上睡觉总流口水，早上枕头一滩印子，以前不这样，是不是脾虚还是中风前兆

en: I feel depressed and prone to crying worse before periods. Is it premenstrual depression?
zh: 最近总想哭，心情低落，还头痛，月经前更明显，是不是经前抑郁

en: Perennial cold limbs aggravated by cold stimulation, typical Raynaud's phenomenon.
zh: 最近总是手脚冰凉，冬天更是冰冷，是不是雷诺现象

en: I always need deep breaths feeling chest oppressed. ECG is normal but I still feel uncomfortable.
zh: 总想长出一口气，感觉气不够用，胸口像压了块石头，去医院查心电图没事，还是难受

en: Shortness of breath needing sighs with normal lung function. Is it anxiety disorder?
zh: 最近总想叹气，气短，做深呼吸才舒服，查肺功能正常，是不是焦虑症

en: I always want to take deep breaths with normal check results. Is it neurosis?
zh: 总想深呼吸，但吸不到底，心电图肺功能都正常，是不是神经官能症

en: Persistent sighing chest tightness with normal cardiopulmonary tests.
zh: 最近总是胸闷，感觉气吸不到底，要大口叹气，查心肺都正常

en: My kid passes mucus stool with occasional blood streaks. Is colonoscopy needed?
zh: 娃大便有黏液，像鼻涕一样，偶尔带血丝，精神好，要不要查肠镜

en: Lately I've been super irritable, nothing pleases me, is this menopause?
zh: 我最近脾气特别爆，看啥都不顺眼，是不是更年期了

en: Hand tremors lately, spills cup, hyperthyroidism or Parkinson's?
zh: 我最近手抖，端杯子都洒，甲亢还是帕金森

en: Vegetarian every day, still get fatty liver?
zh: 我天天吃素，还会得脂肪肝吗

en: Losing tons of hair lately, clumps when grab, is it from staying up late
zh: 我最近掉头发特别厉害，一抓一把，是不是熬夜造成的

en: Corner of mouth cracked, can't open wide, heatiness or vitamin deficiency?
zh: 我嘴角烂了，张不开嘴，是上火还是缺维生素

en: Hard bump on sole painful when walking, corn or plantar wart?
zh: 我脚底长了硬疙瘩，走路疼，像踩石子，是鸡眼还是跖疣

en: Pimples recurring at same spot on chin, why
zh: 我下巴长痘，反复在同一个地方，是什么原因

en: Sudden many closed comedones, rough feel, from cleansing oil?
zh: 我脸上突然冒了好多闭口，摸起来粗糙，是不是用了卸妆油

en: Diarrhea day after drinking, bad stomach?
zh: 我每次喝酒之后第二天就拉肚子，是肠胃不好吗

en: Nausea with smell of cooking oil lately, liver issue?
zh: 我最近闻到油烟味就恶心，是不是肝有问题

en: Bloating every time after noodles, gluten allergy?
zh: 我每次吃面条就胃胀，是不是麸质过敏

en: Stomach pain and diarrhea after crab, eat again?
zh: 我吃了螃蟹后肚子疼，拉稀，还能吃吗

en: Stomach pain after fried food, gallbladder or stomach?
zh: 我每次吃油炸的东西就胃疼，是胆囊还是胃的问题

en: Stomach pain and diarrhea after crab, fine before
zh: 我吃了螃蟹后胃疼，还拉肚子，以前吃没问题

en: Shoulder soreness, worse when raising arm, frozen shoulder or cervical?
zh: 我肩膀酸痛，抬手时更疼，是肩周炎还是颈椎病

en: Baby sucks fingers badly, nails bitten off, need intervention?
zh: 我宝宝吃手特别严重，指甲都啃秃了，要不要管

en: Baby gets mouth redness and rash after egg, allergy?
zh: 我宝宝一吃鸡蛋就嘴巴周围红，身上起疹子，是过敏吗

en: Baby rubs eyes constantly, not red, allergy or habit?
zh: 我宝宝一直揉眼睛，眼睛不红，是过敏还是习惯

en: Kid says ankle hurts, limping, no sprain
zh: 我孩子总说脚脖子疼，走路一瘸一拐的，没扭过

en: Kid clears throat constantly for months, tics?
zh: 我孩子老清嗓子，吭吭的，好几个月了，是抽动症吗

en: Kid's hair yellow, thin and soft, deficiency?
zh: 我孩子头发黄，又细又软，是缺什么

en: Kid says can't breathe but fine when playing, faking?
zh: 我孩子最近老说喘不上气，但玩起来又没事，是装的吗

en: Kid intermittent abdominal pain, better with rub, colic?
zh: 我孩子最近总说肚子疼，揉一揉就好，一会又疼，是肠痉挛吗

en: Child back pain when doing homework, scoliosis?
zh: 我孩子做作业一坐就腰疼，是不是脊柱侧弯

en: Baby shakes head, sometimes shivers like chill, calcium deficiency?
zh: 我宝宝老摇头，有时候像打冷颤一样抖一下，是缺钙吗

en: Pain behind knee worse with activity, growing pain?
zh: 我孩子总说膝盖后面疼，活动多了更疼，是生长痛吗

en: Palms and soles peeling in layers, not itchy
zh: 我宝宝手心和脚心脱皮，一层一层的，不痒

en: Kid's hair thin, yellow, slow growth, zinc deficiency?
zh: 我孩子头发稀疏，发黄，长得慢，是缺锌吗

en: Doctor, I recently discovered that my son's penis is a little red. He said it hurts when he pees. Is it severe?
zh: 医生，我最近发现我儿子小鸡鸡那里有点红，他说尿尿的时候疼，是不是发严了？

en: Doctor, my baby has a lot of red pimples. They are very itchy. He keeps scratching and they are all scratched. Is he allergic? Or eczema? What ointment can I apply?
zh: 医生，我娃身上起了好多红疙瘩，一片一片的，特别痒，他老抓，都抓破了，是不是过敏了？还是湿疹？能抹什么药膏？

en: Doctor, I have a small pimple on my neck. It doesn't hurt or itch, but I can touch it. What is it?
zh: 医生，我脖子上长了个小疙瘩，不疼不痒的，但是能摸到，是什么东西啊？

en: I have pain in my knees recently, especially when going up and down the stairs. Is it arthritis?
zh: 我最近膝盖疼，特别是上下楼梯的时候，是不是关节炎啊？

en: I feel numb in my hands and feet recently, especially when I sleep. Is there a problem with my cervical spine?
zh: 我最近感觉手脚发麻，特别是睡觉起来的时候，是不是颈椎有问题？

en: When I brush my teeth recently, my gums always bleed, and my teeth are a little loose. What should I do?
zh: 我最近刷牙的时候牙龈总是出血，而且牙齿有点松动了，该怎么办？

en: I always feel very tired recently. I am tired when I wake up. I am tired all over. Is my body too weak?
zh: 我最近总是觉得特别累，睡醒了也累，浑身没劲，是不是身体太虚了？

en: I recently discovered that there is a swollen lymph node on my husband's neck. It feels hard and doesn't hurt. Is it serious?
zh: 我最近发现我老公脖子上有个淋巴结肿了，摸上去硬硬的，不疼，要不要紧？

en: I always feel that my eyes are a little blurred recently. Is my myopia deepening?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛看东西有点模糊，是不是近视加深了？

en: Doctor, I always feel waist pain recently, and I have foam when I urinate. Is there a kidney problem?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得腰疼，而且小便的时候有泡沫，是不是肾有问题？

en: I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I stand up. My eyes turn black. Is it anemia?
zh: 我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是站起来的时候，眼前发黑，是不是贫血？

en: I always feel back pain recently, especially when I bend down. Is it a herniated lumbar disc?
zh: 我最近总是觉得腰疼，特别是弯腰的时候，是不是腰椎间盘突出？

en: I always feel flustered recently, and sometimes my heart beats very fast. Is it hyperthyroidism?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳很快，是不是甲亢？

en: I always feel joint pain recently, especially my knees. Is it arthritis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是膝盖，是不是关节炎？

en: Doctor, I always feel sore in my back recently, especially when I get up in the morning. I feel hard. It's better to exercise, but it hurts after sitting for a long time during the day. Is it a strain of my waist muscles? Or is there a kidney problem?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得腰酸，特别是早上起来的时候，感觉腰都硬了，活动活动就好点，但是白天坐久了又疼，是不是腰肌劳损？还是肾有问题？

en: I always feel back pain recently, especially when I bend down to wash my hair or mop the floor. It hurts so much that I can't straighten it. Is the lumbar disc herniated?
zh: 我最近总是觉得腰疼，特别是弯腰洗头或者拖地的时候，疼得直不起来，是不是腰椎间盘突出了？

en: Doctor, I always feel that the soles of my feet are hot recently, like stepping on charcoal fire. It's still hot when I take off the quilt when I sleep at night. Is it because of the yin deficiency and the fire? Or is it a diabetic complication?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得脚底板发热，像踩在炭火上一样，晚上睡觉脱了被子也热，是不是阴虚火旺？还是糖尿病并发症？

en: Always tired even after sleep, blood count normal
zh: 我最近总感觉累，睡醒了也累，查过血常规没事

en: Yawning frequently lately, not from lack of sleep
zh: 我最近老是打哈欠，没睡好，但打太多了

en: Hoarse voice for nearly a month, no cold
zh: 我最近说话声音变哑，没有感冒，快一个月了

en: Constant tearing, worse in wind, blocked tear duct?
zh: 我最近一直流眼泪，迎风更严重，是泪道堵了吗

en: Flush and sweat when excited, what disease
zh: 我最近一激动就脸红，脖子红，还出汗，是什么病

en: Sweet taste in mouth constantly, what disease
zh: 我最近老觉得嘴里发甜，吃什么都甜，是什么病

en: Many white hairs at back of head recently, stress?
zh: 我最近后脑勺长了很多白发，以前没有，是不是压力大

en: Can't taste or smell anything, post-COVID?
zh: 我最近吃啥都感觉没味道，闻也闻不到，是新冠后遗症吗

en: I always feel flustered recently, my heart beats fast, and my hands are shaking, but my blood pressure is not high, and my weight is lighter. Is it hyperthyroidism? What medicine do I need to take?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，心跳快，手抖，但是量血压不高，体重反而轻了，是不是甲亢？需要吃什么药？

en: I always feel flustered recently. Sometimes my heart beats very fast and my hands shake. Is it hyperthyroidism?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳很快，手也跟着抖，是不是甲亢？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling flustered recently. Sometimes my heart beats very fast and my hands are shaking. Is it hyperthyroidism? Do I need to check my skills?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳很快，手也跟着抖，是不是甲亢？需要查甲功吗？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling flustered recently. Sometimes my heart beats very fast and my hands are shaking. Is it hyperthyroidism?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳很快，手也跟着抖，是不是甲亢？

en: Bitter taste and bad breath every morning, brushing doesn't help
zh: 我每天早上起来嘴里发苦，还口臭，刷牙也没用

en: Bitter taste and bleeding gums in morning, even after teeth cleaning
zh: 我每天早上起来口苦，刷牙出血，洗了牙也没好转

en: Doctor, I always feel like I have a big rock on my back recently. It's heavy, especially after climbing two floors of buildings. Is it emphysema? Or is your heart bad?
zh: 医生，我最近总觉得后背像背了块大石头，沉甸甸的，尤其是爬两层楼就喘不上气，是不是肺气肿啊？还是心脏不好？

en: Cough worse at night, triggered by cooking oil fume
zh: 我最近老咳嗽，半夜更厉害，闻到油烟味就咳

en: Doctor, I've been feeling a sore throat recently, and it's even more obvious when I swallow. Is my tonsils inflamed?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得喉咙痛，吞咽的时候更明显，是不是扁桃体发炎了？

en: Recently, I always feel that there is phlegm in my throat, and I can't cough it out or swallow it. Is it chronic pharyngitis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得喉咙里有痰，咳不出来也咽不下去，是不是慢性咽炎？

en: Recently, I have been feeling that there is something blocked in my throat. I can't cough it out and swallow it. It doesn't affect me even if I eat and drink water. Is it chronic pharyngitis or plum blossom?
zh: 我最近总觉得嗓子眼有东西堵着，咳不出来咽不下去，吃饭喝水都不影响，是不是慢性咽炎或者梅核气？

en: Recently, I always feel that there is something blocked in my throat that I can't cough it out and swallow it. It doesn't affect me even if I eat and drink water. Is it chronic pharyngitis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得嗓子眼里有东西堵着，咳不出来咽不下去，吃饭喝水都不影响，是不是慢性咽炎？

en: Recently, I always feel that there is something blocked in my throat, and I can't cough it out or swallow it. It's more obvious after eating. Sometimes I even reflux acid. Is it reflux?
zh: 我最近总是觉得嗓子眼里有东西堵着，咳不出来也咽不下去，吃完饭更明显，有时候还反酸水，是不是反流性食管炎？

en: Lump in armpit tender on pressure, worse around period
zh: 我腋下有个疙瘩，按着疼，月经前后更明显

en: Moveable painless lump in left breast, fibroadenoma?
zh: 我左乳有个疙瘩，不疼，会滑动，是纤维腺瘤吗

en: Periods been early for two months, light flow, used to be regular
zh: 我这俩月月经老提前，量还少，以前可准了

en: I have a little itching below recently, and my leucorrhea is abnormal. It's yellow and has a little smell. Is there inflammation?
zh: 我最近下面有点痒，白带也不正常，黄黄的，还有点味道，是不是有炎症了？

en: In the past two months, I have had very little menstruation. It disappeared in two days. The color is still dark, and my stomach does not hurt. I just wonder if it is premature ovarian failure? I haven't had a baby yet. I'm so scared.
zh: 我最近这俩月吧，月经量特别少，两天就没了，颜色还发黑，肚子倒是也不疼，就是心里犯嘀咕，是不是卵巢早衰了？我还没生孩子呢，好害怕。

en: I recently lost weight and dieted and only ate boiled vegetables. As a result, my menstruation was delayed for half a month and my face was sallow. Is there an endocrine disorder? Will she be infertile?
zh: 我最近减肥节食，只吃水煮菜，结果月经推迟半个月还没来，脸色也蜡黄，是不是内分泌乱了？会不会不孕啊？

en: Hey doctor, in the past two months, I have had very little menstruation. It disappeared in two days. The color is still dark, and my stomach doesn't hurt. I just wonder if it's premature ovarian failure? I haven't had a baby yet. I'm so scared.
zh: 哎医生，我最近这俩月吧，月经量特别少，两天就没了，颜色还发黑，肚子倒是也不疼，就是心里犯嘀咕，是不是卵巢早衰了？我还没生孩子呢，好害怕。

en: I have been preparing for pregnancy recently, but my menstruation has been irregular. Sometimes I come every 40 days, and sometimes I only come every two months. Is it difficult for me to get pregnant? Do you want to take some Chinese medicine to recuperate?
zh: 我最近在备孕，但是月经一直不规律，有时候40多天才来一次，有时候两个月才来，我是不是不容易怀孕啊？要不要吃点中药调理一下？

en: Recently, I always feel that there is something blocked in my throat, and I can't cough it out and swallow it. I eat and drink normally, but I'm just upset. Is it menopausal syndrome?
zh: 我最近总是觉得嗓子眼里有东西堵着，咳不出来咽不下去，吃饭喝水正常，就是心里烦，是不是更年期综合征？

en: Recently, I always feel that there is something in my throat that I can't cough it out and swallow it, but it doesn't affect me even if I eat and drink water. It's just annoying. Is it menopause?
zh: 我最近总是觉得嗓子眼里有东西，咳不出来咽不下去，但是吃饭喝水都不影响，就是心里烦，是不是更年期？

en: Doctor, recently I always feel that there is something blocked in my throat, and I can't cough it out and swallow it. I eat and drink normally, but I just feel upset. Is it menopausal syndrome?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得嗓子眼里有东西堵着，咳不出来咽不下去，吃饭喝水正常，就是心里烦，是不是更年期综合征？

en: Palpitations worse after meals, ECG normal
zh: 我最近老是心慌，吃完饭后更明显，查了心电图没事

en: Lately my head feels dizzy like I'm drunk, but I haven't touched alcohol
zh: 我这两天脑袋晕乎乎的，跟喝了酒似的，但滴酒没沾

en: Headaches when weather changes, like a tight band, why
zh: 我最近天气一变就头疼，像戴了紧箍咒，是什么原因

en: Left temple throbbing pain, sometimes eye swelling
zh: 我最近老觉得左边太阳穴跳着疼，有时候眼睛也胀

en: Left arm feels cold, skin cool to touch, what's up
zh: 我最近老觉得左胳膊发凉，摸着皮肤温度也低，怎么回事

en: Mom-in-law dizzy like on a boat, spinning, nausea
zh: 我婆婆总说头晕，像坐船一样，天旋地转，还恶心

en: Fingertips numb like wearing gloves, what sensation
zh: 我最近总觉得手指尖发麻，像戴了手套，是什么感觉

en: Purple spider-web like veins on thigh, what
zh: 我大腿上有紫色的血管网，像蜘蛛网，是什么

en: Lately my head feels foggy like a plastic bag over it, memory also poor
zh: 我这两天头蒙蒙的，像罩了个塑料袋，记性也差

en: Choke on food and water, especially liquids, laryngoscopy normal
zh: 我吃东西呛咳，喝水也呛，特别是流质，做过喉镜没事

en: Doctor, I always feel flustered recently. Sometimes I feel like my heartbeat misses a beat. Is it an irregular heart rhythm?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳漏了一拍，是不是心律不齐？

en: I always feel flustered recently, and sometimes my heart beats very fast. Is my heart rhythm irregular?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳很快，是不是心律不齐？

en: I always feel flustered recently, my heartbeat misses a beat, and sometimes my heart beats a beat. Several times a day. Is it premature? Is it serious? Need hospitalization?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，心跳漏一拍，有时候心里咯噔一下，一天好几次，是不是早搏？严重吗？需要住院吗？

en: I always feel flustered recently, my heartbeat misses a beat, and sometimes my heart beats a beat. Several times a day. Is it premature? Is it serious? Need hospitalization?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，心跳漏一拍，有时候心里咯噔一下，一天好几次，是不是早搏？严不严重？需要住院吗？

en: I always feel flustered recently. Sometimes I feel like my heartbeat misses a beat, and then my heart beats. Is it premature? Is it serious?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心慌，有时候感觉心跳漏了一拍，然后心里咯噔一下，是不是早搏？严不严重？

en: I always hear someone talking in my ear but no one there, hallucination?
zh: 我总觉得有人在我耳边说话，但我转头没人，是幻觉吗

en: Feel followed but no one there, mental problem?
zh: 我最近老感觉有人跟踪我，回头看没人，是不是精神问题

en: Very distracted lately, mind wanders when others talk
zh: 我最近注意力特别不集中，别人说话我听着就飘走了

en: Lately so irritable I want to smash my phone, hormonal imbalance?
zh: 我最近脾气差到想砸手机，是不是内分泌失调

en: My brain feels slow, sluggish, like rusted
zh: 我感觉脑子转不动，反应迟钝，像锈住了

en: I have been under a lot of pressure recently. I always can't sleep at night. I wake up easily when I fall asleep. I have no energy during the day. What should I do?
zh: 我最近压力很大，晚上总是睡不着，睡着了也容易醒，白天没精神，该怎么办？

en: I always feel panicked recently, my heart beats so fast that it feels like it's about to jump out, sometimes my hands are still shaking, and my blood pressure is not high. Is it an anxiety disorder? Or cardiac neurosis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得心里发慌，心跳快得像要蹦出来，有时候手还抖，量血压也不高，是不是焦虑症犯了？还是心脏神经官能症？

en: It has been two months since my wife gave birth to a child, and she has been in a low mood. She cries often and is unwilling to go out. She has no interest in anything. Is she postpartum depression? Should I see a psychiatrist?
zh: 我老婆生完孩子两个月了，情绪一直很低落，动不动就哭，也不愿意出门，对啥都没兴趣，是不是产后抑郁了？要不要去看心理医生？

en: Grandpa walks slower, shuffles feet, memory also poor
zh: 我外公走路越来越慢，脚步拖地，记忆力也差

en: Lately very high libido, wife can't handle, is it illness?
zh: 我最近性欲特别强，但老婆受不了，是不是病

en: Left testicle much bigger than right, painless, need check?
zh: 我左边蛋蛋比右边大很多，不疼，需要检查吗

en: I always want to go to the toilet recently, but I pee a little every time. It still hurts a little. Is it a urinary tract infection?
zh: 我最近总是想上厕所，但是每次就尿一点点，还有点疼，是不是尿路感染了？

en: Small blisters on hands very itchy, relief after squeezing, eczema?
zh: 我手上起小水泡，很痒，一挤出水就好了，是湿疹吗

en: Small fleshy bump on face can't pull off, what is it
zh: 我脸上有个小肉粒，揪不掉，是什么东西

en: White patch on arm lighter than skin, not spreading
zh: 我胳膊上有一块白斑，比别的皮肤白，但没有扩散

en: Painful red bumps on face that last days, steroid face?
zh: 我脸上起那种一摸就疼的大红包，好几天不下去，是不是激素脸

en: Red raised mole on chest, hemangioma?
zh: 我胸前长了个红色的痣，高出皮肤，是不是血管瘤

en: Face asymmetrical, left bigger than right, no pain
zh: 我的脸不对称，左脸比右脸大，不疼，是啥病

en: Hard lump at mid-chest for years, no pain
zh: 我胸口正中间长了个硬疙瘩，不疼，好几年了

en: I always feel itchy on my skin recently, especially at night. After scratching, I have red pimples. Is it hives?
zh: 我最近总是觉得皮肤痒，特别是晚上，抓了之后起红疙瘩，是不是荨麻疹？

en: Recently, I always feel itchy on my skin, scratching the running water, and leaving black marks after scab, especially on my elbows and knees. Is it eczema? Can I apply hormone ointment?
zh: 我最近总是觉得皮肤痒，抓破了流水，结痂后留黑印，特别是胳膊肘和膝盖窝，是不是湿疹？能涂激素药膏吗？

en: Doctor, I always feel itchy on my skin recently, scratching the running water, and leaving black marks after scab, especially on my elbows and knees. Is it eczema? Can I apply hormone ointment?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得皮肤痒，抓破了流水，结痂后留黑印，特别是胳膊肘和膝盖窝，是不是湿疹？能涂激素药膏吗？

en: Recently, I always feel that my eyes are dry, itchy, and a little red, especially after looking at my phone for a long time. Is it dry eye? What eye drops can I use?
zh: 我最近总是觉得眼睛干涩发痒，还有点红血丝，特别是看手机看久了之后，是不是干眼症？能用什么眼药水？

en: Doctor, I always feel dry, itchy, and a little red recently. Especially after looking at my mobile phone for a long time. Is it dry eye? What eye drops can I use?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得眼睛干涩发痒，还有点红血丝，特别是看手机看久了之后，是不是干眼症？能用什么眼药水？

en: Always hungry soon after meals, blood sugar normal
zh: 我最近老是觉得饿，刚吃完饭没多久就饿，查过血糖没问题

en: Always hungry half hour after meal, also losing weight
zh: 我最近老是感觉饿，吃了饭半小时就饿，还瘦了

en: Doctor, I have been feeling dizzy, dizzy, nausea and vomiting recently, but my ears and hearing seem to have not been affected. Is it otolithiasis? How to reset the fastest?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得头晕，天旋地转，恶心呕吐，但耳朵听力好像没受影响，是不是耳石症？怎么复位最快？

en: I always feel dizzy, dizzy, nausea and vomiting recently, but my ears and hearing seem to have not been affected. Is it otolithiasis? How to reset the fastest?
zh: 我最近总是觉得头晕，天旋地转，恶心呕吐，但耳朵听力好像没受影响，是不是耳石症？怎么复位最快？

en: Feel worms moving in anus, itchy, worse at night
zh: 我最近老感觉肛门有虫子蠕动，痒，夜里更明显

en: I have lost weight recently and don't eat at night, but my stomach is starting to hurt. Is it because of hunger?
zh: 我最近减肥，晚上不吃饭，但是胃开始疼了，是不是饿出来的毛病？

en: I always feel stomachache recently, especially after eating greasy food. Is there a problem with my gallbladder?
zh: 我最近总是觉得肚子疼，特别是吃了油腻的东西之后，是不是胆囊有问题？

en: Doctor, I always feel bitter in my mouth recently, especially when I wake up in the morning and can't even brush my teeth properly. Is there a problem with my gallbladder? Or is your stomach fire too strong?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得嘴里发苦，特别是早上起来，刷牙都刷不干净那种感觉，是不是胆囊有问题？还是胃火太旺了？

en: Doctor, I always feel that there is a rust smell in my mouth recently. It doesn't work even if I brush my teeth. Sometimes I even have a nosebleed. Is there a blood problem? Still getting angry?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得嘴里有股铁锈味，刷牙也不管用，有时候还流鼻血，是不是血液出问题了？还是上火？

en: Doctor, recently I always feel that my fingers are as stiff as I can't hold a fist in the morning. I have to exercise for a long time before I can straighten them out. Is it rheumatoid?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得手指头早上起来僵硬得像握不住拳，得活动好半天才能伸直，是不是类风湿？

en: I always feel pain in my joints recently, especially the root of my big toe. It is red, swollen and hot. It hurts when I touch it. Is gout? Can I take painkillers?
zh: 我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是大脚趾根部，红肿热痛，一碰就钻心地疼，是不是痛风犯了？能不能吃止痛药？

en: Recently, I always feel that the joints of my fingers are swollen, especially the middle section. It is hard and like a nodule. It feels stiff in the morning. Is it osteoarthritis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得手指头关节肿大，特别是中间那节，硬硬的，像结节一样，早上起来僵硬，是不是骨关节炎？

en: Doctor, I have been feeling joint pain recently, especially my finger joints. I get up stiff in the morning and it takes half an hour to get better. Is it rheumatoid arthritis?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得关节疼，特别是手指关节，早上起床僵硬，活动半小时才好，是不是类风湿关节炎？

en: Finger joints stiff in morning, gets better after moving, what's that
zh: 手指关节早上起来僵硬，活动一会就好了，是怎么回事

en: Top of foot swollen, not red, painful walking, no sprain
zh: 我脚背肿了，不红，走路疼，没扭伤过

en: Mid-lower back pain worse bending, better straightening
zh: 我最近后腰正中间疼，弯腰时加重，直起来好点

en: Doctor, I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I turn my head or turn my head. I'll be fine if I faint. Is it cervical spondylosis?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是转头或者扭头的时候，晕一下就好了，是不是颈椎病？

en: Doctor, I always feel waist pain recently, especially when I bend down to wash my hair or mop the floor. It hurts so much that I can't straighten it. Is the lumbar disc herniated?
zh: 医生，我最近总是觉得腰疼，特别是弯腰洗头或者拖地的时候，疼得直不起来，是不是腰椎间盘突出了？

en: I always feel dizzy recently, especially when I turn my head or turn my head. I'll be fine if I faint. Is it cervical spondylosis?
zh: 我最近总是觉得头晕，特别是转头或者扭头的时候，晕一下就好了，是不是颈椎病？

en: BP fluctuates a lot, morning 160/100, afternoon 120/80, normal?
zh: 我最近血压波动大，早上160/100，下午120/80，正常吗

en: Unstable BP, systolic 140-160, diastolic normal
zh: 我最近血压不稳定，高压有时140有时160，低压正常

en: Eating pineapple causes swollen lips and sore tongue. Is it allergy and can I eat it later?
zh: 我每次吃菠萝嘴唇就肿，舌头疼，是不是过敏，以后还能吃吗

en: I have persistent bitter taste in mouth worse in the morning. Is it gallbladder problem?
zh: 最近嘴里总是发苦，早上起来尤其明显，吃什么都是苦的，喝水都苦，是不是胆囊的问题

en: Glove-like numbness on fingertips of both hands. Cervical problem or diabetes?
zh: 我手指尖发麻，像戴手套的感觉，双手都有，是颈椎问题还是糖尿病

en: Bark-like stiff skin on back of hand. Is it scleroderma?
zh: 我手背皮肤变硬，像树皮，不能捏起来，是不是硬皮病

en: I feel nauseous and retch while brushing teeth in the morning. Is it pharyngitis?
zh: 总感觉想吐，尤其是早上刷牙时，干呕，平时不恶心，是不是咽炎

en: I have endless transparent sticky phlegm in throat. Is it chronic pharyngitis?
zh: 总感觉嗓子里有痰，咳出来是透明的，黏黏的，咳不完，是慢性咽炎吗

en: I feel nauseous after meals without vomiting. Is it gastritis?
zh: 最近饭后想吐，恶心，但不吐出来，是不是胃炎

en: My kid has yellow runny nose for over two weeks with stuffy nose and mouth breathing at night. Is it rhinitis?
zh: 孩子流黄鼻涕两个多星期了，不是感冒，精神也好，就是鼻子不通，晚上张嘴睡觉，是不是鼻炎了

en: I have lots of thick yellow phlegm every morning. Is it chronic pharyngitis?
zh: 我每天早上起来痰多，黄色的块状，要咳好几口才干净，是慢性咽炎吗

en: I have throbbing neuralgia pain on the back of head. Is it occipital neuralgia?
zh: 我后脑勺有个地方按着疼，像神经痛，一下一下的，是不是枕神经痛

en: Grapefruit triggers mouth ulcers and tongue blisters. Food allergy?
zh: 每次吃柚子就口腔溃疡，舌头起泡，是不是过敏

en: Painless red mole-like spots increase on my chest. Does it mean poor liver function?
zh: 我胸前起红色小点，不疼不痒，像血痣，越来越多，是不是肝不好

en: My soles feel burning hot especially at night. Is it neuritis?
zh: 最近脚底板发热，发烫，尤其晚上，要放凉水里才舒服，是不是神经炎

en: My gums bleed easily without tooth pain. Could it be leukemia?
zh: 我牙龈总出血，刷牙出血，吸一下也出血，但牙齿不疼，是不是白血病

en: I have bloody saliva in the morning which disappears after brushing teeth. Is it periodontitis?
zh: 我早上起来嘴里有血，吐出来的口水是红的，刷牙后没了，是不是牙周炎

en: Hand tremors obvious while dining without drinking. Essential tremor?
zh: 最近总是手抖，拿筷子夹菜时明显，不喝酒，是不是特发性震颤

en: My hands shake obviously when holding things and get better after drinking alcohol.
zh: 我手上有时候会突然抖，拿东西时明显，喝了酒会好一点，是什么病

en: I urinate frequently three times an hour without pain. Is it caused by too much water intake?
zh: 最近尿频，一小时去了三次，不疼，是不是水喝多了

en: Raw scallions and garlic cause stomach discomfort. Weak stomach?
zh: 每次吃生葱生蒜就胃痛，烧心，是不是胃不好

en: Painless black toenail without trauma. Subungual hemorrhage or melanoma?
zh: 我脚趾甲变黑，不疼，没外伤，是不是甲下出血还是黑色素瘤

en: Staring at computer all day makes my eyes dry gritty. Sodium hyaluronate eye drops only work temporarily. Will I go blind?
zh: 天天对着电脑，眼睛干得像里面塞了沙子，滴了那个玻璃酸钠就好一会，不滴又干，会不会瞎啊

en: I cough badly as soon as I lie down at night with an unbearable itchy throat. I cough up white frothy phlegm. What’s wrong with me?
zh: 晚上一躺下就咳得要死要活，喉咙痒得受不了，咳出来的痰是白的泡沫状，这到底什么毛病啊

en: A hard bone-like painless lump grows on my back for months. What is it?
zh: 后背上长了个硬包，摸着像骨头，不疼不痒，发现好几个月了，是啥东西

en: A movable painless hard lump grows under the skin of my elbow.
zh: 我手肘上长了个硬疙瘩，按着不疼，在皮肤里面，能滑动，是什么

en: Numb anesthetic-like skin on outer thigh lasts for months.
zh: 我大腿外侧有一块皮肤麻木，像打了麻药，掐着不疼，好几个月了，是啥病

en: I feel bloated after every meal and need to lie down for a while. Is it gastroptosis?
zh: 最近吃啥都胃胀，饭后必须躺一会，是不是胃下垂

en: I feel sore between shoulder blades relieved by moving around. Is it fasciitis?
zh: 我后背肩胛骨缝疼，像有气窜，活动一下就好，是不是筋膜炎

en: Sternal pain when pressing and coughing after lifting heavy things. Is it sternal fracture?
zh: 胸口正中间骨头按着疼，咳嗽也疼，之前搬过重物，是不是胸骨骨折了

en: Rough raised age spots on hands get bigger recently. Risk of canceration?
zh: 我手背上老年斑凸起，粗糙，最近一个变大了，会不会癌变

en: Fixed tender point on my spine worsens when bending. Is it lumbar disc herniation?
zh: 我后背脊柱中间有一个点按着疼，弯腰更明显，但不影响活动，是腰椎间盘突出吗

en: My belly button smells bad with hard black dirt inside. Can I dig it out?
zh: 我肚脐眼里面臭臭的，还有黑色硬块，能不能抠

en: Sausage-like swollen shiny fingers. Is it scleroderma?
zh: 我手指头肿胀，像香肠，皮肤发亮，是不是硬皮病

en: There is a painless lump behind my knee which stands out when straightening legs. Is it popliteal cyst?
zh: 我膝盖后面的窝里有个包，腿伸直时明显，不疼，是不是腘窝囊肿

en: I have lumbago difficult to straighten up after bending over. Is it lumbar muscle strain?
zh: 最近腰酸背痛，弯腰洗头都直不起来，睡硬板床好点，是不是腰肌劳损

en: Painless small bumps grow on foreskin. I’m afraid it’s venereal disease and dare not see doctor.
zh: 洗澡的时候发现包皮上长了几个小疙瘩，不疼不痒，没出过轨，害怕是性病，也不敢去医院

en: My hands shake involuntarily especially holding cups with flustered mood, while thyroid function test is normal.
zh: 手会不自觉地抖，尤其是端杯子喝水的时候，水能洒出来，心里还总觉得慌慌的，查过甲功正常

en: I got facial paralysis with water leakage while drinking. Can hormone treatment cure it thoroughly?
zh: 前天起床突然发现嘴歪，喝水会漏，眼睛闭不紧，赶紧去了医院说是面瘫，给我开了激素，能治好吗

en: Painless back bone spurs found on X-ray. Need treatment?
zh: 我后背有骨刺，X光看到，不疼，要不要处理

en: I feel weak and dizzy lately, often nauseous, not sure what's wrong
zh: 最近总浑身发软头也昏沉沉的，时不时还犯恶心，不知道咋回事要不要紧啊

en: Severe hair loss lately, washing pulls clumps, illness?
zh: 我最近掉头发特别多洗头一抓一把是不是生病了

en: Many itchy blisters peeling on hands, worried about infecting family members
zh: 手上长了好多小水泡一碰就痒，还会脱皮，传染不传染家里人呀

en: Lots of fat granules on face, various skin care products useless
zh: 脸上长出好多脂肪粒小颗粒，护肤品换了好多种都没办法消除

en: Mood swings and irritability lately, cannot control
zh: 最近情绪特别差一点事就想发火控制不住

en: Want to cry and no energy lately, depression maybe
zh: 最近总想哭没力气做事饭也不想吃是不是抑郁了

en: My heart feels nervous and I cannot sleep, mind nonstop, do I have anxiety
zh: 最近心里老发慌睡不着，脑子停不下来，我是不是焦虑症了

en: Chest feels blocked lately but exams normal, psychological maybe
zh: 我最近老感觉胸口堵堵的，检查又没啥问题，是不是心理问题啊

en: Normal fasting blood sugar high postprandial sugar, need hypoglycemic drugs
zh: 空腹血糖正常餐后血糖偏高，这种情况需要专门吃降糖药吗

en: Elderly numb inflexible legs hard to climb steps, improvement conditioning
zh: 家里老人走路腿脚麻木不灵活，上下台阶格外吃力该怎么调理改善

en: I got a painful lump near butt lately and sitting hurts badly
zh: 最近屁股上长了个包，坐着特别疼，还不敢碰怎么办

en: Got mouth sores after Ejiao, can continue?
zh: 我吃了阿胶后上火，嘴上起泡，还能继续吃吗

en: I have been eating a new health care product recently, and after taking it, I feel uncomfortable to my stomach. Is it impossible to eat it?
zh: 我最近在吃一种新的保健品，吃了之后感觉胃不舒服，是不是不能吃？

en: More sleepy morning after melatonin, continue?
zh: 我吃了褪黑素后早上更困了，还能吃吗

en: Last doctor was great, can I tip him?
zh: 我上次问诊的医生态度特别好，能给他打赏吗

en: You should add a blacklist function to block certain doctors
zh: 我觉得你们应该加上黑名单功能，拉黑某些医生

zh: 我家门锁突然识别不了指纹了

en: Car shaking and strange noise, engine issue?
zh: 车子突然抖动还有怪声是不是发动机问题

en: Car shakes when accelerating lately, engine issue?
zh: 我车最近踩油门老抖是不是发动机问题

en: Car brakes making strange sounds lately, normal?
zh: 车子最近刹车老有异响正常吗

en: My car brakes make squeaking sounds lately, worried something’s wrong
zh: 我车子最近刹车总有吱吱响声，开着有点害怕是不是有问题

en: My car suddenly wouldn’t start yesterday and still won’t today
zh: 车子昨天突然打不着火了，今天还是不行，会不会电瓶坏了

en: My car suddenly shakes badly while driving with strange noise, engine broken maybe
zh: 我车开着开着突然抖得厉害，还有怪声音是不是发动机坏了

en: Package tracking not updating lately, lost maybe?
zh: 最近快递一直不更新是不是丢件了

en: Computer black screen and won’t start, data risk
zh: 电脑黑屏开不了机文件还没备份怎么办

en: My computer suddenly black screens and won’t start, files not backed up
zh: 电脑突然开不了机一直黑屏，我文件还没备份怎么办啊

en: AC runs but no airflow, broken maybe
zh: 空调不出风了但还能开机是不是坏了

en: My air conditioner powers on but no wind comes out, broken maybe
zh: 我家空调突然一点风都没有，但还能开机是不是坏了

en: Apps not opening after update, system issue
zh: 更新系统后软件全打不开怎么办

en: Home wifi keeps disconnecting lately and TV cannot connect, router issue
zh: 家里wifi最近老断网，电视也连不上，是路由器问题吗

en: Slow internet and video lag, provider issue?
zh: 网速很慢视频一直卡是不是运营商问题

en: Restarted router but still no internet
zh: 路由器重启了还是连不上网

en: Router suddenly can’t connect to internet, broken?
zh: 路由器突然连不上网是不是坏了

en: Why was my mortgage payment suddenly higher?
zh: 我这个月房贷怎么突然扣多了

en: My credit card bill suddenly increased a lot this month, not sure why
zh: 我这个月信用卡账单突然多了好多，不知道哪里扣的钱

en: Game account keeps logging in elsewhere, hacked?
zh: 游戏账号老异地登录是不是被盗了

en: My game account keeps showing foreign logins lately, hacked maybe?
zh: 游戏账号最近总提示异地登录，我是不是被盗号了

en: Credit card suddenly unusable, frozen maybe?
zh: 信用卡突然刷不了是不是冻结了

en: What's your name? Are you human or robot?
zh: 你叫什么名字，是真人还是机器人

en: What's today's date? I forgot
zh: 今天几月几号，我忘了

en: Do you look good?
zh: 你长得好看吗

en: Can you help me calculate 3+5?
zh: 你能帮我算一下3+5等于多少吗

en: It's my birthday today, can you sing a birthday song?
zh: 我今天过生日，能给我唱个生日歌吗

en: Is your company hiring? I want to interview
zh: 你们公司还招人吗，我想来面试

en: My bestie said she found a boyfriend on your platform, really?
zh: 我闺蜜说她在这个平台找到了对象，真的假的

en: Does your hospital have 24-hour emergency services? Can I go directly if I get sick in the middle of the night?
zh: 请问你们医院有24小时急诊吗？半夜生病可以直接去吗？

en: I want to ask you what time does the hospital clinic open on weekends? I'm taking my child for a physical examination, so don't make a wasted trip.
zh: 我想问问你们医院周末门诊几点开门？我要带孩子去做个体检，别白跑一趟。

en: I want to know if I sign up online but can't go because of something that comes up last time, can I cancel it? Will fees be deducted?
zh: 我想知道如果我在网上挂了号，但是临时有事去不了，能不能取消？会不会扣费？

en: Doctor, can you do nucleic acid testing here? How long will the results be available? How much does it cost once?
zh: 医生，你们这里能做核酸检测吗？大概多久出结果？多少钱一次？

en: I would like to ask for advice. If I have previous medical records, is it useful to upload the electronic version? Do you still need to bring a paper version?
zh: 我想咨询一下，如果我有既往病历，上传电子版有用吗？还是需要带纸质版？

en: Excuse me, does your hospital have a pediatric specialty? Which department number should my child register for when he is sick?
zh: 请问你们医院有儿童专科吗？孩子生病应该挂哪个科的号？

en: Finger joints stiff every morning and better later, rheumatism maybe
zh: 最近手指关节早上特别僵硬，活动一会才好，是风湿吗
